summary.zh: 人类至少在约五万年前已进入当时相连的澳大利亚与新几内亚大陆，跨越海峡需要航海能力。更早年代仍有讨论，地图点仅代表澳大利亚北部，不能据此推定唯一登陆地点、迁徙路线或某一年的到达。
summary.en: People had reached Sahul, the connected landmass of Australia and New Guinea, by at least roughly 50,000 years ago. Sea crossings were necessary even when sea levels were lower. Older dates remain debated. The northern Australian map point represents a broad settlement process, not a known first landing or a reconstructed migration route.

significance.zh: 呈现澳大利亚原住民历史的深远时间尺度及早期跨海适应能力。
significance.en: Places Aboriginal Australian history within a deep chronology of human mobility and environmental adaptation.

sources.title: aws-digital-classroom.nma.gov.au — Human settlement of Sahul

summary.zh: 日本列岛在冰期结束前后出现早期绳文陶器，随后发展出长期延续的狩猎、采集、渔捞社会与定居聚落。约前一万四千年只是文化分期的概略起点；地图点代表北日本遗址群，并非最早陶器唯一出土地。
summary.en: Early Jōmon pottery appeared in the Japanese archipelago around the end of the last ice age. Communities subsequently combined hunting, gathering and fishing with increasingly settled life. The approximate opening date is a period marker, and the northern Japanese location represents a wider archaeological landscape rather than one proven birthplace of pottery.

significance.zh: 说明复杂定居社会并非都以谷物农业或王朝国家为起点。
significance.en: Shows that durable settlements and elaborate material cultures did not depend exclusively on cereal agriculture or states.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Jōmon societies and pottery

title.zh: 蒙特韦尔德的人类居住证据

summary.zh: 智利蒙特韦尔德遗址保存约一万四千八百年前的木构、植物和生活遗存，为美洲早期人类居住提供重要证据。此处年代是遗址占居的近似值，不代表人类进入美洲的最初年份，也不能单独证明一条确定的迁徙路线。
summary.en: Monte Verde in southern Chile preserves evidence of human occupation about 14,800 years ago, including organic remains unusually well preserved in wet conditions. Its age challenged models that placed widespread settlement later. This point marks an archaeological locality, not the first arrival in the Americas or proof of one exclusive migration route.

significance.zh: 改变了讨论美洲早期定居年代和路线的证据基础。
significance.en: Helped reshape the evidence used to debate the timing and routes of settlement in the Americas.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Human occupation at Monte Verde

title.zh: 哥贝克力石阵的纪念性建造

summary.zh: 安纳托利亚东南部的群体在前陶新石器时代持续建造带有动物浮雕的巨石围圈。遗址显示大型仪式建筑与社会协作出现于农业转型过程中；时间范围代表多个建造阶段，不能理解为一场仪式或一个已知王国的存续期。
summary.en: Communities in southeastern Anatolia built enclosures with carved stone pillars during the Pre-Pottery Neolithic. Construction required coordinated labour and expressed shared symbolic practices during the transition toward farming. The dates cover successive phases of a particular site; they do not identify a single ceremony, a precisely dated founding event or the borders of a kingdom.

significance.zh: 为理解仪式活动、集体劳动与早期定居之间的关系提供关键材料。
significance.en: Provides evidence for the relationships among ritual, collective labour and early settled communities.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Monumental construction at Göbekli Tepe

title.zh: 梅赫尔格尔的早期农牧聚落

summary.zh: 俾路支地区的梅赫尔格尔在约前六千五百年出现早期农牧聚落，居民种植谷物、饲养家畜并发展手工业。这里展示印度河城市兴起之前漫长的社会变迁；该年份是考古分期的近似起点，不是南亚所有农业同时开始的日期。
summary.en: At Mehrgarh in present-day Balochistan, early communities practised farming, kept animals and developed craft production from approximately 6500 BCE. The settlement illuminates transformations long before the Indus cities. Its opening date is an archaeological approximation and should not be read as the simultaneous beginning of agriculture everywhere in South Asia.

significance.zh: 连接南亚早期农牧生活与后来的印度河城市化。
significance.en: Connects early South Asian farming communities with the much later growth of Indus urbanism.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Early farming at Mehrgarh

summary.zh: 新几内亚高地的库克遗址保存堆垄、沟渠和湿地改造痕迹，约六千五百年前已有较明确的农业发展证据。栽培过程比这个标记更长，亦包含更早的植物利用；这里的前四千五百年是近似换算，而非一次农业发明的精确年份。
summary.en: At Kuk in the New Guinea highlands, mounds, ditches and modified wetlands document a long history of cultivation. Evidence for a major agricultural transition dates to roughly 6,500 years ago, here rounded to 4500 BCE. Earlier plant use and later drainage developments belong to a continuing local process rather than a single invention.

significance.zh: 体现大洋洲独立农业发展及人类长期管理湿地的能力。
significance.en: Documents independent agricultural development in Oceania and sustained management of wetland environments.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Agricultural development at Kuk

summary.zh: 美索不达米亚的乌鲁克出现用于记录物资、数量和管理活动的泥板符号，逐渐形成更复杂的书写体系。日期覆盖早期书写的发展阶段；这些记录反映城市机构的组织需求，却不能把文字起源简化成某个人在某一年完成的发明。
summary.en: Administrative tablets at Uruk recorded quantities, goods and institutional activity through signs that developed into increasingly complex writing. The selected interval covers an early phase of this transformation. Writing answered practical demands of urban administration while eventually enabling other forms of knowledge; it cannot be assigned to one inventor or a single precise year.

significance.zh: 为远距离管理、法律记录和知识传承提供了新的工具。
significance.en: Created new tools for administration, durable records and the transmission of knowledge.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Early writing at Uruk

summary.zh: 太湖流域的良渚社会依托稻作农业建设城市、堤坝和大型土木工程，并以玉器和差异化墓葬表达礼仪与等级。此时间段对应考古文化与遗址的发展，不意味着每项工程同时存在，也不能将其直接等同于有明确疆界的后世王朝。
summary.en: Early rice-growing communities around Liangzhu built an urban centre, extensive earthworks and water-management facilities. Jade objects and differentiated burials indicate shared ritual practices and social hierarchy. The dates describe an archaeological development over many centuries, not simultaneous construction of every monument or the documented borders of a later-style dynastic state.

significance.zh: 表明长江下游也是中国早期复杂社会形成的重要区域。
significance.en: Establishes the lower Yangtze as a major centre in the development of early complex societies in China.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Liangzhu city and water management

summary.zh: 约前第三千纪之交，尼罗河谷的区域政权逐渐整合，王权以统治上下埃及的象征确立统一国家的理想。纳尔迈等早期统治者与这一进程相关，但统一并非有完整记录的单一战役；地图以阿拜多斯代表早期王权中心。
summary.en: Around the turn of the third millennium BCE, regional powers in the Nile valley were consolidated into an early Egyptian state. Royal imagery presented kings as rulers of Upper and Lower Egypt. Narmer is associated with this process, but unification cannot be reduced securely to one recorded battle. Abydos represents an early centre of kingship.

significance.zh: 奠定尼罗河流域王权、行政与纪念性建筑长期发展的基础。
significance.en: Laid foundations for enduring forms of kingship, administration and monumental construction along the Nile.

sources.title: egymonuments.gov.eg — Early unification of Egypt

title.zh: 卡拉尔—苏佩的城市发展

summary.zh: 秘鲁苏佩河谷的卡拉尔形成大型台基、下沉广场与居住区，显示能够组织持续劳动和仪式活动的复杂社会。它属于安第斯多个早期聚落构成的网络，发展跨越许多世纪；地图上的遗址点不应被当作整个文明唯一的起源中心。
summary.en: Caral in Peru’s Supe valley developed monumental platforms, sunken courts and residential areas within a network of early settlements. Its architecture indicates the capacity to organise sustained labour and shared ceremonies. The interval covers centuries of development, and the mapped site should not be mistaken for the sole origin of all Andean civilisation.

significance.zh: 展示美洲在欧洲接触数千年前独立发展的城市与组织传统。
significance.en: Demonstrates independently developing urban and organisational traditions in the Americas millennia before European contact.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Urban development at Caral-Supe

title.en: Mature urbanism in the Indus civilisation

summary.zh: 哈拉帕、摩亨佐达罗等城市形成规划街道、排水设施、标准化器物与广泛交换网络。城市间共享许多物质文化特征，但文字尚未得到可靠释读，政治组织仍有争论。地图以摩亨佐达罗代表区域性发展，不暗示存在已证实的单一帝国。
summary.en: Harappa, Mohenjo-daro and other Indus settlements developed planned streets, drainage systems, standardised objects and extensive exchange networks. Shared material practices connected cities, but their writing remains undeciphered and political organisation is debated. Mohenjo-daro represents this regional urban phase; the marker does not assert that all settlements belonged to a securely documented unified empire.

significance.zh: 揭示南亚早期城市公共设施、工艺标准与区域联系的高度发展。
significance.en: Highlights sophisticated urban infrastructure, craft standards and regional connections in early South Asia.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Mature urbanism in the Indus civilisation

summary.zh: 埃及第四王朝的统治者在吉萨组织修建大型金字塔及附属建筑，工程依赖石料运输、食物供应和劳动管理。这里用约略年代表示主要建造阶段，而不是断言所有建筑同年完成；遗址反映王权、宗教与社会资源动员的结合。
summary.en: Fourth Dynasty rulers organised the construction of large pyramids and associated complexes at Giza. Transporting stone, feeding workers and coordinating labour required substantial administrative capacity. The rounded dates represent principal construction phases, not completion of every structure at once. The site brings together royal authority, religious expectations and the mobilisation of social resources.

significance.zh: 成为理解古埃及国家组织与工程能力的重要物证。
significance.en: Provides major evidence for the organisational and engineering capacities of the ancient Egyptian state.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Construction of the Giza pyramids

title.en: Development of the kingdom of Kerma

summary.zh: 努比亚的克尔玛发展成拥有大型土砖建筑、墓地和区域联系的政治中心，与埃及既贸易也竞争。其历史展示尼罗河上游自身的国家形成过程，并非单纯的埃及附属史。时间范围是王国发展的概略分期，领土控制在期间不断变化。
summary.en: Kerma in Nubia developed into a political centre with monumental mud-brick buildings, extensive cemeteries and regional connections. Its rulers traded and competed with Egypt. The approximate interval represents a long development, during which power changed substantially, and highlights state formation in the upper Nile rather than treating Nubia only as an extension of Egyptian history.

significance.zh: 强调尼罗河上游社会在非洲古代政治与贸易中的主动作用。
significance.en: Emphasises upper Nile societies as active participants in ancient African politics and exchange.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Development of the kingdom of Kerma

summary.zh: 不列颠巨石阵在约前二千五百年形成重要的石构阶段，但遗址及周边景观经历了更早和更晚的使用。运输、排列巨石需要跨群体协作，建筑与太阳周期存在联系；其具体仪式含义仍无法像有文字记录的事件那样确定。
summary.en: A major stone-building phase at Stonehenge dates to approximately 2500 BCE, within a much longer history of activity in the surrounding landscape. Moving and arranging large stones required organised cooperation. Architectural relationships with the solar cycle are evident, although the monument’s precise ceremonial meanings remain less certain than events documented in written records.

significance.zh: 说明史前欧洲能够围绕仪式景观开展大规模协作。
significance.en: Shows the capacity of prehistoric European communities to organise substantial work around ceremonial landscapes.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Major stone-building phase at Stonehenge

summary.zh: 萨尔贡及其后继者把美索不达米亚多个城市纳入跨区域统治，通过军事行动、官员和地方关系维持权力。年代采用常见中年表，古代年表仍存在差异。阿卡德城址尚未确定，因此地图点仅代表美索不达米亚中部而非已知首都遗址。
summary.en: Sargon and his successors brought multiple Mesopotamian cities under a wider dynastic system, using military force, officials and local relationships. The dates follow a conventional middle chronology and remain subject to ancient chronological uncertainties. Because the location of Akkad itself is unknown, the marker represents central Mesopotamia rather than a securely identified capital.

significance.zh: 提供研究跨城市帝国统治及其脆弱性的早期案例。
significance.en: Offers an early case for examining both the reach and fragility of rule across multiple cities.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Expansion of the Akkadian dynasty

summary.zh: 巴比伦国王汉谟拉比晚期形成著名法碑，列举财产、家庭、劳动与伤害等案件的裁断。其规定体现不同社会身份的不平等，也表达王权主持公正的形象。地图标记巴比伦政治中心；石碑后来迁移，不能将发现地点与原始法律适用范围混同。
summary.en: The famous stele associated with Hammurabi’s late reign presents decisions concerning property, families, labour and injury. Its unequal treatment of different social ranks also supported a royal image of justice. Babylon is mapped as the political centre; the monument was moved in antiquity, so its later findspot must not be confused with its original legal setting.

significance.zh: 保存了古代法律思想、社会等级和王权宣传相互交织的记录。
significance.en: Preserves evidence of the intersection of legal reasoning, social hierarchy and royal representation.

sources.title: www.louvre.fr — The stele of Hammurabi

title.zh: 拉皮塔航海与远大洋洲定居

summary.zh: 制作拉皮塔陶器的群体及其后裔逐步向远大洋洲扩展，将航海、园艺和岛际交流结合起来。斐济、汤加与萨摩亚的定居发生于不同时间；地图以汤加为代表节点，整个区间表示长期过程，不是一条已被完整复原的迁徙航线。
summary.en: Communities associated with Lapita pottery and their descendants expanded into Remote Oceania through skilled voyaging, horticulture and inter-island exchange. Fiji, Tonga and Samoa were settled at different times. The marker represents Tonga within a broader process, and the long interval does not claim a single migration wave or a fully reconstructed sailing route.

significance.zh: 为后来的波利尼西亚社会与跨洋航海网络奠定基础。
significance.en: Helped establish the foundations of later Polynesian societies and oceanic networks.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Lapita voyaging into Remote Oceania

summary.zh: 安阳殷墟保存商王室以甲骨记录占卜的材料，内容涉及祭祀、战争、收成和王室活动。这些文字为研究早期中国政治与语言提供直接证据，但首先反映宫廷关注，并不能代表所有居民的日常声音；时间范围覆盖晚商阶段。
summary.en: Oracle bones from Anyang record divination concerning sacrifices, warfare, harvests and royal affairs during the late Shang period. Their inscriptions provide direct evidence for early Chinese writing and politics. They principally express court concerns, however, and cannot be taken as a complete account of ordinary people’s lives throughout the broader region.

significance.zh: 形成研究中国早期文字、国家与宗教实践的重要直接材料。
significance.en: Provides direct evidence for early Chinese writing, state activity and religious practice.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Shang oracle-bone records

title.zh: 东地中海青铜时代体系转变
title.en: Transformation of the Late Bronze Age eastern Mediterranean

summary.zh: 前十二世纪前后，东地中海多处宫殿中心遭毁弃，赫梯等政治体系瓦解，贸易与聚落格局发生重大变化。战争、人口流动、环境压力及内部问题的作用仍有争论；乌加里特只是代表地点，不能把所有地区的变化归于同一年或单一原因。
summary.en: Around the twelfth century BCE, several eastern Mediterranean palace centres were destroyed or abandoned, political systems broke apart and exchange networks changed. Warfare, population movement, environmental pressures and internal tensions remain debated explanations. Ugarit serves as a representative locality; neither the date range nor the marker implies one simultaneous collapse caused by a single factor.

significance.zh: 提醒读者区域性体系危机可能包含不同时间、不同原因与持续性。
significance.en: Shows how regional crises may combine different timings, causes and forms of continuity.

sources.title: gwtoday.gwu.edu — Transformation of the Late Bronze Age eastern Mediterranean

title.zh: 奥尔梅克中心与纪念性艺术

summary.zh: 墨西哥湾沿岸的圣洛伦索、拉文塔等中心在不同时期发展大型土木工程、巨石头像和区域交换。奥尔梅克影响遍及中美洲部分地区，但这些联系不等于统一帝国。地图以圣洛伦索代表长期且多中心的文化发展，年代边界为近似分期。
summary.en: Centres such as San Lorenzo and La Venta developed earthworks, colossal stone heads and exchange connections along Mexico’s Gulf coast at different times. Olmec influence extended into parts of Mesoamerica without demonstrating a single unified empire. San Lorenzo represents a long, multi-centred cultural development whose chronological boundaries are approximate archaeological conventions.

significance.zh: 展示中美洲早期政治组织、艺术与跨区域联系的形成。
significance.en: Illuminates early political organisation, artistic traditions and interregional connections in Mesoamerica.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Olmec centres and monumental art

title.zh: 腓尼基字母书写的传播

summary.zh: 地中海东岸的腓尼基社群使用并传播以辅音为主的字母书写，贸易和海上联系推动其被其他语言社群借用。后来希腊等体系进行了重要改造。比布鲁斯是代表地点，时间区间说明渐进传播，不能理解为字母文字在此被一次性发明。
summary.en: Phoenician communities used and spread a predominantly consonantal alphabet through eastern Mediterranean networks. Commercial and maritime connections helped other language communities adopt and modify it, including important later Greek adaptations. Byblos is a representative locality, and the interval describes gradual transmission rather than a claim that alphabetic writing was invented once at this location.

significance.zh: 促进更广泛的书写实践，并影响多种后来的文字体系。
significance.en: Contributed to wider writing practices and influenced numerous later scripts.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Spread of Phoenician alphabetic writing

title.en: Zhou conquest of Shang and the Mandate of Heaven

summary.zh: 周人在前十一世纪击败商，建立以王室与诸侯关系组织的统治，并以天命观念解释政权更替的正当性。前1046年是常用研究年表，具体年代仍与古史重建有关；地图以周原区域代表政治基础，并非精确标定牧野战场。
summary.en: The Zhou defeated the Shang in the eleventh century BCE and organised rule through relationships between the royal house and regional lords. The Mandate of Heaven helped justify dynastic replacement. The commonly used date of 1046 BCE belongs to a reconstructed chronology; the Zhou homeland is marked rather than an exact battlefield location.

significance.zh: 深刻影响后世中国对于统治责任、合法性和政权更替的理解。
significance.en: Influenced later Chinese thinking about political responsibility, legitimacy and dynastic change.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Zhou conquest of Shang and the Mandate of Heaven

summary.zh: 以纳帕塔地区为基地的库施统治者逐步控制埃及，形成第二十五王朝，并在尼罗河上下游开展建筑与宗教活动。其权力随后受到亚述扩张挑战。起始年代和实际控制范围并不完全一致，地图以杰贝尔巴卡尔代表库施王权中心。
summary.en: Kushite rulers based around Napata extended their authority into Egypt and formed the Twenty-fifth Dynasty, sponsoring religious and architectural projects along the Nile. Assyrian expansion later challenged their power. The opening date and the extent of effective control did not coincide everywhere; Gebel Barkal represents a centre of Kushite kingship rather than fixed imperial boundaries.

significance.zh: 呈现非洲东北部国家之间双向影响与竞争，而非单向文化传播。
significance.en: Highlights reciprocal influence and competition among northeastern African states.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Kushite rule in Egypt

summary.zh: 尼尼微在新亚述晚期成为王都，宫殿、城墙和泥板收藏体现帝国对资源与知识的集中。军事征服伴随人口强制迁移和严厉统治，也依赖复杂行政。前612年城市陷落标志帝国核心瓦解的重要阶段，但并非全部亚述政治活动的即时终结。
summary.en: Nineveh became a major royal capital in the late Neo-Assyrian period, concentrating palaces, fortifications and tablet collections. Imperial expansion relied on administration alongside warfare, coercion and forced population transfers. The city’s fall in 612 BCE marked a major breakdown of the imperial centre, rather than the instantaneous end of all Assyrian political activity.

significance.zh: 揭示早期帝国的行政知识与强制性统治如何共同运作。
significance.en: Reveals how administrative knowledge and coercive power operated together in an early empire.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Nineveh under the Neo-Assyrian Empire

title.zh: 孔子及儒家思想的早期发展
title.en: Confucius and the early Confucian tradition

summary.zh: 孔子在春秋末期围绕仁、礼、学习和政治责任开展教学，其思想由弟子及后来的学者整理发展。这里采用传统生卒年，曲阜代表其主要历史关联地点；不能把后世儒家所有学说都归于孔子本人，或认为其影响在生前已普及整个东亚。
summary.en: Confucius taught during the late Spring and Autumn period, discussing humane conduct, ritual, learning and political responsibility. Disciples and later scholars preserved and developed these ideas. The dates are traditional life dates, and Qufu represents a principal historical association; later Confucian doctrines and their East Asian influence should not all be projected back onto his lifetime.

significance.zh: 奠定了东亚长期讨论教育、伦理与政治秩序的重要思想资源。
significance.en: Provided lasting resources for East Asian debates about education, ethics and political order.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Confucius and the early Confucian tradition

summary.zh: 波斯国王居鲁士的军队占领巴比伦，将其纳入阿契美尼德帝国，并通过地方传统和行政安排巩固权力。相关铭文具有王权宣传性质，不能直接按现代人权宣言解读。此事件推动近东政治格局重组，也使多种法律和宗教传统在帝国内并存。
summary.en: Cyrus’s forces took Babylon in 539 BCE and incorporated it into the Achaemenid Empire. Local traditions and administrative arrangements helped consolidate the new regime. Royal inscriptions are also political representations and should not simply be equated with modern declarations of human rights. The conquest reshaped Near Eastern power while retaining substantial institutional and religious diversity.

significance.zh: 扩大了统合多地区、多传统的波斯帝国政治体系。
significance.en: Expanded a Persian imperial system that governed multiple regions and traditions.

sources.title: www.britishmuseum.org — Cyrus takes Babylon

summary.zh: 克里斯提尼改革重新组织雅典公民的部落与政治参与，推动城邦民主制度形成。参与资格主要属于成年男性公民，妇女、奴隶和外邦居民被排除。改革是持续政治斗争的一环，既扩大部分人的权力，也提醒人们区分古代公民制与现代普选。
summary.en: Cleisthenes reorganised Athenian tribes and political participation, helping establish institutions associated with democracy. Participation remained largely restricted to adult male citizens, excluding women, enslaved people and resident foreigners. These reforms formed part of continuing political conflict: they expanded power for some inhabitants without producing the universal political equality associated with modern democratic ideals.

significance.zh: 成为研究公民参与及其排除边界的重要历史案例。
significance.en: Offers a key historical case for studying civic participation and its exclusions.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Democratic reforms at Athens

title.zh: 佛陀的教导与早期佛教
title.en: The Buddha and early Buddhist communities

summary.zh: 释迦牟尼在恒河流域传播关于苦、修行和解脱的教导，追随者逐渐形成僧团与传承。其生卒年存在不同传统与学术估计，因此以约前五世纪代表活动时期。菩提伽耶是重要纪念地点，不表示全部教导都在此地同时形成。
summary.en: Siddhartha Gautama taught in the Ganges region about suffering, disciplined practice and liberation, while followers formed monastic and teaching communities. Traditions and scholarship differ on his life dates, so approximately 500 BCE marks a broad period of activity. Bodh Gaya is a major commemorative locality rather than the sole place where all teachings developed.

significance.zh: 开启后来广泛影响南亚、东亚与东南亚的宗教和思想传统。
significance.en: Began religious and intellectual traditions that later spread widely across South, East and Southeast Asia.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — The Buddha and early Buddhist communities

summary.zh: 今尼日利亚中部的诺克文化制作复杂的人物与动物陶塑，并与当地早期冶铁社会相关。这里选择前五世纪至公元二世纪作为代表性艺术阶段，不宣称这是整个文化的确切起止。许多器物缺乏完整出土背景，其原始用途与政治组织仍待研究。
summary.en: Communities associated with Nok culture in central Nigeria produced elaborate terracotta figures alongside early ironworking traditions. The interval selects a representative artistic phase rather than asserting exact boundaries for the whole culture. Many objects lack secure archaeological contexts, so their original functions and the political organisation of their makers remain subjects of investigation.

significance.zh: 展现撒哈拉以南非洲古代艺术与技术传统的深厚历史。
significance.en: Demonstrates the deep history of artistic and technological traditions in sub-Saharan Africa.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Nok terracotta traditions

summary.zh: 波斯帝国与多个希腊城邦在爱琴海地区发生战争，马拉松、萨拉米斯和普拉提亚等战斗影响地区力量关系。希腊城邦立场并不一致，战争也不是两个统一民族国家的对抗。雅典作为代表节点，不能表达各次远征与战役的全部地理范围。
summary.en: Wars between the Persian Empire and several Greek city-states included battles at Marathon, Salamis and Plataea. They changed Aegean power relationships, but Greek communities did not share one position and the conflict was not between two unified nation-states. Athens is a representative node rather than a marker for every campaign or battlefield.

significance.zh: 促进雅典势力上升，并留下影响深远但需要比较阅读的战争叙事。
significance.en: Contributed to Athens’s growing power and generated influential narratives that require comparative reading.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Greco-Persian Wars

title.en: State competition in the Warring States period

summary.zh: 战国诸国通过行政改革、征兵、农业开发和战争争夺优势，诸子学说也在这一环境中发展。这里以三家分晋获周王承认为分期起点之一，学界另有不同划分。地图点代表中原地区，不把持续变化的国家竞争压缩成一个事件或固定边界。
summary.en: Competing states pursued administrative reform, military mobilisation, agricultural expansion and conquest, while diverse philosophical traditions developed. This interval uses royal recognition of Jin’s partition as one conventional opening; other periodisations exist. The central plains marker represents a changing regional system, not one event or an assertion that political borders remained fixed throughout the period.

significance.zh: 推动后来统一帝国的制度形成，也孕育多种政治伦理方案。
significance.en: Helped shape imperial institutions while generating competing approaches to political and ethical life.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — State competition in the Warring States period

summary.zh: 亚历山大从小亚细亚进入近东，击败阿契美尼德王权，继续远征至中亚和南亚西北。征服带来暴力、城市建立与精英交流，其帝国在死后分裂。地图以高加米拉附近代表关键战区，不绘制未经逐段核实的行军路线。
summary.en: Alexander campaigned through Anatolia and the Near East, defeated the Achaemenid monarchy and advanced into Central Asia and northwestern South Asia. Conquest involved violence as well as new cities and elite exchange. His empire fragmented after his death. The area near Gaugamela represents a major theatre, not a separately verified reconstruction of his full marching route.

significance.zh: 改变近东权力格局，并扩展后来所谓希腊化世界的交流范围。
significance.en: Reshaped Near Eastern power and expanded connections within the later Hellenistic world.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Alexander’s campaigns into Asia

summary.zh: 旃陀罗笈多建立孔雀王朝，以恒河流域为重要基础逐步扩展统治，形成南亚规模很大的政治体系。约前322年是常用的建国年代，实际征服与行政整合持续更久。地图以华氏城代表政治中心，不把整个次大陆视作同质而完整的统治区。
summary.en: Chandragupta established the Mauryan dynasty and expanded from a major base in the Ganges region, building a large South Asian political system. Approximately 322 BCE is a conventional accession or foundation date, while conquest and integration continued much longer. Pataliputra marks the political centre without implying uniform, complete control over the entire subcontinent.

significance.zh: 成为南亚早期大规模国家组织及地区整合的重要案例。
significance.en: Provides an important example of early large-scale state organisation and regional integration in South Asia.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Rise of the Mauryan dynasty

summary.zh: 麦罗埃成为库施王权、宗教与生产活动的重要中心，留下金字塔、神庙、文字和冶铁遗存。其联系延伸至尼罗河与红海网络，体现非洲东北部的地方发展。区间表示代表性的政治文化阶段，并不确定首都迁移或王国衰落发生于单一年度。
summary.en: Meroe became a major centre of Kushite kingship, religious life and production, leaving pyramids, temples, writing and evidence of ironworking. Connections extended through Nile and Red Sea networks. The interval represents a broad political and cultural phase rather than a precisely dated transfer of the capital or one instantaneous collapse of the kingdom.

significance.zh: 展示具有自身文字与政治传统的非洲古代国家。
significance.en: Highlights an ancient African state with its own written and political traditions.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — The Kushite kingdom at Meroe

title.zh: 阿育王的羯陵伽战争与法敕

summary.zh: 阿育王征服羯陵伽后，在法敕中表达对战争苦难的悔意，并推广有关道德行为、宗教尊重和公共责任的主张。刻石为研究王权提供重要材料，也带有自我塑造的性质。年代采用近似年表，地图以羯陵伽地区的陀利为代表节点。
summary.en: After conquering Kalinga, Ashoka’s edicts expressed remorse for suffering and promoted ethical conduct, religious respect and public responsibilities. These inscriptions are major evidence for royal policy but also present a carefully fashioned image of kingship. The dates are approximate, and Dhauli represents a Kalinga locality rather than the entire reach of the edict network.

significance.zh: 将帝国统治、战争反思与伦理传播联系起来，并支持佛教扩展。
significance.en: Connected imperial government with reflection on warfare and ethical communication, while supporting Buddhism’s expansion.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Ashoka’s Kalinga war and edicts

summary.zh: 秦灭六国后，秦王采用皇帝称号，在更广区域推进郡县行政、文字规范和度量衡标准。统一伴随战争、徭役与严厉刑罚，地方整合也并非一夜完成。咸阳代表政治中心，此年标记王朝统一的重要节点，而非所有制度从零诞生。
summary.en: After defeating rival states, the Qin ruler adopted the imperial title and extended territorial administration and standards for writing, weights and measures. Unification also involved warfare, compulsory labour and harsh punishment; local integration was gradual. Xianyang represents the political centre, and 221 BCE marks a major consolidation rather than the invention of every imperial institution.

significance.zh: 确立后来中国王朝反复继承与调整的统一帝国框架。
significance.en: Established an imperial framework repeatedly inherited and modified by later Chinese dynasties.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Qin unification and imperial institutions

summary.zh: 罗马与迦太基围绕西地中海霸权展开战争，汉尼拔进入意大利，罗马则在伊比利亚与北非作战。罗马获胜后优势显著扩大，但双方社会均付出严重代价。地图以迦太基标示对抗的一端，战争跨越多地，绝非只发生在这一城市。
summary.en: Rome and Carthage fought for power across the western Mediterranean. Hannibal campaigned in Italy while Roman forces operated in Iberia and North Africa. Roman victory greatly expanded its advantage, but both societies suffered severe losses. Carthage marks one pole of the conflict rather than the location of all its campaigns and battles.

significance.zh: 推动罗马成为地中海西部的主导力量。
significance.en: Helped establish Rome as the dominant power in the western Mediterranean.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Second Punic War

summary.zh: 刘邦在秦亡后的战争中获胜，建立汉王朝，逐步结合皇帝直辖郡县与封国安排。汉继承并调整秦的行政制度，减轻部分早期统治压力，但地方权力问题长期存在。长安代表后来的西汉首都，此年不意味着帝国边界和制度已经完全定型。
summary.en: Liu Bang emerged victorious from wars following the Qin collapse and founded the Han dynasty. Its government combined directly administered territories with kingdoms and revised inherited Qin institutions. Regional power remained contested. Chang’an represents the Western Han capital, while the foundation date should not imply that imperial institutions or territorial limits were already complete.

significance.zh: 开启影响中国政治制度与文化认同的长期王朝传统。
significance.en: Began a long-lasting dynasty influential in Chinese political institutions and cultural identity.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Foundation of the Han dynasty

title.zh: 纳斯卡地画与沙漠社会

summary.zh: 秘鲁南部沙漠社会在地表制作线条、几何图案与动物形象，并通过仪式和环境管理维持生活。地画跨越多个时期，具体用途不能归于一个已证实的解释。这里的范围代表重要发展阶段，地图点表示遗产区而不是所有图形的共同中心。
summary.en: Communities in southern Peru created lines, geometric designs and animal figures across the desert landscape. These works developed over different periods and were associated with social and ceremonial practices in an arid environment. Their purposes remain debated. The interval selects a major phase, while the marker represents an extensive landscape rather than one central drawing.

significance.zh: 呈现安第斯社会将景观、仪式与生活环境联系起来的独特方式。
significance.en: Shows distinctive Andean relationships among landscape, ritual and life in an arid environment.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Nazca geoglyphs and desert societies

title.en: Zhang Qian’s missions and Eurasian connections

summary.zh: 张骞奉汉廷之命西行，最初目的包括寻求对抗匈奴的伙伴，历经拘留后带回中亚政治与物产信息。既有欧亚交换早于其出使，因此不能说他独自开创丝绸之路。长安标记使团出发的政治中心，区间表示首次出使的历程。
summary.en: Zhang Qian travelled west on a Han mission partly intended to seek partners against the Xiongnu. After lengthy detention, he returned with information about Central Asian societies and products. Eurasian exchange predated his journey, so he did not single-handedly create the Silk Roads. Chang’an marks the mission’s political point of departure.

significance.zh: 扩大汉廷对中亚的知识，并推动后续外交与贸易联系。
significance.en: Expanded Han knowledge of Central Asia and encouraged later diplomatic and commercial connections.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Zhang Qian’s missions and Eurasian connections

title.zh: 奥古斯都与罗马元首制

summary.zh: 屋大维获得奥古斯都称号，在保留共和国机构形式的同时集中军事与政治权力。罗马由内战走向长期的帝国统治结构，但权力调整经过多个阶段。前27年是重要制度象征，不意味着所有居民得到和平或所有共和传统当日消失。
summary.en: Octavian received the title Augustus while concentrating military and political authority behind continuing republican institutions. Rome moved from civil wars toward durable imperial rule, but arrangements developed through several settlements. The year 27 BCE is an important institutional marker, not the day every republican practice disappeared or peace reached every inhabitant of the empire.

significance.zh: 形成后来罗马皇帝统治的重要政治模式。
significance.en: Established an influential political model for subsequent Roman emperors.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Augustus and the Roman Principate

summary.zh: 红海、阿拉伯海和南亚港口的商人利用季风组织航行，交换香料、纺织品、金属与其他货物。港口社会连接罗马世界、非洲和亚洲，网络也包含多种地方中介。古塞尔代表红海一端，此区间不是贸易起源的时间，更不是一条单向航路。
summary.en: Merchants organised voyages using monsoon winds between Red Sea, Arabian Sea and South Asian ports, exchanging spices, textiles, metals and other goods. Networks linked Roman territories, Africa and Asia through many local intermediaries. Quseir represents a Red Sea node. The interval does not identify the origin of oceanic trade or a single one-way route.

significance.zh: 把世界史中的商业联系放在多中心、跨海洋的框架中理解。
significance.en: Places commerce within a multi-centred history of connections across the ocean.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Indian Ocean monsoon trading networks

title.zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎的都市繁荣

summary.zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎在墨西哥盆地发展为大型城市，拥有纪念性建筑、住宅区和跨区域影响。居民来源与文化多样，城市的政治组织仍有许多未知。公元一至六世纪是概略繁荣阶段，不能将其后来名称或阿兹特克传说直接当作建城者自己的叙述。
summary.en: Teotihuacan grew into a large city in the Basin of Mexico, with monumental buildings, residential compounds and far-reaching influence. Its inhabitants were diverse and aspects of its government remain uncertain. The first through sixth centuries mark a broad flourishing phase; later names and Aztec traditions should not be treated automatically as the founders’ own accounts.

significance.zh: 展示美洲古代城市规模、多元人口与区域互动。
significance.en: Demonstrates the scale, population diversity and regional interactions of ancient American cities.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Urban flourishing at Teotihuacan

title.zh: 耶稣活动与基督教起源
title.en: Jesus and the origins of Christianity

summary.zh: 耶稣在罗马统治下的犹太地区传道，并在本丢彼拉多任内被处决；其追随者围绕复活信仰逐步形成基督教社群。具体年份通常估计在公元30年前后，存在分歧。耶路撒冷代表关键地点，信仰陈述与可研究的历史过程在这里保持区分。
summary.en: Jesus taught in Roman-ruled Judaea and was executed under Pontius Pilate. Followers subsequently formed communities centred on belief in his resurrection. The precise year is debated and is represented approximately as 30 CE. Jerusalem marks a central locality, while statements of religious belief are distinguished from the historical development of communities and institutions.

significance.zh: 起源于地方性宗教运动的传统后来影响多个大陆的社会与政治。
significance.en: A locally rooted religious movement later influenced societies and politics across several continents.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Jesus and the origins of Christianity

summary.zh: 征侧与征贰领导今越南北部地区反抗汉朝统治，一度建立自主权力，随后被汉军镇压。事件发生于古代地方社会与帝国扩张的背景中，其后成为越南历史记忆的重要象征。地图代表红河三角洲，避免用现代国界直接界定当时政治共同体。
summary.en: Trưng Trắc and Trưng Nhị led an uprising against Han rule in the region of present-day northern Vietnam, briefly establishing independent authority before defeat. The conflict arose within ancient local societies and imperial expansion and later became central to Vietnamese historical memory. The Red River delta marker does not impose modern national boundaries on those communities.

significance.zh: 突显地方反抗、女性领导与后世历史记忆之间的关系。
significance.en: Highlights relationships among local resistance, women’s leadership and later historical memory.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — The Trưng sisters’ uprising

summary.zh: 维苏威火山的喷发掩埋庞贝、赫库兰尼姆等聚落，造成大量死亡并保存建筑、物品及生活痕迹。事件年份明确，但具体日期仍有讨论，因此地图不设精确日月。遗址为研究罗马社会提供丰富材料，却只是区域生活的部分截面。
summary.en: Vesuvius buried Pompeii, Herculaneum and nearby settlements in 79 CE, killing inhabitants while preserving buildings, objects and traces of daily life. The year is secure, but the precise calendar date remains debated and is not specified here. These exceptional remains offer rich evidence without representing every aspect of society across the Roman world.

significance.zh: 成为灾害史与罗马日常生活研究的重要考古档案。
significance.en: Created a major archaeological record for studying disasters and everyday Roman life.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Eruption of Mount Vesuvius

title.zh: 贵霜时代的跨区域交流

summary.zh: 贵霜统治者连接中亚与南亚西北，钱币、城市和宗教艺术体现多种传统的交汇。佛教造像与商贸往来在这一时期发展，但不应归结为单一文化向另一文化的传授。白沙瓦代表一个重要政治文化节点，区间为宽泛阶段而非精确王朝起止。
summary.en: Kushan rulers connected Central Asia with northwestern South Asia. Coins, urban centres and religious art reflect interactions among several traditions, while Buddhist imagery and commerce developed through overlapping networks. Peshawar represents an important political and cultural node. The interval selects a broad phase rather than exact dynastic boundaries or a single direction of cultural transmission.

significance.zh: 展示欧亚交往通过地方选择与创新产生新的文化形式。
significance.en: Shows how local choices and innovations created new cultural forms within Eurasian exchange.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Cross-regional exchange under the Kushans

title.zh: 莫切社会的灌溉与艺术

summary.zh: 秘鲁北部海岸的莫切社会建设灌溉设施与大型土砖建筑，留下精细陶器、金属工艺和有关仪式暴力的证据。各河谷政治关系随时间变化，不能假定始终存在一个统一帝国。地图以莫切河谷代表多中心的发展，分期边界为近似年代。
summary.en: Moche societies on Peru’s north coast developed irrigation, monumental adobe construction, elaborate pottery and metalworking. Archaeology also documents ritual violence and pronounced social distinctions. Political relationships among valleys changed, so a continuously unified empire should not be assumed. The Moche valley represents a multi-centred development with approximate chronological boundaries rather than a single political event.

significance.zh: 揭示干旱海岸环境中农业管理、权力与艺术生产的联系。
significance.en: Illuminates connections among agricultural management, power and artistic production on an arid coast.

sources.title: peabody.harvard.edu — Moche irrigation and artistic traditions
The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Moche Decorated Ceramics

title.zh: 蔡伦与造纸技术的改进
title.en: Cai Lun and improvements in papermaking

summary.zh: 传统史料记载蔡伦于105年向汉廷报告改进的造纸方法，使用树皮、麻及破旧织物等材料。考古发现表明纸在此之前已经存在，因此这一标记应理解为改进和推广的重要记录，而非纸的绝对发明日。洛阳代表当时宫廷所在地区。
summary.en: Traditional historical accounts associate 105 CE with Cai Lun’s report to the Han court on improved papermaking using materials including bark, hemp and old textiles. Archaeological paper predates this report, so the marker concerns an influential improvement and its recognition rather than an absolute invention date. Luoyang represents the court’s location.

significance.zh: 有助于书写材料逐渐普及，但其全球传播经历了漫长过程。
significance.en: Contributed to the wider use of writing materials, whose global diffusion took many centuries.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Cai Lun and improvements in papermaking

summary.zh: 二世纪后期罗马帝国出现广泛疫病，文献记录严重死亡与军队、城市的冲击。现代学者常讨论天花等可能病原，但不能把回溯诊断当作已确定事实，死亡总数也不可靠。罗马只是代表节点，区间表示主要流行阶段而非全部地区同时受灾。
summary.en: A major epidemic affected the Roman Empire in the later second century, with texts describing severe mortality and disruption to armies and cities. Smallpox is among proposed retrospective diagnoses, but the pathogen and total deaths are not securely established. Rome represents the wider crisis, and the interval does not imply simultaneous outbreaks everywhere.

significance.zh: 展示帝国交通网络、战争与传染病风险之间的联系。
significance.en: Illustrates relationships among imperial connectivity, warfare and epidemic risk.

sources.title: www.getty.edu — The Antonine epidemic

title.zh: 玛雅古典时期的城市网络

summary.zh: 玛雅地区的众多王国建设城市和碑铭，发展历法、书写与王朝历史记录，同时进行贸易、结盟和战争。不同地区的兴衰时间并不相同，九世纪部分城市衰落也不意味着玛雅人民消失。蒂卡尔作为代表地点，不能被视为统一玛雅帝国的首都。
summary.en: Numerous Maya kingdoms built cities and inscribed monuments, developed calendrical and writing practices, and recorded dynastic histories while trading, allying and fighting. Regional trajectories differed, and the decline of some cities in the ninth century did not mean Maya peoples disappeared. Tikal represents this network, not the capital of a single Maya empire.

significance.zh: 让文字、考古与仍然延续的玛雅社会共同进入美洲历史叙述。
significance.en: Connects written and archaeological evidence with the continuing history of Maya peoples.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Classic Maya urban networks

title.zh: 罗马帝国的宗教宽容安排
title.en: Religious toleration in the Roman Empire

summary.zh: 君士坦丁与李锡尼达成通常称为米兰敕令的宗教宽容安排，保障基督徒等群体的礼拜并归还被没收财产。基督教此时并未立即成为唯一国教，后续政策仍反复。米兰标记政治协商地点，具体实施通过其他地区的文书与行政展开。
summary.en: Constantine and Licinius agreed on arrangements commonly called the Edict of Milan, supporting religious worship and restoration of confiscated Christian property. Christianity did not instantly become the empire’s exclusive official religion, and later policies changed. Milan marks the political agreement, while implementation depended on documents and administration in other imperial regions.

significance.zh: 改变基督教社群与罗马统治者之间的制度关系。
significance.en: Changed the institutional relationship between Christian communities and Roman rulers.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Religious toleration in the Roman Empire

title.zh: 笈多王朝与古典文化发展
title.en: The Gupta dynasty and classical cultural development

summary.zh: 笈多统治者在南亚北部扩展权力，梵文文学、宗教艺术与数学天文学获得发展。常见的黄金时代称呼不能抹去地区差异、战争和社会等级。华氏城仅为代表节点，区间描述较广的政治文化阶段，不表示整个南亚始终由笈多王朝统一治理。
summary.en: Gupta rulers expanded power in northern South Asia during a period of notable developments in Sanskrit literature, religious art, mathematics and astronomy. The familiar label “golden age” should not erase regional differences, warfare or social hierarchy. Pataliputra represents a broader political and cultural phase, not continuous Gupta control over the whole subcontinent.

significance.zh: 帮助理解南亚经典学术与艺术传统在具体政治社会条件下的发展。
significance.en: Places influential South Asian scholarly and artistic traditions in their political and social settings.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — The Gupta dynasty and classical cultural development

title.zh: 阿克苏姆王权采用基督教
title.en: Royal adoption of Christianity at Aksum

summary.zh: 四世纪阿克苏姆王室在埃扎纳统治时期采用基督教，钱币与铭文留下宗教变化的线索。这一转变发生在非洲东北部与红海交流网络中，并非居民信仰在某年整齐更换。约340年仅为世纪内的显示锚点，精确改宗年代仍不完全确定。
summary.en: During Ezana’s reign in the fourth century, Aksumite royalty adopted Christianity, with coins and inscriptions reflecting religious change. The transformation belonged to northeastern African and Red Sea networks and did not mean every inhabitant converted simultaneously. Approximately 340 CE is a display anchor within the century, not a securely established exact conversion date.

significance.zh: 奠定埃塞俄比亚及厄立特里亚地区长期基督教传统的重要基础。
significance.en: Helped establish enduring Christian traditions in the Ethiopian and Eritrean region.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Royal adoption of Christianity at Aksum

title.zh: 那烂陀的学术寺院发展
title.en: Development of the monastic learning centre at Nalanda

summary.zh: 那烂陀从五世纪起发展为重要的佛教寺院与学术中心，吸引来自南亚及更远地区的求学者，开展辩论、文本研究和知识传承。其建筑与组织经历长期变化；这里标记主要繁荣过程，不采用一个无法确定的精确创校或单一毁灭日期。
summary.en: From the fifth century, Nalanda developed into a major Buddhist monastic and scholarly centre, attracting students from South Asia and beyond. Debate, textual study and transmission of knowledge took place within institutions that changed over time. The interval marks a broad flourishing process rather than an exactly known foundation or one exclusive moment of destruction.

significance.zh: 展示前现代亚洲跨地区求学与知识交流的制度基础。
significance.en: Shows institutional foundations for long-distance learning and intellectual exchange in premodern Asia.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Development of the monastic learning centre at Nalanda

title.en: Deposition of the western Roman emperor

summary.zh: 奥多亚塞在意大利废黜罗慕路斯·奥古斯都，此事常用作西罗马帝国终结的象征。实际上罗马制度、地方精英与东部帝国仍然存在，西部权力重组已持续很久。拉文纳标记政治中心，476年是方便的分期节点，而非整个古代世界突然结束。
summary.en: Odoacer deposed Romulus Augustulus in Italy, an event often used to mark the end of the Western Roman Empire. Roman institutions, local elites and the eastern empire continued, while western political transformation had already lasted generations. Ravenna marks the political centre; 476 is a useful conventional boundary, not the sudden end of antiquity everywhere.

significance.zh: 提醒历史分期应与制度延续和区域差异一起理解。
significance.en: Encourages periodisation to be read alongside institutional continuity and regional differences.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Deposition of the western Roman emperor

title.zh: 阿耶波多的数学天文学著作

summary.zh: 阿耶波多于499年写成《阿耶波多历数书》，以数学方法讨论计算、三角关系与天体运动，并提出地球自转解释日周运动。其宇宙模型不能简单等同于现代天文学。地图用华氏城附近作为学术关联地点，不声称现已确定写作房舍。
summary.en: Aryabhata composed the Aryabhatiya in 499, treating computation, trigonometric relationships and celestial motions mathematically. His account used Earth’s rotation to explain apparent daily motion, although his astronomical system was not identical to modern astronomy. The location near Pataliputra represents a scholarly association rather than a securely identified building where the work was written.

significance.zh: 体现南亚数学与天文学相互推动，并影响后来的跨语言学术传播。
significance.en: Demonstrates interaction between mathematics and astronomy in South Asia and later scholarly transmission.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Aryabhata’s mathematical astronomy

summary.zh: 尼日尔河内陆三角洲的杰内—杰诺由更早聚落成长为重要城市，与周边聚落通过渔业、农业、手工业和交换相联系。该阶段早于当地全面伊斯兰化，展示西非自身的城市发展。时间范围选择明显扩展期，不等于遗址最初有人居住或最终废弃的年代。
summary.en: Jenne-jeno grew from an older settlement into a significant urban centre in the Inland Niger Delta, linked with surrounding communities through fishing, farming, crafts and exchange. This phase preceded widespread local Islamisation and demonstrates indigenous West African urban development. The interval selects a period of substantial growth rather than the site’s first occupation or eventual abandonment.

significance.zh: 纠正把西非城市生活完全归因于外来贸易者的单向叙述。
significance.en: Demonstrates the local foundations of West African urban life and exchange.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Urban networks at Jenne-jeno

title.zh: 蒂瓦纳库的高原政治中心
title.en: Tiwanaku as an Andean highland centre

summary.zh: 的的喀喀湖附近的蒂瓦纳库在五至九世纪达到繁荣阶段，纪念性建筑、宗教图像与农业技术支撑跨区域影响。其权力通过多种地方关系实现，不能由一张整齐边界图完全表示。日期描述高峰阶段，并非该社会从产生到终结的全部历史。
summary.en: Near Lake Titicaca, Tiwanaku flourished between the fifth and ninth centuries, combining monumental architecture, religious imagery and agricultural technologies with regional influence. Authority operated through varied local relationships that cannot be fully represented by a neat boundary polygon. The dates describe an apogee rather than the entire history of the society’s emergence and decline.

significance.zh: 展示印加之前安第斯高原复杂社会与环境适应的成就。
significance.en: Highlights complex highland societies and environmental adaptation in the Andes before the Inca.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Tiwanaku as an Andean highland centre

summary.zh: 六世纪中叶鼠疫在东地中海及其他地区传播，君士坦丁堡于542年遭受严重疫情，此后仍有反复。古病原研究支持鼠疫病原的存在，但各地死亡比例和长期经济影响仍有争论。地图点代表帝国首都，区间仅覆盖第一轮主要冲击。
summary.en: Plague spread through the eastern Mediterranean and other regions in the mid-sixth century, striking Constantinople severely in 542 and recurring later. Ancient pathogen research supports the presence of plague bacteria, while local mortality and long-term economic effects remain debated. The capital represents the wider outbreak, and the interval covers only its initial major phase.

significance.zh: 连接传染病、城市生活、帝国交通与历史证据不确定性的讨论。
significance.en: Connects epidemic disease with urban life, imperial transport and uncertainty in historical evidence.

sources.title: www.mpg.de — Plague during Justinian’s reign
Mordechai et al., PNAS — The Justinianic Plague: An inconsequential pandemic? (2019)

summary.zh: 隋军攻灭陈朝，使中国南北长期分立后的主要政治区域重新归于一个王朝。统一继承了此前数百年的迁徙、制度变化与经济发展，也伴随战争和后续征发。南京代表陈都所在地区，此年标记政权更替，不能抹去地方差异与边疆多样性。
summary.en: Sui forces defeated the Chen dynasty in 589, reunifying major northern and southern political regions after a long period of division. This outcome built on centuries of migration, institutional change and economic development and involved warfare and later mobilisation. Nanjing represents the defeated southern capital, without implying that local differences or frontier diversity vanished.

significance.zh: 为隋唐时期更广泛的行政整合与南北交流创造条件。
significance.en: Created conditions for wider administrative integration and north-south exchange under the Sui and Tang.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Reunification under the Sui

title.en: Expansion of the Grand Canal under the Sui

summary.zh: 隋朝在已有水道基础上开凿和连接运河，使南方粮食产区与北方政治军事中心联系更紧密。工程促进运输，也给被征发劳动者造成沉重负担。洛阳代表枢纽地区，区间只覆盖隋代的重要建设阶段，不能当作整条大运河从无到有的唯一施工期。
summary.en: The Sui expanded and connected existing waterways, linking southern grain-producing regions more closely with northern political and military centres. Transport improved, but compulsory labour imposed heavy burdens. Luoyang represents a major hub. The interval covers important Sui works rather than the entire canal’s construction, which involved many earlier and later phases across a very extensive network.

significance.zh: 深刻改变粮食运输、国家财政与中国南北经济联系。
significance.en: Reshaped grain transport, state finance and economic connections between northern and southern China.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Expansion of the Grand Canal under the Sui

title.zh: 唐朝建立与长安的交流网络
title.en: Foundation of the Tang and Chang’an’s networks

summary.zh: 李渊建立唐朝，随后通过战争逐步整合隋末分裂的政治区域。长安成为外交、宗教和商贸往来的重要城市，吸纳多种人群与文化。建国年份仅标记王朝起点，唐的繁荣与对外联系是在之后不同阶段形成，不能被压缩到618年一刻。
summary.en: Li Yuan founded the Tang dynasty in 618, followed by campaigns to consolidate territories fragmented during the Sui collapse. Chang’an became a major setting for diplomacy, religion and commerce involving diverse communities. The foundation year marks a dynastic beginning; the dynasty’s cosmopolitan urban life and wider networks developed over subsequent stages rather than appearing instantaneously.

significance.zh: 为中古东亚政治制度与跨地区文化交流提供重要中心。
significance.en: Provided a major centre for medieval East Asian institutions and cross-regional cultural exchange.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Foundation of the Tang and Chang’an’s networks

title.zh: 希吉拉：穆罕默德迁徙麦地那

summary.zh: 穆罕默德及追随者从麦加迁往麦地那，在新的社会关系中建立宗教与政治共同体。后来的伊斯兰历以这一迁徙发生之年为纪元。地图标记目的地而非精确路线；此事件并非伊斯兰信仰第一次出现，却是社群组织和领导关系发展的关键节点。
summary.en: Muhammad and his followers moved from Mecca to Medina, establishing new religious and political relationships within the receiving community. The later Islamic calendar used the year of this migration as its epoch. Medina marks the destination rather than a precisely reconstructed route; the event was a major institutional turning point, not the first appearance of Islamic belief.

significance.zh: 成为伊斯兰社群历史与历法记忆的核心参照。
significance.en: Became a central reference in Islamic communal history and calendrical memory.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — The Hijra to Medina

title.zh: 婆罗摩笈多论零与负数
title.en: Brahmagupta on zero and negative numbers

summary.zh: 婆罗摩笈多在《婆罗摩修正体系》中讨论零、负数、方程与天文计算，并为多种运算给出规则。其关于除零等处理并不等同于现代定义，不能只用发明零的口号概括。宾马尔是文本自述的写作城市，地图点代表城市而非确定建筑。
summary.en: In the Brahmasphutasiddhanta, Brahmagupta discussed zero, negative numbers, equations and astronomical computation, setting out rules for several operations. His treatment of matters such as division by zero differed from modern definitions, so the work is more complex than a slogan about inventing zero. Bhinmal represents the city named in the text as its place of composition.

significance.zh: 推进把零与负数纳入计算规则的系统性讨论。
significance.en: Advanced systematic treatment of zero and negative numbers within computational rules.

sources.title: University of St Andrews — MacTutor: Brahmagupta

title.zh: 早期哈里发国家的扩张

summary.zh: 早期哈里发统治者的军队在近东、北非和更远地区扩张，建立新的税收与行政体系，同时继承许多地方制度。军事征服与居民逐渐接受伊斯兰教是不同速度的过程。大马士革代表倭马亚时期中心，区间不表示一组固定边界持续存在。
summary.en: Early caliphal armies expanded through the Near East, North Africa and beyond, developing taxation and administration while retaining many local institutions. Political conquest and the gradual adoption of Islam by inhabitants proceeded at different speeds. Damascus represents an Umayyad centre, and the interval should not be read as one set of borders lasting unchanged.

significance.zh: 重组跨区域政治秩序，并为新的语言、宗教与商业联系创造条件。
significance.en: Reorganised regional power and created conditions for new linguistic, religious and commercial connections.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Expansion of the early caliphates

title.zh: 新罗扩展在朝鲜半岛的统治
title.en: Silla’s expansion on the Korean peninsula

summary.zh: 新罗先与唐联合击败高句丽，随后与唐争夺控制权，逐步统治朝鲜半岛大部分地区。北方仍有不同政治力量，后来的渤海也继承高句丽部分传统，因此统一新罗不等于现代韩国与朝鲜疆界被完全统一。庆州标记新罗的政治文化中心。
summary.en: Silla first allied with Tang forces against Goguryeo, then contested Tang control and came to govern much of the Korean peninsula. Other powers remained in the north, and Balhae later inherited parts of Goguryeo’s legacy. Gyeongju marks Silla’s centre; “Unified Silla” should not be equated mechanically with the complete territory of modern Korean states.

significance.zh: 构成半岛政治整合与持续南北多元格局的重要阶段。
significance.en: Marks a major phase of peninsula-wide integration alongside continuing northern political diversity.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Silla’s expansion on the Korean peninsula

title.zh: 室利佛逝的海上与佛教网络

summary.zh: 七世纪义净的旅行记录和随后碑铭显示，苏门答腊的室利佛逝是海上交通与佛教学术的重要节点。其权力依靠港口、地方关系和航道联系，并非现代连续疆界的国家。671年取自到访记录而非建国证书，1025年则标记朱罗袭击这一转折。
summary.en: Yijing’s seventh-century account and subsequent inscriptions identify Srivijaya in Sumatra as a major node of maritime travel and Buddhist learning. Power depended on ports, local relationships and shipping connections rather than a modern continuous territory. The opening year records a visit, not a foundation charter; 1025 marks the turning point of Chola attacks.

significance.zh: 突出东南亚社会在亚洲海洋贸易与知识传播中的主动作用。
significance.en: Highlights Southeast Asian agency in maritime commerce and the circulation of knowledge.

sources.title: University of Missouri Museum of Art and Archaeology — Muse 22

title.zh: 平城京与奈良时代都城

summary.zh: 日本朝廷迁至平城京，以规划都城、宫廷行政与佛教寺院建设表达国家秩序。制度吸收来自东亚大陆的经验，也由本地社会选择和改造。710年标记迁都，随后城市与宗教机构继续发展；地图点指都城区域，不代表全国变化同步完成。
summary.en: The Japanese court moved to Heijō-kyō, where urban planning, court administration and Buddhist institutions expressed a developing state order. Continental East Asian models were selectively adapted within local conditions. The year marks the transfer of the capital; construction and institutional change continued afterwards, and developments elsewhere in the archipelago did not proceed identically.

significance.zh: 展示中古东亚制度传播与地方重构相结合的过程。
significance.en: Shows medieval East Asian institutional exchange as a process of transmission and local reconstruction.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Heijō-kyō and the Nara capital

summary.zh: 阿拔斯运动推翻倭马亚核心统治，建立新的哈里发王朝，其政治支持来自多个地区与群体。王朝更替改变精英关系与权力重心，但并未消除帝国内部冲突，也未控制所有穆斯林地区。库法代表早期权力活动，而非后来才建设的巴格达。
summary.en: The Abbasid movement overthrew the central Umayyad regime and established a new caliphal dynasty supported by varied regional constituencies. The change reshaped elite relationships and centres of power without ending internal conflict or unifying all Muslim territories. Kufa represents an early political setting rather than Baghdad, which was founded later.

significance.zh: 开启以伊拉克为重要中心的哈里发政治与文化阶段。
significance.en: Opened a caliphal era in which Iraq became a major political and cultural centre.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — The Abbasid Revolution

summary.zh: 安禄山起兵后攻入唐朝核心地区，战争持续多年并造成大规模破坏、迁徙和财政压力。唐朝延续下来，但中央与地方军事力量、税收方式和人口分布发生长期变化。洛阳代表关键战区，户籍损失不能直接当作战死人口的精确统计。
summary.en: An Lushan’s rebellion spread into the Tang heartland and produced years of warfare, displacement and fiscal pressure. The dynasty survived, but military authority, taxation and population patterns changed over the longer term. Luoyang represents a major theatre. Changes in registered population must not be treated as an exact count of people killed in the conflict.

significance.zh: 成为理解唐朝中后期政治财政转型的重要转折。
significance.en: Was a major turning point in the political and fiscal transformation of the later Tang.

sources.title: www.iranicaonline.org — The An Lushan Rebellion

summary.zh: 哈里发曼苏尔在底格里斯河附近建设新都巴格达，借助河流交通与既有城市网络组织帝国权力。城市后来成为贸易、翻译、数学和哲学的重要中心，但这些成就是此后长期累积的结果。建城标记不把复杂学术活动归于一个机构或单一年度。
summary.en: Caliph al-Mansur founded Baghdad near the Tigris, drawing on river transport and established urban networks to organise imperial power. The city later became a major setting for commerce, translation, mathematics and philosophy. Those achievements accumulated over time; the foundation date does not attribute a broad intellectual movement to one institution or a single year.

significance.zh: 形成连接西亚、南亚与地中海世界的核心城市之一。
significance.en: Established one of the major urban centres connecting West Asia, South Asia and the Mediterranean.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Foundation of Baghdad

summary.zh: 爪哇中部统治者与工匠修建婆罗浮屠，以层层平台、浮雕和佛塔组织修行者的空间体验。建筑结合佛教观念与当地环境和艺术传统，反映群岛社会参与跨海文化交流。这里采用八至九世纪主要建造阶段的近似范围，不把完工日期视为已精确确定。
summary.en: Patrons and craftspeople in central Java built Borobudur with ascending terraces, reliefs and stupas that structured a visitor’s religious experience. Buddhist ideas were expressed through local artistic and environmental settings, demonstrating the archipelago’s role in maritime cultural exchange. The rounded interval represents principal eighth- and ninth-century construction phases rather than a securely known completion date.

significance.zh: 体现东南亚对佛教艺术和建筑的创造性发展。
significance.en: Demonstrates Southeast Asian creativity in Buddhist art and architecture.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Construction of Borobudur

title.zh: 林迪斯法恩袭击与维京时代
title.en: The Lindisfarne raid and the Viking Age

summary.zh: 斯堪的纳维亚袭击者攻击林迪斯法恩修道院，在英格兰文献中引起强烈反响，常被用作维京时代的象征起点。北欧海上活动并不始于此年，后来还包括贸易、移民与政治建构。地图标记受袭遗址，不以一次暴力事件概括全部北欧社会。
summary.en: Scandinavian raiders attacked the monastery at Lindisfarne, producing a powerful response in English written sources. The event is often used symbolically to open the Viking Age, although northern seafaring predated it and later activity included trade, settlement and state-building. The marker identifies the raided locality without reducing all Scandinavian societies to raiding.

significance.zh: 帮助区分有记载的标志事件与更长久的跨海社会过程。
significance.en: Distinguishes a memorable documented event from longer maritime social processes.

sources.title: www.english-heritage.org.uk — The Lindisfarne raid and the Viking Age

summary.zh: 教宗利奥三世在罗马为查理曼加冕，强化法兰克统治者与罗马教会的关系，并提出西欧新的帝国主张。此举与仍然存在的东罗马帝国形成复杂关系。加冕没有建立现代意义的欧洲统一国家，而是中古王权、宗教与罗马传统的重新组合。
summary.en: Pope Leo III crowned Charlemagne in Rome, strengthening connections between the Frankish ruler and the Roman church while advancing a western imperial claim. The act created complicated relationships with the continuing eastern Roman Empire. It did not establish a modern unified European nation but reworked medieval kingship, religious authority and Roman political traditions.

significance.zh: 深刻影响西欧帝国观念及王权与教会关系。
significance.en: Influenced western European ideas of empire and relationships between rulers and the church.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Charlemagne’s imperial coronation

title.zh: 加纳帝国与跨撒哈拉贸易

summary.zh: 加纳帝国在萨赫勒地区参与并控制部分黄金、盐和其他商品的交换，统治者与商人群体通过税收、保护和地方关系维系网络。这里的加纳并非现代同名国家所在地。库姆比萨利赫作为代表遗址，区间表示繁盛阶段，不强行给出有争议的建国年份。
summary.en: Ghana’s rulers participated in and controlled portions of Sahelian exchanges in gold, salt and other goods, working through taxation, protection and local relationships. The historical empire was not located in the modern country of the same name. Koumbi Saleh is a representative site, and the interval marks prominence rather than a disputed exact foundation.

significance.zh: 把西非政治发展与贯穿沙漠的商业联系放在同一历史框架。
significance.en: Connects West African political development with commercial networks across the Sahara.

sources.title: www.loc.gov — Ghana and trans-Saharan trade

title.en: Rise of the Angkor political centre

summary.zh: 后世碑铭把阇耶跋摩二世的重要王权仪式联系到802年，常据此标记吴哥时代起点。高棉政治中心、农业水利和寺院网络实际经历长期发展。地图以库伦山区代表相关传统，须将追述史料中的纪年与可直接考证的当时记录加以区分。
summary.en: Later inscriptions associate an important royal ceremony of Jayavarman II with 802, commonly used to mark the opening of the Angkor period. Khmer political centres, agricultural water systems and temple networks developed over much longer spans. The Kulen region represents this tradition, and retrospective chronology should be distinguished from a directly contemporary dated record.

significance.zh: 为理解高棉国家、王权仪式与景观建设的关系提供起点。
significance.en: Provides an entry point to Khmer state formation, royal ritual and landscape construction.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Rise of the Angkor political centre

summary.zh: 花剌子密在九世纪的巴格达系统讨论一次与二次方程的分类和求解，把几何论证与继承、分配等实际计算相联系。其书名中的术语后来影响代数一词，著作又经翻译进入其他语言。约820年是学术著作年代的近似值，不代表代数所有思想的唯一诞生。
summary.en: Working in ninth-century Baghdad, al-Khwarizmi systematically classified and solved linear and quadratic equations, connecting geometric reasoning with practical calculations such as inheritance and distribution. A term in his book’s title later supplied the word algebra, and translations extended its influence. Around 820 is approximate and does not identify the sole origin of all algebraic thought.

significance.zh: 推进代数成为有系统方法的研究领域，并连接不同数学传统。
significance.en: Advanced algebra as a systematic field and connected different mathematical traditions.

sources.title: University of St Andrews — MacTutor: Al-Khwarizmi

summary.zh: 一卷《金刚经》木版印本的题记明确记载868年，显示宗教供养、复制技术和文本传播的结合。它是现存最早有完整纪年的印刷书籍之一，不是人类第一次印刷。地图标记敦煌莫高窟的保存与发现地点，实际刊印地点并未因此得到确定。
summary.en: A woodblock-printed Diamond Sutra bears a colophon dated 868, linking religious patronage with techniques for reproducing and circulating texts. It is an exceptionally early complete dated printed book, not the first instance of printing itself. The map marks its preservation and discovery at Dunhuang’s Mogao caves rather than claiming a securely identified printing location.

significance.zh: 提供印刷技术、佛教实践与跨地区文本流通相联系的实物证据。
significance.en: Provides material evidence linking printing, Buddhist practice and the circulation of texts.

sources.title: British Library / International Dunhuang Programme — The Diamond Sutra

title.en: Formation of the Khitan Liao state

summary.zh: 阿保机称帝，契丹统治者逐渐建立兼顾不同人口与生计方式的政权，后来以辽为国号。草原与农耕地区的统治安排并不完全相同，边界也持续变化。地图以辽上京地区代表政治中心；916年是帝号节点，不是所有辽代制度与城市同时出现。
summary.en: Abaoji adopted an imperial title as Khitan rulers developed a state governing populations with different livelihoods and institutions, later known as Liao. Arrangements for steppe and agricultural regions differed, and territorial control changed. The Shangjing region represents a political centre; 916 marks an imperial claim rather than simultaneous creation of every Liao institution and city.

significance.zh: 表明中古东亚政治秩序由多个能够创新制度的国家共同塑造。
significance.en: Shows that medieval East Asian political order was shaped by several institutionally innovative states.

sources.title: www.tnm.jp — Formation of the Khitan Liao state

summary.zh: 赵匡胤建立宋朝，随后逐步整合多个地区政权，加强文官行政并限制部分军事将领权力。宋始终与辽、西夏及后来的金等并存，不能把建国等同于整个东亚统一。开封代表北宋都城，商业与技术发展则是之后持续数百年的复杂过程。
summary.en: Zhao Kuangyin founded the Song dynasty and subsequently absorbed several regional regimes, strengthening civil administration while limiting some military commanders. Song coexisted with Liao, Western Xia and later Jin, so its foundation did not unite all East Asia. Kaifeng represents the Northern Song capital; commercial and technological transformations unfolded over subsequent centuries.

significance.zh: 开启以城市、商业、文官治理与技术创新著称的历史阶段。
significance.en: Opened an era associated with urban growth, commerce, civil government and technological innovation.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Foundation of the Song dynasty

title.zh: 朱罗王朝与南亚海洋联系
title.en: Chola power and South Asian maritime connections

summary.zh: 拉贾拉贾一世及其后继者扩展朱罗势力，修建大型寺院，并以军事和商业活动参与印度洋网络。1025年袭击室利佛逝是重要节点，但不等于朱罗永久统治整个海域。坦贾武尔代表王权与寺院中心，贸易还由商人和地方社群共同推动。
summary.en: Rajaraja I and his successors expanded Chola power, sponsored large temples and participated in Indian Ocean networks through both military and commercial activity. Attacks on Srivijaya in 1025 were significant without establishing permanent rule over the entire sea. Thanjavur represents royal and temple institutions, while merchants and local communities also sustained exchange.

significance.zh: 呈现南亚国家、寺院与商人共同参与海洋世界的方式。
significance.en: Shows how South Asian states, temples and merchants participated in the maritime world.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Chola power and South Asian maritime connections

title.zh: 弗拉基米尔与罗斯的基督教化
title.en: Volodymyr and the Christianisation of Rus

summary.zh: 基辅罗斯统治者弗拉基米尔采用拜占庭基督教，并推动王权与新宗教机构的结合，988年是传统纪年。不同地区的信仰变化持续更久，不能把一次王室改宗当作所有居民同步改信。基辅代表政治中心，事件也不应直接归属于单一现代民族国家。
summary.en: The ruler Volodymyr adopted Byzantine Christianity and supported connections between royal authority and new religious institutions, traditionally dated to 988. Changes in local belief continued much longer and did not follow one simultaneous conversion. Kyiv represents the political centre; the history of Rus should not be assigned exclusively to a single modern nation-state.

significance.zh: 影响东欧宗教、书写文化和跨区域政治联系。
significance.en: Influenced religion, written culture and political connections across eastern Europe.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Volodymyr and the Christianisation of Rus

title.zh: 伊本·海赛姆的光学研究

summary.zh: 伊本·海赛姆在十一世纪前期系统研究视觉、光的传播及反射等问题，结合数学论证与观察实验。其著作后来经翻译影响其他学术传统。约1020年是活动时期的显示锚点，开罗代表研究关联地；不能据此声称现代科学方法由一人一次性发明。
summary.en: In the early eleventh century, Ibn al-Haytham investigated vision, light and reflection through mathematical argument and observational or experimental procedures. Translations later extended the influence of his work. Around 1020 serves as an approximate chronological anchor and Cairo as a scholarly locality, without claiming that one individual suddenly invented the entire modern scientific method.

significance.zh: 体现光学、数学与实验性检验相结合的重要传统。
significance.en: Represents an influential tradition linking optics, mathematics and experimental investigation.

sources.title: University of St Andrews — MacTutor: Al-Haytham

title.zh: 北欧人在纽芬兰的活动证据
title.en: Evidence of Norse activity in Newfoundland

summary.zh: 兰塞奥兹牧草地的木材研究利用树轮中的宇宙射线事件信号，将北欧人砍伐木材的一次活动定到1021年。该结果证明这一年有人在场，不给出首次抵达或整个聚落持续期。美洲早已有原住民社会，因此不能将此称为无人大陆的发现。
summary.en: Research on wood from L’Anse aux Meadows used a cosmic-ray signal in tree rings to date a Norse woodcutting activity to 1021. This establishes presence in that year, not the first arrival or the full duration of settlement. Indigenous societies already inhabited the Americas, so the evidence does not describe discovery of an empty continent.

significance.zh: 为跨大西洋接触提供精确年份，同时保留证据所能证明的边界。
significance.en: Provides a precise year for transatlantic contact while respecting the limits of the evidence.

sources.title: Nature — Evidence for European presence in the Americas in AD 1021

summary.zh: 宋政府在四川设立管理交子的机构，把此前私人发行的信用凭证纳入官方制度。纸币缓解重钱运输困难，也需要信用、兑换与发行管理。成都代表其早期中心；1023年标记官方管理的重要节点，不等于所有地区同时用纸币替代金属货币。
summary.en: The Song government established official administration for jiaozi in Sichuan, incorporating earlier privately issued credit instruments into a public system. Paper currency eased problems of transporting heavy coins but depended on confidence, redemption and issuance control. Chengdu represents an early centre; 1023 did not mark universal replacement of metallic money throughout the empire.

significance.zh: 成为理解货币信用与国家财政制度演变的重要案例。
significance.en: Provides an important case for understanding monetary credit and the development of fiscal institutions.

sources.title: Wikipedia（百科参考） — Song jiaozi and paper currency

summary.zh: 沈括记述毕昇在十一世纪中期制作可重复排版的泥活字，把文字复制的部分工作从整版雕刻转为字模组合。技术效果受字库、工艺与使用场景影响，木版印刷并未随即消失。约1040年是近似年代，地图为华中代表点，并非已确定的发明工坊。
summary.en: Shen Kuo described Bi Sheng’s mid-eleventh-century use of reusable ceramic type, allowing characters to be assembled rather than carving every page as a whole. Practical value depended on character sets, production methods and applications; woodblock printing did not disappear. Around 1040 is approximate, and the central Chinese marker does not identify a securely known workshop.

significance.zh: 为模块化复制文本提供重要技术方案，后来在不同地区得到再发展。
significance.en: Introduced an important modular approach to text reproduction later developed in different settings.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Bi Sheng’s movable type

summary.zh: 密西西比河流域的卡霍基亚在十一至十二世纪形成大型土丘、广场与居民区，农业与区域联系支持人口集中和劳动组织。人口估计存在范围，不能从遗址面积直接换算精确居民数。所选年代表示高峰扩张期，不代表城市全部占居历史。
summary.en: Cahokia developed large earthen mounds, plazas and residential areas during an eleventh- and twelfth-century expansion supported by agriculture and regional connections. Building required substantial labour organisation, while population estimates remain ranges rather than exact counts. The selected interval marks a peak phase, not the whole history of occupation or a fixed political territory.

significance.zh: 展现墨西哥以北美洲原住民社会的重要城市传统。
significance.en: Highlights a major Indigenous urban tradition in North America north of Mexico.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Urban expansion at Cahokia

title.zh: 东西方教会分裂的重要节点
title.en: A major stage in the East–West church schism

summary.zh: 罗马教宗使节与君士坦丁堡宗主教之间的相互绝罚，成为东西教会分裂的著名标志。神学、语言和权威争议在此前已长期积累，此后关系也没有在一天内完全断绝。君士坦丁堡代表争端中心，1054年是一段渐进分裂过程中的节点。
summary.en: Excommunications involving papal legates and the patriarch of Constantinople became a famous marker of the East–West schism. Disputes over theology, language and authority had developed over centuries, and relations did not end completely in one day. Constantinople represents a central setting; 1054 is one stage within a prolonged and uneven separation.

significance.zh: 影响欧洲与地中海世界的宗教制度和政治关系。
significance.en: Influenced religious institutions and political relationships across Europe and the Mediterranean.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — A major stage in the East–West church schism

summary.zh: 诺曼底公爵威廉在黑斯廷斯战胜哈罗德，随后取得英格兰王位，并逐步重组土地、贵族与行政关系。征服并非战役结束即告完成，地方反抗与暴力持续多年。地图点标记战场附近，后来的语言与社会变化应理解为长期结果而非当天发生。
summary.en: William of Normandy defeated Harold at Hastings and subsequently took the English crown, beginning major changes in landholding, aristocracy and government. Conquest was not complete when the battle ended; resistance and violence continued for years. The marker identifies the battlefield area, while linguistic and social transformations belong to the longer aftermath rather than one day.

significance.zh: 改变英格兰统治阶层，并加强与欧洲大陆的政治文化联系。
significance.en: Changed England’s ruling elite and intensified political and cultural connections with continental Europe.

sources.title: www.english-heritage.org.uk — The Norman Conquest of England

summary.zh: 来自西欧的十字军经过安纳托利亚与近东，在1099年攻取耶路撒冷并杀害大量居民，建立新的拉丁政治据点。远征同时牵涉拜占庭、穆斯林政权及地方社群，动机不能归为单一因素。地图以耶路撒冷为终点代表，不绘制统一无争议的远征路线。
summary.en: Crusading armies from western Europe crossed Anatolia and the Near East, captured Jerusalem in 1099 and killed many inhabitants before establishing Latin political enclaves. Byzantine authorities, Muslim powers and local communities were all involved, with varied motives and interests. Jerusalem represents a major destination, not a claim to one uncontested reconstruction of the entire expedition.

significance.zh: 加剧并重组地中海东部战争、政治与宗教关系。
significance.en: Intensified and reshaped warfare, politics and religious relationships in the eastern Mediterranean.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — The First Crusade

title.zh: 大津巴布韦的城市与国家
title.en: The city and state of Great Zimbabwe

summary.zh: 大津巴布韦的建造者修筑宏大的干砌石墙，将农业、畜牧、手工业与通向印度洋的贸易联系起来。遗址由当地非洲社会创造，早期殖民解释曾错误否认这一点。时间范围对应主要发展阶段，政治权力、人口规模和贸易方向在期间持续变化。
summary.en: The builders of Great Zimbabwe constructed major dry-stone walls within a society supported by farming, livestock, crafts and trading connections toward the Indian Ocean. Local African communities created the site, contrary to earlier colonial claims. The interval represents principal development phases, during which political authority, population and commercial relationships continued to change.

significance.zh: 以考古证据展示南部非洲国家形成与远距离联系。
significance.en: Documents state formation and long-distance connections in southern Africa through archaeological evidence.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — The city and state of Great Zimbabwe

summary.zh: 苏利耶跋摩二世统治时期修建吴哥窟，将毗湿奴崇拜、王权象征与精细的建筑浮雕结合起来。寺院依托更广的城市和水利景观，后又融入佛教传统。日期大致对应相关统治与建造阶段，不意味着工程在即位当天开始或国王去世时全部结束。
summary.en: Angkor Wat was built during Suryavarman II’s reign, combining devotion to Vishnu, royal symbolism and elaborate architectural reliefs. It belonged to a wider urban and hydraulic landscape and later became associated with Buddhist traditions. The dates broadly follow the reign and construction phase, rather than claiming work began on an accession day or ended at the ruler’s death.

significance.zh: 体现高棉建筑、宗教与国家资源组织的复杂结合。
significance.en: Demonstrates a complex relationship between Khmer architecture, religion and the organisation of state resources.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Construction of Angkor Wat

title.zh: 基尔瓦的印度洋贸易繁荣

summary.zh: 斯瓦希里城市基尔瓦通过黄金、象牙与进口陶瓷等商品的交换繁荣，修建清真寺、宫殿与石造居所。当地非洲社群主动参与连接阿拉伯、印度和中国的网络，并形成多元文化。区间表示高峰阶段，不暗示贸易从此时才开始或其后立即停止。
summary.en: The Swahili city of Kilwa prospered through exchanges involving gold, ivory and imported ceramics, supporting mosques, palaces and stone houses. Local African communities actively shaped networks linking Arabia, India and China and developed a distinctive cosmopolitan culture. The interval marks a peak phase, not the beginning of commerce or its immediate end thereafter.

significance.zh: 突出非洲东岸城市在印度洋世界中的主动商业与文化角色。
significance.en: Highlights the active commercial and cultural role of East African cities in the Indian Ocean world.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Kilwa’s Indian Ocean trading prosperity

summary.zh: 埃塞俄比亚高地的工匠从岩体中凿出教堂、通道和排水系统，形成持续使用的礼拜与朝圣景观。传统把主要工程联系到拉利贝拉王，建筑分期则更复杂。约1200年仅概括重要建设时期，不把全部教堂归为同一次施工或同一位工匠的作品。
summary.en: Craftspeople in the Ethiopian highlands cut churches, passages and drainage systems from living rock, creating a landscape of worship and pilgrimage that remains active. Tradition connects major works with King Lalibela, while architectural phases are more complex. Around 1200 is a broad chronological anchor, not a claim that every church was made in one campaign.

significance.zh: 展示非洲基督教社会延续至今的建筑与宗教创造力。
significance.en: Highlights architectural and religious creativity within African Christian traditions that continue today.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — The rock-hewn churches of Lalibela

title.zh: 南马都尔的人工岛与仪式中心
title.en: Artificial islets and ceremonial power at Nan Madol

summary.zh: 波纳佩岛近海的社群以玄武岩与珊瑚块修筑人工岛、宫殿、墓地和仪式建筑，形成与绍德雷尔王朝相关的中心。工程需要复杂运输和劳动组织。所选范围对应重要建筑阶段，部分研究给出更早或更晚年代，不应把政治与宗教实践限定为精确三百年。
summary.en: Communities off Pohnpei built artificial islets, residences, tombs and ceremonial structures using basalt and coral, creating a centre associated with the Saudeleur dynasty. Construction required sophisticated transport and labour organisation. The interval follows a major architectural phase; research also identifies earlier and later activity, so political and religious practice should not be confined to exactly three centuries.

significance.zh: 显示太平洋岛屿社会的工程能力、等级关系与延续的地方传统。
significance.en: Reveals engineering skill, social hierarchy and continuing local traditions in Pacific island societies.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Artificial islets and ceremonial power at Nan Madol

title.zh: 拉帕努伊的摩艾与仪式景观
title.en: Moai and ceremonial landscapes on Rapa Nui

summary.zh: 拉帕努伊社群雕刻并竖立摩艾石像，建设仪式平台，并调整农业以适应岛屿环境。这一条目选择欧洲接触前的重要发展阶段，不把最初定居年份视为已经一致解决。森林变化、社会组织与后来殖民冲击必须分别考察，不能只用自我毁灭解释岛屿历史。
summary.en: Rapa Nui communities carved and raised moai, built ceremonial platforms and adapted agriculture to an island environment. This entry selects a major pre-European-contact phase without claiming consensus on the exact first settlement date. Environmental change, social organisation and later colonial disruption need separate examination; the island’s history cannot be reduced to a simple narrative of self-destruction.

significance.zh: 强调太平洋社会的创造力，并避免把环境变化写成单一灾难寓言。
significance.en: Emphasises Pacific creativity while resisting a one-cause environmental collapse narrative.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Moai and ceremonial landscapes on Rapa Nui

summary.zh: 库特布丁·艾伯克在古尔统治瓦解后建立独立权力，通常以1206年作为德里苏丹国的开端。随后多个王朝治理不断变化的领土，与地方精英、农民和宗教社群发生合作及冲突。德里代表政治中心，不意味着南亚当年被单一政权完整征服。
summary.en: Qutb al-Din Aibak established independent power after the fragmentation of Ghurid authority, conventionally opening the Delhi Sultanate in 1206. Successive dynasties governed changing territories through cooperation and conflict with local elites, cultivators and religious communities. Delhi represents the political centre without implying that one regime conquered or uniformly governed the entire subcontinent in that year.

significance.zh: 重塑南亚北部政治与城市文化，并推动新的跨区域联系。
significance.en: Reshaped northern South Asian politics and urban culture while extending cross-regional connections.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Foundation of the Delhi Sultanate

title.zh: 成吉思汗与蒙古帝国形成
title.en: Chinggis Khan and the formation of the Mongol Empire

summary.zh: 铁木真在统一多支草原力量后获成吉思汗称号，建立新的军事政治组织，随后展开跨欧亚征服。帝国促进人员与物品往来，也造成严重屠杀、破坏和强制迁移。地图以蒙古东部代表集会相关区域，不能假装会议地点或当年国界已精确确定。
summary.en: Temüjin received the title Chinggis Khan after consolidating several steppe forces and organised a new military-political order. Subsequent conquests connected Eurasian regions while causing massacres, destruction and forced movement. Eastern Mongolia represents the region associated with the assembly; the marker does not claim an exactly known meeting site or precisely established borders for 1206.

significance.zh: 开启改变欧亚政治、交通与人口分布的蒙古扩张。
significance.en: Began a Mongol expansion that transformed Eurasian politics, transport and population patterns.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Chinggis Khan and the formation of the Mongol Empire

summary.zh: 英格兰约翰王在与反叛贵族冲突中接受《大宪章》，涉及王权、司法、财产及特定群体的权利。最初文本很快被撤销，后经重颁获得不同意义。它不是现代民主或全民平等的直接宣言，却成为后世限制权力与法律保障讨论的重要资源。
summary.en: King John accepted Magna Carta during conflict with rebel barons, addressing royal power, justice, property and the rights of particular groups. The first settlement was quickly annulled, while later reissues acquired new meanings. It was not a declaration of modern democracy or universal equality, but became an important resource in later arguments about legal safeguards.

significance.zh: 展示政治妥协文本如何经过后世重释获得长期影响。
significance.en: Shows how a political compromise gained lasting influence through subsequent reinterpretation.

sources.title: www.nationalarchives.gov.uk — Issuing of Magna Carta

title.zh: 马蓬古布韦的王权与贸易

summary.zh: 林波波河附近的马蓬古布韦形成山顶精英居所与山下聚落相区分的政治中心，黄金、象牙及外来物品反映长距离贸易。其发展与农业、人口及等级制度相联系。日期对应主要王都阶段，不能把全部区域社会都解释为这座中心单向控制的附属。
summary.en: Mapungubwe near the Limpopo developed a political centre separating elite hilltop residences from settlements below. Gold, ivory and imported objects indicate long-distance exchange connected with farming, population growth and social hierarchy. The dates describe a principal capital phase, without assuming that every surrounding community was simply a uniformly controlled dependency of the centre.

significance.zh: 为南部非洲社会分层与印度洋贸易联系提供关键证据。
significance.en: Provides important evidence for social stratification and Indian Ocean connections in southern Africa.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Kingship and trade at Mapungubwe

summary.zh: 松迪亚塔在曼丁地区整合联盟，形成后来马里帝国的重要基础，1235年常与基里纳战役联系。口述史与后世文字记录共同保存这段历史，精确年代和地点仍有不确定。地图点只代表曼丁核心区，不将传说细节或推定战场包装为已核实事实。
summary.en: Sundiata consolidated alliances in the Manding region, establishing foundations of the later Mali Empire. The conventional date 1235 is associated with the battle of Kirina, known through oral traditions and later writing. Exact chronology and location remain uncertain. The marker represents the Manding heartland rather than presenting a disputed battlefield or every narrative detail as verified.

significance.zh: 展现西非联盟政治、历史传承与国家形成的结合。
significance.en: Highlights relationships among alliance-building, historical transmission and state formation in West Africa.

sources.title: discovery.ucl.ac.uk — Rise of the Mali Empire

title.zh: 波利尼西亚人定居新西兰
title.en: Polynesian settlement of Aotearoa New Zealand

summary.zh: 来自东波利尼西亚的航海者在十三世纪后半叶定居新西兰，成为毛利人的祖先，并逐步适应不同的资源与气候。考古年代支持约1250至1300年的主要定居过程。怀劳沙洲代表早期遗址之一，不能据此断定唯一登陆地点或一条确定航线。
summary.en: Voyagers from East Polynesia settled Aotearoa New Zealand in the later thirteenth century, becoming ancestors of Māori communities and adapting to new resources and climates.
