Archaeological dating supports a principal settlement interval around 1250–1300. Wairau Bar represents one early locality, not proof of an exclusive first landing place or one fully reconstructed sailing route.

significance.zh: 体现远洋航海知识与进入新环境后的社会、生态变化。
significance.en: Demonstrates oceanic navigational knowledge and social and ecological change in a new environment.

sources.title: Te Ara — Encyclopedia of New Zealand（专业百科） — Polynesian settlement of Aotearoa New Zealand

summary.zh: 旭烈兀率领的蒙古军攻陷巴格达，处死阿拔斯哈里发，造成严重杀戮和城市破坏。死亡总数在史料中差异很大，不宜采用夸张的单一数字。事件终结了巴格达阿拔斯统治的重要阶段，但伊斯兰学术与城市生活并未因此在整个区域彻底消失。
summary.en: Mongol forces led by Hülegü captured Baghdad, executed the Abbasid caliph and inflicted severe killing and destruction. Reported death totals vary widely and should not be reduced to one dramatic number. The event ended an important phase of Abbasid rule in Baghdad, but Islamic scholarship and urban life did not disappear throughout the region.

significance.zh: 标志西亚权力结构的重大改变，而非所有知识传统的终结。
significance.en: Marked a major change in West Asian power without ending all scholarly traditions.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — The Mongol sack of Baghdad

title.en: Kublai adopts the Yuan dynastic name

summary.zh: 忽必烈采用大元国号，以中国皇帝身份组织统治，同时处于蒙古诸汗国逐渐分化的欧亚政治网络中。南宋直到1279年才被征服，因此1271年不等于全部相关领土已统一。大都代表政治中心，元朝不应被简单视为整个蒙古帝国的同义词。
summary.en: Kublai adopted the Yuan dynastic name while organising rule as a Chinese emperor within an increasingly divided Mongol imperial world. The Southern Song was not conquered until 1279, so the naming date did not complete territorial consolidation. Dadu represents the political centre; the Yuan dynasty should not be used as a synonym for the entire Mongol Empire.

significance.zh: 体现蒙古帝国背景下东亚统治制度与政治身份的重新组合。
significance.en: Shows the reconstruction of East Asian institutions and political identities within the Mongol imperial setting.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Kublai adopts the Yuan dynastic name

title.zh: 意大利城市中的人文主义与艺术转变
title.en: Humanism and artistic change in Italian cities

summary.zh: 意大利多座城市中，学者重新研读古典文本，艺术家探索新的空间表现与人体研究，商人、教会和统治者提供赞助。文艺复兴并非突然摆脱一片黑暗，也吸收地中海之外的知识与物质。佛罗伦萨只是代表中心，发展时间和形式因地区而异。
summary.en: Scholars in Italian cities reread classical texts while artists explored spatial representation and the human body with support from merchants, churches and rulers. The Renaissance was not a sudden escape from a uniformly dark past and drew on knowledge and materials from wider networks. Florence represents one centre within a geographically and chronologically varied transformation.

significance.zh: 将艺术与知识变化置于城市经济、赞助和跨文化联系之中。
significance.en: Places artistic and intellectual change within urban economies, patronage and cross-cultural connections.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Humanism and artistic change in Italian cities

summary.zh: 马里统治者曼萨·穆萨前往麦加朝觐，途经开罗展示王国资源与外交联系，并加强西非与更广伊斯兰世界的联系。旅行见闻经不同作者转述，财富规模不宜换算为现代精确身价。地图以开罗代表有重要记载的停留地，不画未逐段核实的全程路线。
summary.en: Mali’s ruler Mansa Musa travelled toward Mecca, passing through Cairo and demonstrating his kingdom’s resources and diplomatic connections. The journey strengthened West Africa’s visibility within the wider Islamic world. Accounts were transmitted by different writers, so wealth should not be converted into a precise modern net worth. Cairo represents a documented stop, not a verified full itinerary.

significance.zh: 展现撒哈拉两侧政治、宗教与知识网络的联通。
significance.en: Shows connections among political, religious and intellectual networks across the Sahara.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Mansa Musa’s pilgrimage

title.zh: 特诺奇蒂特兰的建立传统

summary.zh: 墨西加人的历史传统将特诺奇蒂特兰建城联系到1325年，城市后来利用湖泊、堤道和集约农业发展为强大政治中心。相关叙述结合历史记忆与宗教象征，不能把所有细节当作当代日志。建城也不等于阿兹特克三方同盟当年已经成立。
summary.en: Mexica historical traditions associate Tenochtitlan’s foundation with 1325. The city later used its lake setting, causeways and intensive agriculture to become a powerful political centre. Foundation accounts combine historical memory with religious symbolism and are not contemporary diaries in every detail. The date also predates the formation of the Aztec Triple Alliance.

significance.zh: 为理解墨西哥盆地的城市建设、联盟政治与历史记忆提供节点。
significance.en: Provides a point of entry to urban development, alliance politics and historical memory in the Basin of Mexico.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — The foundation tradition of Tenochtitlan

title.zh: 黑死病的跨区域大流行

summary.zh: 鼠疫沿欧亚与地中海的多种联系扩散，造成严重死亡，并引发劳动、宗教和社会秩序的变化。地区受灾程度不一，迫害犹太人等行为不能作为真实病因解释。地图以东地中海代表交流节点，区间是常见主要波次，疫病在此后仍反复出现。
summary.en: Plague spread through Eurasian and Mediterranean connections, causing severe mortality and changes in labour, religious life and social relations. Impacts varied between regions, and persecution of Jewish communities or other scapegoats did not explain the disease’s cause. An eastern Mediterranean marker represents connectivity; the interval covers a conventional major wave, with recurrent outbreaks continuing afterwards.

significance.zh: 展示生物灾害如何通过人口、制度与偏见影响社会。
significance.en: Shows how a biological disaster interacted with demography, institutions and prejudice.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — The Black Death pandemic

summary.zh: 朱元璋在南京建立明朝，同年其军队攻占元大都，重组税收、军事与地方行政。蒙古统治力量继续在北方活动，因此不能说元朝相关政治传统在一日之间完全消失。1368年标记王朝更替，明的制度及边界随后仍经历重大调整。
summary.en: Zhu Yuanzhang founded the Ming dynasty at Nanjing, and his armies captured the Yuan capital later that year. Fiscal, military and local institutions were reorganised. Mongol rulers continued to operate in the north, so Yuan political traditions did not vanish overnight. The foundation date marks dynastic change rather than the final form of Ming institutions or borders.

significance.zh: 重塑东亚政治秩序，并开启新的国家管理与对外关系阶段。
significance.en: Reshaped East Asian political order and began a new phase of state administration and foreign relations.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Foundation of the Ming dynasty

title.zh: 刚果王国与姆班扎刚果
title.en: The Kongo kingdom and Mbanza Kongo

summary.zh: 十四世纪刚果地区逐渐形成以姆班扎刚果为重要中心的王国，通过王权、地方组织与贸易联系整合不同社群。约1390年是便于展示的概略年代，并非有完整文书可证的建国日。该政权早于葡萄牙人到来，不能把欧洲接触当作当地政治历史的起点。
summary.en: During the fourteenth century, a Kongo kingdom developed around Mbanza Kongo through royal authority, local institutions and exchange. Approximately 1390 is a broad display date rather than a fully documented foundation year. The polity existed before Portuguese arrival, which must not be treated as the beginning of political history in the region.

significance.zh: 确认中部非洲国家形成的自主历史与后来的跨大西洋联系。
significance.en: Recognises Central African state formation before its later transatlantic connections.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — The Kongo kingdom and Mbanza Kongo

title.zh: 马六甲港口国家的兴起
title.en: Rise of the port polity of Melaka

summary.zh: 十五世纪初马六甲在海峡贸易网络中兴起，通过统治者、商人社群、港口规则和外交联系吸引航运。伊斯兰文化与多语言商业环境相互发展，明朝也是其重要外交伙伴。约1400年表示早期形成阶段，不把有分歧的建城传说当作精确纪年。
summary.en: Melaka rose within strait-based trading networks in the early fifteenth century, attracting shipping through rulers, merchant communities, port arrangements and diplomacy. Islamic traditions developed alongside a multilingual commercial environment, and Ming China became an important diplomatic partner. Around 1400 represents early formation rather than treating debated foundation traditions as an exact documented chronology.

significance.zh: 成为理解东南亚海上贸易、多元港市与区域外交的重要节点。
significance.en: Provides a major node for understanding Southeast Asian maritime trade, diverse port communities and diplomacy.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Rise of the port polity of Melaka

summary.zh: 明朝派遣郑和等率领船队前往东南亚、南亚、西亚与非洲东岸，开展外交、贸易与军事行动。航行依托已经繁荣的印度洋网络，不能称为发现这些有人居住的地区。南京代表组织中心，时间区间涵盖多次航行而非一条连续不间断的路线。
summary.en: Ming fleets led by Zheng He and others travelled to Southeast Asia, South Asia, West Asia and the East African coast for diplomacy, trade and military action. They operated within already flourishing Indian Ocean networks rather than discovering inhabited lands. Nanjing represents an organisational centre, and the interval covers separate voyages, not one uninterrupted route.

significance.zh: 呈现国家海上力量与既有跨文化商业网络的互动。
significance.en: Shows interactions between state-sponsored seafaring and established cross-cultural commercial networks.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Voyages of Zheng He’s fleets

summary.zh: 帕查库特克统治与印加迅速扩张相联系，库斯科王权通过征服、联盟、道路和劳役制度整合安第斯地区。传统年表以1438年为重要起点，精确纪年仍依赖后世记述。扩张带来组织和基础设施，也包含强制迁移与被征服社群的抵抗。
summary.en: Pachacuti’s rule is associated with rapid imperial Inca expansion from Cusco through conquest, alliances, roads and labour obligations. Conventional chronology uses 1438 as a major opening, although precise dates depend on later accounts. Expansion created infrastructure and administrative connections while also imposing forced relocation and provoking resistance among incorporated communities.

significance.zh: 展示安第斯帝国如何依地形、劳动制度与地方关系组织权力。
significance.en: Shows how an Andean empire organised power through terrain, labour systems and local relationships.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Expansion of the Inca Empire

title.zh: 埃乌阿雷时期的贝宁王国

summary.zh: 埃乌阿雷时期的贝宁王权扩展军事力量、强化都城并发展宫廷仪式，艺术与王室组织共同表达政治权威。历史结合口述传统、器物与外来记述，具体措施的年代仍有讨论。此处指今尼日利亚的贝宁城王国，不能与现代贝宁共和国混为一谈。
summary.en: Under Oba Ewuare, Benin strengthened military power, fortified its capital and developed court ritual, with art and royal institutions expressing political authority. Evidence combines oral histories, objects and outside accounts, so dates for individual reforms remain uncertain. This is the kingdom centred on Benin City in present-day Nigeria, not the modern Republic of Benin.

significance.zh: 展示西非王权、城市工程与宫廷艺术之间的联系。
significance.en: Demonstrates relationships among West African kingship, urban construction and court art.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Benin under Oba Ewuare

title.zh: 谷登堡与欧洲活字印刷

summary.zh: 谷登堡及合作者在美因茨发展适合欧洲文字排印的金属活字、油墨和印压系统，并刊印大型书籍。东亚更早已有木版与活字技术，因此不能称他发明全人类印刷术。该时期的组合式工艺与商业组织使欧洲书籍生产逐步扩大，而非立即实现全民阅读。
summary.en: Gutenberg and collaborators in Mainz developed a system combining metal type, ink and a press suited to European book production. East Asian woodblock and movable-type traditions were earlier, so he did not invent printing for all humanity. The technical and commercial combination gradually expanded European book production without immediately creating universal literacy or access.

significance.zh: 降低部分文本复制成本，并改变知识、宗教与商业传播的条件。
significance.en: Changed the conditions of textual reproduction and the circulation of knowledge, religion and commerce.

sources.title: www.gutenberg.de — Gutenberg and European movable-type printing

title.zh: 奥斯曼军攻取君士坦丁堡

summary.zh: 穆罕默德二世率奥斯曼军攻取君士坦丁堡，结束当地拜占庭皇帝统治，并将城市重建为帝国中心。围城与陷落造成杀戮、俘虏和流离失所，后续也有迁入与制度重组。事件并未关闭所有欧亚贸易，不能简单当作欧洲远航的唯一原因。
summary.en: Mehmed II’s Ottoman army captured Constantinople, ending Byzantine imperial rule there and rebuilding the city as an imperial centre. Siege and conquest caused killing, captivity and displacement, followed by migration and institutional reorganisation. The event did not close all Eurasian trade and should not be treated as the sole cause of later European oceanic voyages.

significance.zh: 重塑东地中海权力结构，并开启城市新的帝国历史。
significance.en: Reshaped eastern Mediterranean power and began a new imperial phase in the city’s history.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Ottoman conquest of Constantinople

title.zh: 哥伦布航行抵达加勒比

summary.zh: 哥伦布率船队横渡大西洋抵达已有原住民社会的加勒比岛屿，随后持续的欧洲殖民改变当地政治与生活。跨洋交换伴随征服、奴役和疾病传播，影响极不平等。地图点仅代表巴哈马群岛区域，因为首次登陆岛屿仍有争论，不能称为发现无人新大陆。
summary.en: Columbus’s expedition crossed the Atlantic and reached Caribbean islands already inhabited by Indigenous societies. Continuing European colonisation transformed local politics and lives, while transatlantic exchange accompanied conquest, enslavement and disease with deeply unequal effects. The marker represents the Bahamas region because the first landing island remains debated; it does not portray discovery of an empty continent.

significance.zh: 开启持续跨大西洋联系，也带来原住民社会的灾难性殖民冲击。
significance.en: Opened sustained transatlantic connections while bringing devastating colonial disruption to Indigenous societies.

sources.title: Library of Congress — 1492: An Ongoing Voyage

title.zh: 格拉纳达陷落与宗教政策转向
title.en: Fall of Granada and changing religious policy

summary.zh: 格拉纳达纳斯里王朝向卡斯蒂利亚与阿拉贡君主投降，伊比利亚最后一个穆斯林王国结束。同年犹太人被要求改宗或离境，随后穆斯林也面临日益强制的政策。政治统一与宗教同质化并非同一件事，地方社群的损失与迁移是事件的重要后果。
summary.en: Granada’s Nasrid rulers surrendered to the monarchs of Castile and Aragon, ending the peninsula’s last Muslim kingdom. In the same year, Jews were ordered to convert or leave, and Muslims later faced increasingly coercive policies. Political consolidation and religious homogenisation were distinct processes, with displacement and losses among local communities central to their consequences.

significance.zh: 标志伊比利亚权力与宗教秩序的转折，并推动离散社群形成。
significance.en: Marked a turning point in Iberian power and religion and contributed to diasporic movements.

sources.title: www.alhambra-patronato.es — Fall of Granada and changing religious policy
Center for Online Judaic Studies — Edict of the Expulsion of the Jews from Spain, 1492 (primary text translation)

summary.zh: 卡斯蒂利亚与葡萄牙通过条约约定大西洋一条划分海外主张的经线，试图协调各自扩张。被划入地区的原住民与其他政治实体没有参与，也并未因此失去自身主权事实。托尔德西里亚斯是签约地点，条约主张不能直接画成双方当时实际控制的世界疆界。
summary.en: Castile and Portugal agreed on an Atlantic meridian dividing overseas claims and seeking to coordinate expansion. Indigenous peoples and other political entities in the claimed regions did not participate. Tordesillas marks the signing place; the treaty’s asserted division must not be represented as actual global territorial control by the two monarchies in 1494.

significance.zh: 揭示欧洲殖民主张与当地政治现实之间的根本差异。
significance.en: Exposes the distinction between European colonial claims and political realities on the ground.

sources.title: www.unesco.org — The Treaty of Tordesillas

summary.zh: 达·伽马的船队绕过非洲抵达卡利卡特，开辟葡萄牙往返欧洲与印度洋的海路联系。他们进入的是早已繁荣、由多种社群经营的贸易世界，并依赖区域航海知识。后续葡萄牙扩张结合贸易和武力，此次到达不能称为发现印度或开始所有东西方贸易。
summary.en: Vasco da Gama’s fleet reached Calicut after rounding Africa, establishing a Portuguese sea connection between Europe and the Indian Ocean. The expedition entered an already flourishing trading world and relied on regional maritime knowledge. Later Portuguese expansion combined commerce with force; this arrival neither discovered India nor began all exchange between eastern and western societies.

significance.zh: 使欧洲海权更直接介入印度洋既有贸易体系。
significance.en: Enabled European maritime power to intervene more directly in established Indian Ocean trading systems.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Vasco da Gama reaches Calicut

title.zh: 卡布拉尔船队抵达巴西

summary.zh: 葡萄牙航海者卡布拉尔率船队横渡大西洋，在今巴西海岸登陆，并代表葡萄牙王室提出领土主张。当地早已生活着众多原住民社会，这次航行并非无人土地的发现；其后殖民扩张、种植园经济与强迫劳动逐步改变了南美洲的大西洋沿岸。
summary.en: Pedro Álvares Cabral’s Portuguese expedition reached the coast of present-day Brazil while sailing toward the Indian Ocean. Portugal claimed the territory, although numerous Indigenous societies already inhabited it. The landing became a landmark in the development of Portuguese America; sustained colonization, plantation agriculture and forced labour expanded over subsequent decades, rather than all beginning at the moment of arrival.

significance.zh: 它开启了葡萄牙在南美洲扩张的重要阶段。
significance.en: It marked an important stage in Portuguese expansion into South America.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Cabral reaches Brazil

summary.zh: 伊斯玛仪一世进入大不里士并称沙阿，建立萨法维政权，将十二伊玛目派什叶派确立为国家宗教。王朝随后在伊朗高原扩展统治，宗教制度化经历了长期且有强制性的过程。此事改变了伊朗与奥斯曼、乌兹别克等邻近政权之间的政治和宗教关系。
summary.en: Ismail I proclaimed himself shah at Tabriz and established Safavid rule, making Twelver Shiism the state religion. The dynasty subsequently consolidated control across much of the Iranian plateau. Religious transformation was gradual and sometimes coercive, rather than an immediate conversion of the population. Safavid institutions helped reshape Iran’s political identity and its relations with Ottoman and Uzbek neighbours.

significance.zh: 它深刻塑造了近世伊朗的国家与宗教结构。
significance.en: It profoundly shaped the political and religious structures of early modern Iran.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Iranica — Safavid dynasty

title.zh: 路德与宗教改革的开端

summary.zh: 马丁·路德在维滕贝格提出反对赎罪券实践的论题，争论随后借助印刷传播，发展为挑战教会权威的宗教改革。传统所述张贴论纲的具体情节存在争议，但一五一七年的论争有文献依据；改革后来分化成多个教派，并与诸侯政治和社会冲突交织。
summary.en: Martin Luther circulated arguments against indulgences at Wittenberg, opening a controversy that expanded into the Protestant Reformation. Printing helped spread criticism of church authority, while rulers and communities pursued different religious and political aims. The familiar account of physically posting the theses is debated; the controversy itself is documented. Reformation movements developed into several distinct traditions over subsequent decades.

significance.zh: 它重构了欧洲宗教生活，并影响国家权力与教育文化。
significance.en: It reorganized European religious life and influenced state power, education and culture.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Luther and the Protestant Reformation

title.zh: 麦哲伦—埃尔卡诺环球航行

summary.zh: 麦哲伦率西班牙资助的船队出航，穿越南美洲南端海峡进入太平洋；他在菲律宾冲突中死亡后，埃尔卡诺带领维多利亚号返回西班牙。航程依靠沿途社会的知识和补给，也伴随暴力与损失。塞维利亚为代表点，整次航行横跨多个大洋。
summary.en: An expedition financed by the Spanish crown sailed under Ferdinand Magellan, crossed the strait at South America’s southern tip and traversed the Pacific. After Magellan died in the Philippines, Juan Sebastián Elcano brought the Victoria back to Spain. The voyage relied on local knowledge and supplies and involved violence and severe losses. Seville represents a journey spanning several oceans.

significance.zh: 首次完成的环球航行把跨洋航路连接为可实践的整体。
significance.en: The first completed circumnavigation connected oceanic routes into a practicable global circuit.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Magellan–Elcano circumnavigation

summary.zh: 埃尔南·科尔特斯的西班牙军队与众多原住民盟军围攻并攻陷墨西加首都特诺奇蒂特兰。战争、饥饿与天花共同摧毁了城市的抵抗能力。征服不是西班牙人单独完成的行动，也没有立即结束各地原住民抵抗；其后新西班牙殖民统治逐步形成。
summary.en: Spanish forces led by Hernán Cortés, together with substantial Indigenous allied armies, besieged and captured the Mexica capital of Tenochtitlan. Warfare, hunger and smallpox devastated the city. The conquest depended on regional alliances and rivalries rather than Spanish action alone, and resistance continued elsewhere. Colonial New Spain subsequently developed through further military campaigns and institutional change.

significance.zh: 它终结了墨西加帝国的中心政权，开启新的殖民秩序。
significance.en: It destroyed the central Mexica imperial government and opened a new colonial order.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Fall of Tenochtitlan

title.zh: 巴布尔建立莫卧儿统治

summary.zh: 巴布尔在第一次帕尼帕特战役中击败德里苏丹易卜拉欣·洛迪，随后占领德里和阿格拉，奠定莫卧儿帝国基础。火器、战术与地方政治联盟共同影响战局。早期统治仍不稳固，帝国在后继者特别是阿克巴时期才形成更广泛的行政和财政体系。
summary.en: Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi at the First Battle of Panipat and took Delhi and Agra, establishing the foundations of Mughal rule. Firearms, battlefield tactics and political alliances all contributed to the outcome. The new dynasty initially faced substantial resistance and interruption; the wider administrative and revenue structures associated with the Mughal Empire developed under later rulers, especially Akbar.

significance.zh: 莫卧儿王朝成为近世南亚政治、经济与艺术的重要中心。
significance.en: The Mughal dynasty became a major centre of early modern South Asian politics, economy and art.

sources.title: Panipat District Government — First Battle of Panipat, 1526

title.zh: 卡哈马卡事件与印加征服
title.en: Cajamarca and the conquest of the Incas

summary.zh: 皮萨罗率领的西班牙人于卡哈马卡俘虏印加统治者阿塔瓦尔帕，次年处死他并进入库斯科。帝国此前受到内战和疫病削弱，征服者也利用地方联盟。此处标示征服的关键转折，并非印加抵抗的终点；比尔卡班巴的独立政权延续至一五七二年。
summary.en: Francisco Pizarro’s force captured the Inca ruler Atahualpa at Cajamarca, executed him the following year and entered Cuzco. Civil war, epidemic disease and local alliances shaped the Spanish advance. These years mark a decisive phase of conquest rather than the disappearance of Inca resistance: an independent Inca state at Vilcabamba continued until 1572, and Indigenous societies endured colonial rule.

significance.zh: 安第斯地区进入西班牙殖民扩张与原住民长期抵抗的新阶段。
significance.en: The Andes entered a new phase of Spanish colonial expansion and prolonged Indigenous resistance.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Cajamarca and the conquest of the Incas

summary.zh: 哥白尼的《天体运行论》在纽伦堡出版，将地球置于绕太阳运行的行星之列，并以地球自转解释日周运动。该体系仍使用圆周和本轮，起初并未立即取代旧天文学。它为后来开普勒、伽利略与牛顿的研究提供了重新讨论天体运动的框架。
summary.en: Copernicus’s On the Revolutions of the Heavenly Spheres appeared in Nuremberg, treating Earth as a planet moving around the Sun and explaining daily celestial motion through Earth’s rotation. The model retained circles and epicycles and did not immediately displace older astronomy. It nevertheless provided a new framework that later researchers, including Kepler, Galileo and Newton, transformed substantially.

significance.zh: 它推动了对地球位置和天体运动解释的根本改变。
significance.en: It helped transform explanations of Earth’s position and celestial motion.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Copernicus publishes the heliocentric model

title.en: Development of the Potosí silver mines

summary.zh: 西班牙殖民者开始大规模开发波托西富银山，城市随后成为全球白银生产中心之一。采矿、汞齐冶炼和强制性的米塔劳役制度使大量原住民付出沉重代价。白银通过大西洋及跨太平洋贸易进入欧洲和亚洲，将安第斯矿区连接到更广阔的货币网络。
summary.en: Large-scale colonial exploitation of silver at Potosí began in the mid-sixteenth century, turning the settlement into a major mining centre. Mining, mercury-based processing and the coercive mita labour system imposed heavy costs on Indigenous communities. Silver circulated through Atlantic and Pacific trading networks to Europe and Asia, connecting the Andean mining region to expanding systems of commerce and money.

significance.zh: 波托西展示了早期全球贸易与殖民强迫劳动之间的紧密联系。
significance.en: Potosí reveals the close connection between early global trade and colonial forced labour.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — City of Potosí

summary.zh: 天主教会在特伦托及短暂迁至博洛尼亚期间举行多届会议，回应新教改革并整顿教会内部事务。会议重申教义、圣礼和传统的权威，也推动神学院教育及主教纪律改革。地图以主要会址特伦托表示，决议的执行则在不同地区持续展开。
summary.en: The Catholic Church held successive sessions at Trent, with a temporary transfer to Bologna, responding to Protestant challenges and internal demands for reform. The council reaffirmed doctrine, sacraments and the authority of tradition while promoting seminaries and stronger episcopal discipline. Trent marks the principal meeting place; implementation varied across regions and continued long after the final session.

significance.zh: 它为近世天主教改革与教派分化确立了重要制度框架。
significance.en: It established a major institutional framework for Catholic reform and confessional division.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Council of Trent

summary.zh: 跨太平洋返航路线确立后，西属菲律宾与墨西哥之间形成长期大帆船贸易，马尼拉建城后成为关键枢纽。美洲白银换取中国丝绸、瓷器及其他亚洲商品，商人、船员和移民也参与其中。时间范围表示传统所称贸易时代，地图点代表马尼拉港。
summary.en: After a workable eastward Pacific route was established, regular galleon commerce linked the Spanish Philippines with Mexico, with Manila becoming its major Asian hub after the city’s foundation. American silver exchanged for Chinese silk, porcelain and other Asian goods. Merchants, sailors and migrants connected these markets and communities. The date range describes the conventional trading era, represented geographically by Manila.

significance.zh: 这一航线把亚洲、美洲及欧洲市场持续联系起来。
significance.en: The route sustained connections among Asian, American and European markets.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Manila galleon trade

title.zh: 摩洛哥入侵与桑海帝国衰落

summary.zh: 摩洛哥萨阿德王朝军队穿越撒哈拉，在通迪比击败桑海军队，随后占据加奥与廷巴克图等城市。此次远征与黄金、盐和跨撒哈拉贸易的控制有关。它削弱了桑海帝国的中央权力，但没有让西非政治社会立即消失，地方抵抗与新政权继续发展。
summary.en: A Moroccan Saadian army crossed the Sahara and defeated Songhai forces at Tondibi before occupying major towns, including Gao and Timbuktu. Control of gold, salt and trans-Saharan commerce helped motivate the campaign. The invasion undermined Songhai’s central authority but did not erase West African political life: resistance, regional governments and changing commercial networks continued after the imperial collapse.

significance.zh: 西非萨赫勒的帝国格局与跨撒哈拉贸易权力发生重大转变。
significance.en: Imperial power in the western Sahel and control of trans-Saharan trade changed substantially.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Moroccan invasion and Songhai’s decline

title.zh: 英国东印度公司获特许状
title.en: Charter of the English East India Company

summary.zh: 伊丽莎白一世向英国东印度公司颁发王室特许状，赋予其在规定范围内经营亚洲贸易的权利。公司最初是商业组织，后来逐步建立军队、税收与领土统治。伦敦点代表公司成立地点，其影响跨越印度洋，并在十八、十九世纪深刻改变南亚社会。
summary.en: Elizabeth I granted a royal charter to the English East India Company, authorizing trade in a defined eastern commercial sphere. Initially a trading enterprise, the company later acquired armies, revenue rights and territorial authority. London represents its foundation rather than the location of all its activities. Its transformation over subsequent centuries profoundly affected societies across the Indian Ocean, especially South Asia.

significance.zh: 它体现了特许公司从远洋商业组织向殖民统治机构的转变。
significance.en: It exemplifies the transformation of chartered commerce into colonial government.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Charter of the English East India Company

summary.zh: 德川家康在关原之战后取得优势，获任征夷大将军，以江户为政治中心建立幕府。大名、武士与朝廷被纳入新的权力秩序，之后逐步实行参勤交代及对外贸易管制。江户时期长期相对稳定，也伴随城市、商业、出版与地方文化的发展。
summary.en: After consolidating his position following Sekigahara, Tokugawa Ieyasu received the title of shogun and established a government centred on Edo. Subsequent rulers organized relations among daimyo, warriors and the imperial court, while regulating travel and foreign commerce. The Edo period brought prolonged relative stability alongside expanding cities, markets, publishing and regional cultural activity, rather than complete isolation from the world.

significance.zh: 德川体制为日本两个多世纪的政治与社会发展奠定基础。
significance.en: The Tokugawa order shaped more than two centuries of Japanese political and social development.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Establishment of the Tokugawa shogunate

summary.zh: 伽利略改进望远镜并观测月面、银河及木星卫星，次年以《星际信使》公布部分结果。这些发现挑战了天界完美不变以及所有天体都绕地球运动的观念，但并未单独证明地球绕日运行。帕多瓦代表其任教与开展早期观测工作的地点。
summary.en: Galileo improved the telescope and observed the Moon’s surface, the Milky Way and satellites of Jupiter, publishing major results in Sidereus Nuncius. These observations challenged assumptions about perfect, unchanging heavens and the claim that every celestial body circled Earth. They did not by themselves prove Earth’s orbit around the Sun. Padua represents his teaching base and early observational work.

significance.zh: 仪器观测开始在天文学理论争论中发挥新的决定性作用。
significance.en: Instrument-based observation assumed a powerful new role in astronomical debate.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Galileo’s telescopic observations

summary.zh: 波希米亚的政治宗教冲突扩展为席卷中欧的长期战争，哈布斯堡诸国、瑞典、法国及众多德意志邦国先后卷入。战争不只是天主教与新教对抗，也涉及王朝和国际权力竞争。军事行动、疫病和饥荒重创平民，布拉格作为冲突起点的代表。
summary.en: A political and religious crisis in Bohemia developed into prolonged warfare across central Europe, involving Habsburg powers, Sweden, France and numerous German states. Confessional divisions mattered, but dynastic interests and international power struggles also shaped shifting alliances. Campaigns, disease and famine devastated civilian communities. Prague represents the conflict’s initial crisis, not the geographical extent of the entire war.

significance.zh: 战争推动欧洲国家关系调整，也留下深刻的人口与社会创伤。
significance.en: The war reshaped European power relations and left profound demographic and social damage.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Thirty Years’ War

summary.zh: 李自成军攻入北京、明崇祯帝死亡后，清军经山海关入关并占领北京，顺治帝随后迁都。此年是明清政权更替的关键节点，却不是清朝建立之年，也非征服全国的终点。南明及其他抵抗延续多年，新的统治秩序经历长期战争与制度整合。
summary.en: After Li Zicheng’s forces captured Beijing and the Chongzhen emperor died, Qing armies entered through Shanhai Pass and occupied the capital. The Shunzhi emperor subsequently moved his court there. The year marks a pivotal transfer of power, not the dynasty’s original founding or the completion of conquest. Southern Ming regimes and other resistance continued as Qing rule expanded through warfare and institutional consolidation.

significance.zh: 北京的政权更替成为清朝统治中国内地的关键起点。
significance.en: The transfer of Beijing was a pivotal step in Qing rule over China proper.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Qing occupation of Beijing

summary.zh: 在明斯特和奥斯纳布吕克达成的一组条约结束了三十年战争的主要战事，并调整神圣罗马帝国内部的政治宗教安排。各方还承认部分国家的独立地位。它是欧洲外交史的重要节点，但将现代主权国家体系完全归因于单一条约，属于过度简化。
summary.en: Treaties negotiated at Münster and Osnabrück ended the main conflict of the Thirty Years’ War and revised political and religious arrangements within the Holy Roman Empire. They also recognized the independence of certain states. The settlements were important diplomatic landmarks, but the familiar claim that modern sovereignty suddenly originated in 1648 oversimplifies a much longer and uneven historical development.

significance.zh: 和约建立了新的欧洲权力安排，并成为后世主权论述的重要参照。
significance.en: The settlements rearranged European power and became a major reference in later discussions of sovereignty.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Peace of Westphalia

title.zh: 牛顿发表《自然哲学的数学原理》

summary.zh: 牛顿出版《自然哲学的数学原理》，以运动定律和万有引力把地面运动与天体运动纳入共同数学框架。该书综合并改造了前人的观测与理论成果，使用几何论证处理轨道、潮汐等问题。其解释范围极为广泛，但后来相对论揭示了经典力学的适用边界。
summary.en: Newton published the Principia, combining laws of motion and universal gravitation in a mathematical account of terrestrial and celestial phenomena. The work synthesized and transformed earlier observations and theories, using geometrical reasoning to address orbits, tides and related problems. Its framework achieved extraordinary explanatory reach, although later relativity clarified the limits within which classical mechanics provides an accurate description.

significance.zh: 它成为近代数学物理与工程力学的基础之一。
significance.en: It became a foundation of modern mathematical physics and engineering mechanics.

sources.title: Library of Congress — Newton, Principia, 1687

title.zh: 英国光荣革命与权利法案
title.en: Glorious Revolution and Bill of Rights

summary.zh: 威廉率军进入英格兰后，詹姆斯二世出逃，议会将王位授予威廉与玛丽，并通过《权利法案》限制王权。此过程涉及宗教排斥和利益联盟，在爱尔兰、苏格兰还伴随战争。因此“光荣”是传统名称，不意味着整个不列颠诸岛都经历了和平且平等的转型。
summary.en: William’s intervention in England was followed by James II’s flight and Parliament’s offer of the crown to William and Mary. The Bill of Rights restricted royal powers and strengthened parliamentary authority. Religious exclusions remained, and conflict in Ireland and Scotland accompanied the settlement. The traditional label “Glorious Revolution” therefore does not describe a uniformly peaceful or egalitarian transformation across the islands.

significance.zh: 它加强了议会在英国宪政秩序中的地位。
significance.en: It strengthened Parliament’s position within the British constitutional order.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Glorious Revolution and Bill of Rights

summary.zh: 狄德罗、达朗贝尔及众多作者组织编纂《百科全书》，将科学、工艺与思想知识编成可检索的条目和图版。工程面对审查、宗教与政治压力仍持续推进。其核心文本和图版在这一时期陆续出版，后续增补另行发展，巴黎代表主要编辑出版中心。
summary.en: Diderot, d’Alembert and a large network of contributors organized the Encyclopédie, presenting science, crafts and intellectual debate through articles and illustrated plates. The project continued despite censorship and political and religious opposition. This range covers publication of the principal text and plate volumes; later supplements belong to a further history. Paris represents the main editorial and publishing centre.

significance.zh: 知识的分类、传播和批判性讨论成为启蒙文化的重要力量。
significance.en: The classification, circulation and criticism of knowledge became central forces in Enlightenment culture.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Publication of the Encyclopédie

summary.zh: 欧洲列强的联盟对抗与海外殖民竞争相互交织，形成跨越欧洲、北美、加勒比和南亚的战争。通常以一七五六年至一七六三年为主体时段，北美相关战事更早开始。英国和普鲁士分别在不同战区获益，战争债务与帝国扩张又引发后续政治危机。
summary.en: European alliance conflicts merged with overseas imperial competition in a war spanning Europe, North America, the Caribbean and South Asia. The conventional 1756–1763 dates cover its principal phase; related fighting in North America began earlier. Britain and Prussia gained in different theatres, while war debts and imperial expansion created new tensions. Berlin is a representative point, not a unique centre.

significance.zh: 跨洲战争重组了殖民权力，并为后来的革命增加财政压力。
significance.en: The intercontinental war redistributed imperial power and intensified fiscal pressures preceding later revolutions.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Seven Years’ War

summary.zh: 罗伯特·克莱武指挥的东印度公司军队在普拉西击败孟加拉纳瓦布西拉杰·乌德·达乌拉。战前阴谋、关键将领的不参战及商业利益共同决定结果。胜利扩大了公司的政治影响，取得正式税收权则是之后的事情，不能将这一战等同于立即征服整个印度。
summary.en: East India Company forces commanded by Robert Clive defeated Bengal’s nawab, Siraj al-Dawlah, at Plassey. Conspiracy, commercial interests and the refusal of key commanders to fight shaped the outcome. The victory increased the company’s political influence in Bengal, while formal revenue authority came later. It was an important step toward colonial rule, not an immediate conquest of all India.

significance.zh: 公司商业势力由此更深地介入南亚政权与财政。
significance.en: Company commerce became more deeply entangled with South Asian political and fiscal power.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Battle of Plassey

summary.zh: 英国在十八世纪后期到十九世纪前期经历纺织机械化、蒸汽动力、煤铁工业及工厂生产扩张。起讫年代是概括性分期，各行业和地区速度不同。曼彻斯特代表工业城市的发展；产能增长同时伴随劳动纪律、童工、污染和城市公共卫生等社会问题。
summary.en: Britain experienced expanding mechanized textiles, steam power, coal and iron production and factory organization from the later eighteenth into the nineteenth century. These dates are a conventional periodization, not precise boundaries shared by every industry. Manchester represents industrial urbanization. Rising output accompanied new labour discipline, child labour, pollution and public-health problems, making industrialization a social transformation as well as a technological one.

significance.zh: 工业化改变了生产、能源利用与日常劳动的规模和方式。
significance.en: Industrialization transformed the scale and organization of production, energy use and everyday labour.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Industrial Revolution in Britain

title.zh: 库克考察澳大利亚东海岸

summary.zh: 库克的奋进号航行至澳大利亚东海岸，进行测绘并代表英国提出领土主张。原住民在此已生活数万年，登陆和接触不能称为发现无人大陆。博塔尼湾为代表地点，此次航行后来与英国殖民计划相连，也成为原住民与殖民历史记忆冲突的重要节点。
summary.en: James Cook’s Endeavour surveyed Australia’s eastern coast and claimed territory for Britain. Aboriginal peoples had lived there for tens of thousands of years, so the voyage did not discover an uninhabited continent. Botany Bay serves as a representative location for a much longer coastal journey. The expedition later informed British colonization and remains significant in contested memories of contact and dispossession.

significance.zh: 测绘与帝国主张为后续英国殖民扩张提供条件。
significance.en: Surveying and imperial claims helped prepare the way for subsequent British colonization.

sources.title: National Museum of Australia — Cook claims Australia

summary.zh: 北美十三个英国殖民地的代表在费城通过《独立宣言》，主张脱离英国统治并陈述政治权利原则。独立战争此前已经开始，英国正式承认美国独立则在一七八三年。宣言中的平等语言与仍然存在的奴隶制、原住民剥夺及女性权利限制形成明显张力。
summary.en: Representatives of thirteen British colonies adopted the Declaration of Independence in Philadelphia, asserting separation from Britain and articulating principles of political rights. Fighting had already begun, and British recognition of independence followed only in 1783. The declaration’s language of equality coexisted with slavery, dispossession of Indigenous peoples and restrictions on women’s rights, contradictions later reform movements repeatedly challenged.

significance.zh: 它成为共和政治与权利诉求的重要文本，也留下持续争论。
significance.en: It became an influential statement of republican government and rights, while leaving enduring contradictions.

sources.title: US National Archives — Declaration of Independence

title.en: First Fleet arrives at Sydney Cove

summary.zh: 英国第一舰队在悉尼湾建立流放殖民地，移送囚犯、军人和官员，开启新南威尔士的持续殖民统治。当地并非无人居住，殖民扩张造成土地剥夺、暴力与疾病传播。这个日期在澳大利亚公共记忆中具有不同意义，原住民也以入侵和幸存的历史理解它。
summary.en: Britain’s First Fleet established a penal settlement at Sydney Cove, bringing convicts, military personnel and officials and beginning sustained colonial rule in New South Wales. The country was already inhabited, and colonial expansion brought dispossession, violence and disease. The date consequently carries different meanings in Australian public memory, including Indigenous understandings of invasion, survival and continuing connections to country.

significance.zh: 它开启澳大利亚持续的英国殖民统治及其深远社会后果。
significance.en: It began sustained British colonization in Australia and its far-reaching social consequences.

sources.title: National Museum of Australia — The First Fleet arrives at Sydney Cove

summary.zh: 财政危机、等级不平等与政治动员促成法国大革命，旧制度被推翻，公民权利、共和制度和大众政治成为争论中心。革命经历立宪、共和、恐怖统治与督政府等阶段，并与对外战争交织。巴黎代表主要政治中心，不意味着革命只发生在首都。
summary.en: Fiscal crisis, social inequalities and political mobilization drove the French Revolution, dismantling the old regime and bringing citizenship, republicanism and mass politics into intense debate. The revolution passed through constitutional monarchy, republic, the Terror and the Directory while interacting with foreign war and regional conflict. Paris represents a principal political centre; change and violence extended far beyond the capital.

significance.zh: 革命扩展了公民与平等观念，也展示了政治激进化的复杂代价。
significance.en: The revolution expanded ideas of citizenship and equality while revealing the costs of political radicalization.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — French Revolution

summary.zh: 圣多明各被奴役者发动起义，随后在殖民战争、法国革命与当地族群阶层冲突中争取自由。杜桑·卢维杜尔及后继领导人组织抵抗，最终建立独立海地并废除奴隶制。海地革命的成果来自长期集体斗争，其后还遭受外交孤立和沉重的外部经济压力。
summary.en: Enslaved people in Saint-Domingue rose in revolt, pursuing freedom amid colonial warfare, the French Revolution and conflicts among local social groups. Toussaint Louverture and subsequent leaders organized resistance that ultimately produced independent Haiti and the abolition of slavery. The outcome emerged from prolonged collective struggle rather than a single leader’s actions. Diplomatic isolation and external financial pressures burdened the new state afterward.

significance.zh: 它把反奴役斗争转化为独立国家，改变了大西洋革命的意义。
significance.en: It turned a struggle against enslavement into an independent state and transformed Atlantic revolutionary history.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Haitian Revolution

title.zh: 詹纳开展牛痘接种实验

summary.zh: 爱德华·詹纳在伯克利利用牛痘材料开展接种实验，研究其对天花的保护作用。此前亚洲、非洲与奥斯曼地区已有多种人痘接种实践，他并非最早尝试预防天花的人。牛痘疫苗的传播与后续改进，为更大规模的免疫和最终消灭天花提供了基础。
summary.en: Edward Jenner experimented with cowpox material at Berkeley to investigate protection against smallpox. Earlier communities in Asia, Africa and the Ottoman world had already practised forms of variolation, so he was not the first person to attempt prevention. The dissemination and improvement of vaccination nevertheless created a crucial basis for large-scale immunization and the eventual worldwide eradication of smallpox.

significance.zh: 牛痘接种成为现代疫苗史的重要转折。
significance.en: Cowpox vaccination became a major turning point in the history of modern vaccines.

sources.title: World Health Organization — Smallpox

summary.zh: 法国颁布统一的民法典，确立财产权、契约和法律面前形式平等等原则，整合革命后的法律秩序。法典同时强化丈夫和父亲的家庭权威，限制女性的法律自主性。它借助征服、移植与后来的法律改革传播，影响范围远超过拿破仑统治时期的法国。
summary.en: France promulgated a unified civil code regulating property, contracts and formal equality before the law, consolidating aspects of the post-revolutionary legal order. The code also strengthened husbands’ and fathers’ authority and restricted women’s legal autonomy. Through conquest, adaptation and later reform, its influence spread well beyond Napoleonic France, making it both a vehicle of legal modernization and a structure of exclusion.

significance.zh: 它成为许多国家民法编纂的参照，但其平等具有明显边界。
significance.en: It became a reference for civil codification in many countries, although its equality had clear limits.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Promulgation of the Napoleonic Code

title.zh: 英国废除跨大西洋奴隶贸易

summary.zh: 英国议会通过法律，禁止英国臣民参与奴隶贸易。这是被奴役者抵抗、废奴运动和政治变化共同推动的结果，但法律并未同时解放殖民地奴隶，也未立即终结非法贩运。伦敦代表立法地点，贸易和执法的实际空间横跨非洲、美洲与大西洋。
summary.en: The British Parliament prohibited British participation in the slave trade after sustained resistance by enslaved people, abolitionist campaigning and political change. The law did not simultaneously emancipate enslaved people in British colonies, nor did it immediately eliminate illegal trafficking. London represents the legislative decision, while the trade and subsequent enforcement involved African and American societies across the Atlantic.

significance.zh: 废止奴隶贸易与废除奴隶制度是相互关联却不同的历史步骤。
significance.en: Ending the slave trade and ending slavery were connected but distinct historical processes.

sources.title: UK Parliament — Abolition of the slave trade

summary.zh: 西班牙王室危机与殖民地内部矛盾推动美洲多地建立自治机构并爆发独立战争。玻利瓦尔、圣马丁及众多地方军民参与斗争，不同地区道路和结局各异。此范围概括主要大陆独立浪潮，不涵盖所有后续殖民地；加拉加斯作为北部运动的代表点。
summary.en: The crisis of the Spanish monarchy and tensions within its American colonies encouraged local governing juntas and wars for independence. Bolívar, San Martín and many regional forces participated, but different societies followed distinct paths. This range summarizes the principal mainland wave, not the independence of every Spanish possession. Caracas represents one northern centre in a struggle spanning much of the continent.

significance.zh: 西属美洲的帝国版图转化为多个新国家及新的政治冲突。
significance.en: Spanish America’s imperial map gave way to multiple new states and new political struggles.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Spanish American independence wars

summary.zh: 拿破仑战争末期，欧洲列强在维也纳协商领土调整、王朝恢复和均势安排。会议形成的秩序试图防止法国再次独霸，也限制革命与民族主义运动。其影响延续数十年，但欧洲并未因此停止战争，殖民地和多数普通民众亦没有平等参与谈判。
summary.en: European powers met in Vienna near the end of the Napoleonic Wars to negotiate territorial changes, dynastic restoration and a balance of power. The resulting settlement sought to prevent renewed French domination and contain revolutionary and nationalist movements. Its influence lasted for decades, but it did not end warfare, and colonized peoples and most ordinary Europeans had no equal voice in the negotiations.

significance.zh: 它确立了十九世纪欧洲外交与领土秩序的重要基础。
significance.en: It provided a major foundation for nineteenth-century European diplomacy and territorial arrangements.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Congress of Vienna

summary.zh: 今印度尼西亚松巴哇岛的坦博拉火山发生巨大喷发，附近居民遭受火山灾害、饥荒与疾病。进入平流层的物质影响全球气候，次年一些地区出现异常寒冷与歉收，即所谓无夏之年。影响具有地域差异，不能把全球所有一八一六年的困难都归于火山。
summary.en: Mount Tambora on Sumbawa, in present-day Indonesia, erupted catastrophically, causing immediate destruction and subsequent hunger and disease. Material reaching the stratosphere affected global climate, contributing to unusual cold and crop failures in several regions during the following “year without a summer.” Effects varied geographically, and the eruption should not be treated as the sole cause of every hardship recorded in 1816.

significance.zh: 区域自然灾害通过大气系统产生了全球性的社会影响。
significance.en: A regional natural disaster produced worldwide social consequences through the atmosphere.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Eruption of Mount Tambora

summary.zh: 法国军队登陆并攻占阿尔及尔，开启后来持续数十年的征服和殖民扩张。对城市的占领不等于立即控制整个阿尔及利亚，阿卜杜勒·卡迪尔等领导人组织长期抵抗。殖民统治随后伴随土地征用、欧洲移民定居和对本地居民实行不平等的法律制度。
summary.en: French forces landed in Algeria and captured Algiers, beginning decades of conquest and colonial expansion. Taking the city did not mean immediate control of the entire country; Abd al-Qadir and other leaders organized prolonged resistance. Colonial rule subsequently involved land appropriation, European settlement and unequal legal treatment of local populations, developments whose effects persisted well into the twentieth century.

significance.zh: 它开启了法国在北非持续一百多年的殖民统治。
significance.en: It began more than a century of French colonial rule in North Africa.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — French invasion of Algeria

title.en: Slavery Abolition Act in the British Empire

summary.zh: 英国一八三三年通过废奴法，次年开始在多数殖民地实施，但许多获释者被迫进入“学徒制”，到一八三八年才结束。法律存在地域例外，补偿主要支付给奴隶主而非被奴役者。此事件应理解为分阶段的解放过程，而非单日实现完整平等。
summary.en: Britain passed the Slavery Abolition Act in 1833, with implementation beginning in most colonies the following year. Many formerly enslaved people were compelled into an apprenticeship system that lasted until 1838. Geographic exceptions remained, and compensation went chiefly to slave owners rather than the enslaved. Emancipation was therefore a staged and contested process, not the immediate achievement of social equality.

significance.zh: 法律废奴开启了新的自由劳动与公民权斗争，而非终结不平等。
significance.en: Legal abolition opened new struggles over free labour and citizenship rather than ending inequality.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Slavery Abolition Act in the British Empire

summary.zh: 清政府禁烟行动与英国维护商业利益的军事干预引发战争。英国凭借海军与武器优势取得胜利，《南京条约》规定赔款、开放通商口岸并割让香港岛。广州为主要冲突地区的代表点，战争及条约改变了中国对外关系，并加深了清朝面临的财政与政治压力。
summary.en: Qing efforts to suppress the opium trade and British military intervention in defence of commercial interests led to war. British naval and military advantages produced victory, followed by the Treaty of Nanjing, indemnities, treaty ports and the cession of Hong Kong Island. Guangzhou represents a major theatre, while the conflict and settlement altered China’s foreign relations and intensified pressures on the Qing state.

significance.zh: 战争开启了中国近代条约口岸体系与新的帝国主义干预阶段。
significance.en: The war opened China’s treaty-port system and a new phase of imperial intervention.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — First Opium War

title.en: Signing of the Treaty of Waitangi

summary.zh: 英国王室代表与部分毛利首领在怀唐伊签署条约，随后更多首领签署不同文本。毛利文与英文对治理权、主权及首领权威的表述存在重大差异。条约成为新西兰政治关系的重要基础，也因土地剥夺和违约引发长期争议、抵抗与后来寻求补偿的程序。
summary.en: Representatives of the British Crown and Māori chiefs signed an agreement at Waitangi, with further signatures collected afterward. Māori and English texts differed significantly in their treatment of governance, sovereignty and chiefly authority. The treaty became central to New Zealand’s political relationships, while dispossession and breaches generated prolonged dispute, resistance and later processes seeking recognition and redress.

significance.zh: 条约文本差异与履约问题持续影响新西兰的宪政和原住民权利。
significance.en: Differences between treaty texts and questions of compliance continue to shape constitutional and Indigenous rights issues.

sources.title: NZHistory — Treaty of Waitangi

summary.zh: 经济困难、政治压制与民族诉求促成法国、德意志、意大利和哈布斯堡领地的革命浪潮。参与者包括工人、自由派、民族主义者和农民，但他们的目标并不一致。许多革命最终被镇压，部分社会改革却保留下来，巴黎只是这一跨地区运动的代表地点。
summary.en: Economic hardship, political repression and national aspirations helped trigger revolutions in France, the German states, Italy and Habsburg territories. Workers, liberals, nationalists and peasants participated with differing and sometimes conflicting goals. Many revolutionary governments were defeated, yet some reforms survived and political expectations changed. Paris represents one centre of a wave whose trajectories varied substantially across Europe.

significance.zh: 革命使社会问题、宪政与民族国家诉求进入更广泛的大众政治。
significance.en: The revolutions brought social questions, constitutionalism and national aspirations into wider popular politics.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — European revolutions of 1848

summary.zh: 洪秀全领导的宗教政治运动在华南兴起，太平军于一八五三年占领南京并建立与清廷对抗的政权。运动提出激进的社会和宗教主张，内部制度与实际执行存在差距。持续战争、饥荒与疫病造成巨大伤亡，也促使清朝地方军事和财政权力进一步扩大。
summary.en: Hong Xiuquan’s religious and political movement emerged in southern China, captured Nanjing in 1853 and established a rival government to the Qing. It advanced radical social and religious claims, though practice did not consistently follow proclaimed ideals. Prolonged fighting, famine and disease caused catastrophic losses. The struggle also strengthened regional military and fiscal institutions within the Qing political system.

significance.zh: 它是十九世纪最具破坏性的内战之一，并改变了清朝权力结构。
significance.en: It was among the nineteenth century’s most destructive civil wars and altered Qing power structures.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Taiping Rebellion

summary.zh: 俄国与奥斯曼帝国的冲突扩展为英国、法国等国参与的战争，主要战场包括克里米亚和黑海周边。宗教保护权争议与欧洲均势竞争相互交织。伤病和后勤问题造成大量死亡，战地护理、新闻报道及军事管理改革因而受到更广泛关注。
summary.en: Conflict between Russia and the Ottoman Empire expanded into a war involving Britain, France and other powers, with major fighting around Crimea and the Black Sea. Religious protection claims interacted with competition over the European balance of power. Disease and logistical failures caused immense losses, drawing attention to battlefield nursing, war reporting and military administration. Sevastopol represents the principal siege theatre.

significance.zh: 战争暴露军事与公共卫生制度缺陷，并推动俄国等国改革。
significance.en: The war exposed weaknesses in military and public-health systems and encouraged reform, including in Russia.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Crimean War

title.zh: 印度起义与公司统治终结
title.en: Indian Rebellion and the end of company rule

summary.zh: 东印度公司军队中的士兵起义扩展为北印度多地反抗，土地、宗教、军队待遇及殖民兼并等不满交织。不同参与者的诉求并不统一，也并非所有地区都加入。镇压之后，英国王室接管公司在印度的统治，殖民军政制度随之重组。
summary.en: A mutiny among East India Company soldiers developed into wider rebellion across parts of northern India, drawing on grievances over land, religion, military treatment and colonial annexation. Participants did not share a single programme, and many regions remained outside the uprising. After violent suppression, the British Crown assumed government from the company and reorganized colonial military and political institutions.

significance.zh: 它终结了公司在印度的直接统治，开启英国王室统治阶段。
significance.en: It ended direct company government in India and inaugurated Crown rule.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Indian Rebellion and the end of company rule

title.en: Publication of On the Origin of Species

summary.zh: 达尔文出版《物种起源》，以自然选择解释生物适应与物种变化，综合航行观察、育种研究和长期资料积累。华莱士独立提出相近思想，两人的相关论文此前已共同发表。该书引发科学和宗教争论，进化论后来又与遗传学结合并不断发展。
summary.en: Darwin published On the Origin of Species, explaining adaptation and evolutionary change through natural selection and drawing on observations, breeding studies and extensive correspondence. Alfred Russel Wallace had independently developed a similar idea, and their accounts were presented jointly the previous year. The book stimulated scientific and religious debate; evolutionary theory subsequently developed through genetics and many further discoveries.

significance.zh: 自然选择为理解生命多样性提供了统一而可研究的机制。
significance.en: Natural selection supplied a unifying, investigable mechanism for understanding biological diversity.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Publication of On the Origin of Species

summary.zh: 亚历山大二世颁布改革，结束大量私人庄园农奴对地主的人身依附。农民获得一定法律权利，但土地分配、赎买负担和村社制度限制了实际改善；国家农民等群体的改革另有进程。圣彼得堡代表中央决策地，实施影响遍及俄罗斯帝国广大农村。
summary.en: Alexander II’s reform ended personal bondage for millions of serfs on privately owned estates. Peasants gained legal rights, but land allocations, redemption obligations and communal arrangements constrained the practical benefits. Other groups, including state peasants, followed different reform schedules. Saint Petersburg represents the imperial decision-making centre, while implementation affected rural communities across large areas of the Russian Empire.

significance.zh: 人身解放并未自动解决土地与贫困问题，却改变了帝国社会基础。
significance.en: Personal emancipation did not automatically resolve land and poverty problems, but it changed the empire’s social foundations.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Emancipation of Russian serfs

title.zh: 美国内战与奴隶制废除
title.en: American Civil War and abolition of slavery

summary.zh: 围绕奴隶制扩张与存续的冲突导致南方州脱离联邦，随后爆发内战。联邦胜利维护国家统一，战争期间的解放政策及第十三修正案终结了法律上的奴隶制。黑人军人和被奴役者自我解放发挥重要作用，但重建时期及之后仍存在严重种族压迫。
summary.en: Conflict over the expansion and survival of slavery drove southern secession and civil war. Union victory preserved the United States, while wartime emancipation policies and the Thirteenth Amendment ended legal slavery. Black soldiers and enslaved people pursuing their own freedom played essential roles. Abolition did not establish lasting racial equality, and Reconstruction and its aftermath involved continuing struggles over citizenship and power.

significance.zh: 战争实现国家统一与法律废奴，随后开启未完成的平等权利斗争。
significance.en: The war preserved the Union and abolished slavery, opening an unfinished struggle for equal rights.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — American Civil War and abolition of slavery

title.zh: 红十字运动与第一部日内瓦公约
title.en: Red Cross movement and the first Geneva Convention

summary.zh: 受索尔费里诺战场伤员遭遇启发，日内瓦成立后来发展为红十字国际委员会的组织，并召开国际会议。次年通过首部《日内瓦公约》，要求保护战地医疗服务并照顾伤员。其最初范围较窄，后来多次扩充，逐步形成现代国际人道法的重要组成部分。
summary.en: Inspired by the suffering of wounded soldiers at Solferino, a Geneva committee helped organize international cooperation for battlefield relief. The first Geneva Convention followed in 1864, protecting medical services and requiring care for wounded soldiers. Its initial scope was limited, but later revisions and additional agreements expanded the framework, making these initiatives central to modern international humanitarian law.

significance.zh: 跨国人道救援与战争行为的法律限制获得制度基础。
significance.en: International humanitarian relief and legal restraints on warfare gained an institutional foundation.

sources.title: ICRC — Founding and early years

summary.zh: 反幕府力量宣布恢复天皇统治，德川政权瓦解，日本随后推进废藩置县、征兵、教育与工业等改革。维新并非一日完成，制度重建伴随戊辰战争和其他抵抗。京都代表政权转换的象征地点，政治中心随后迁至东京，国家力量及对外扩张能力显著增强。
summary.en: Opponents of the Tokugawa government proclaimed the restoration of imperial rule, followed by reforms in administration, conscription, education and industry. The transformation was not completed in a single year: the Boshin War and further resistance accompanied institutional reconstruction. Kyoto represents the symbolic political transition, while the centre of government shifted to Tokyo and Japan’s capacity for state-building and imperial expansion increased.

significance.zh: 日本从幕藩体制转向中央集权国家，并迅速参与全球工业与帝国竞争。
significance.en: Japan moved from shogunal government toward a centralized state participating in industrial and imperial competition.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Meiji Restoration

summary.zh: 苏伊士运河正式通航，在地中海与红海之间建立直接海路，减少欧洲往返亚洲的航行距离。工程依赖大量劳动力和国际资本，也与埃及债务及欧洲势力干预相连。运河改变了全球航运布局，后来多次成为战争、殖民控制和国家主权争议的焦点。
summary.en: The Suez Canal opened a direct shipping passage between the Mediterranean and Red Sea, shortening many routes between Europe and Asia. Its construction depended on extensive labour and international capital and became entangled with Egyptian debt and European intervention. The canal reorganized global maritime commerce and subsequently became a recurrent focus of warfare, colonial control and struggles over national sovereignty.

significance.zh: 它重组全球海运，也使埃及处于更激烈的国际权力竞争中。
significance.en: It reshaped world shipping and placed Egypt at the centre of intensified international competition.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Opening of the Suez Canal

summary.zh: 普法战争期间，德意志帝国在凡尔赛宫宣告成立，普鲁士国王威廉一世成为皇帝。统一由普鲁士主导，并不包括所有德语居民地区；新的帝国保留各邦结构，同时强化共同军事与政治制度。其出现显著改变欧洲力量平衡，也增加了法德之间的长期紧张。
summary.en: During the Franco-Prussian War, the German Empire was proclaimed at Versailles with Prussia’s Wilhelm I as emperor. Unification occurred under Prussian leadership and did not encompass all German-speaking regions. The empire retained federal states while strengthening common military and political institutions. Its emergence transformed the European balance of power and contributed to enduring tensions between Germany and France.

significance.zh: 一个新的工业军事强国改变了欧洲的外交结构。
significance.en: A new industrial and military power transformed Europe’s diplomatic structure.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Proclamation of the German Empire

title.zh: 贝尔取得电话专利并传输语音
title.en: Bell’s telephone patent and voice transmission

summary.zh: 亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔获得美国电话专利，并与托马斯·沃森完成清晰语音传输实验。电话的形成涉及多位发明者、专利争议和后续工程改进，不能归结为孤立的灵光一现。波士顿代表实验地点，商业网络随后逐步扩展，改变远距离交流方式。
summary.en: Alexander Graham Bell received a US telephone patent and, working with Thomas Watson, demonstrated intelligible voice transmission. The telephone emerged through contributions from multiple inventors, patent disputes and subsequent engineering improvements rather than a single isolated insight. Boston represents the experimental work. Commercial networks expanded gradually, changing business, household communication and expectations about the speed of contact across distance.

significance.zh: 语音通信网络开始改变商业组织与日常人际联系。
significance.en: Voice communication networks began transforming business organization and everyday social contact.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Bell’s telephone patent and voice transmission

title.zh: 柏林会议与非洲殖民瓜分
title.en: Berlin Conference and colonial partition of Africa

summary.zh: 欧洲列强及其他与会国在柏林讨论刚果盆地贸易、航行和殖民占领规则，非洲社会没有获得平等席位。会议不是一夜划定非洲全部边界，但促进了此后的帝国竞争与殖民扩张。地图以非洲区域归类，柏林坐标表示作出这些外部安排的会议地点。
summary.en: European powers and other participants met in Berlin to discuss trade, navigation and rules for colonial occupation in Africa, without equal African representation. The conference did not draw every African boundary at once, but it helped accelerate imperial competition and territorial conquest. This event is classified with Africa because of its consequences; the Berlin coordinate identifies the site of the external negotiations.

significance.zh: 会议成为殖民瓜分非洲的重要制度节点。
significance.en: The conference became an important institutional milestone in the colonial partition of Africa.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Berlin Conference and colonial partition of Africa

summary.zh: 巴西通过“黄金法”，在法律上废除奴隶制，成为美洲最后废奴的国家。决定来自被奴役者逃亡与抵抗、废奴主义动员和经济政治变化的共同作用。法律没有提供充分的土地、教育或生计保障，因此解放之后，黑人巴西人仍持续面对结构性不平等。
summary.en: Brazil’s Golden Law abolished slavery, making it the last country in the Americas to do so. Escapes and resistance by enslaved people, abolitionist mobilization and economic and political changes all contributed. The law did not provide adequate land, education or livelihood support, leaving formerly enslaved people to pursue freedom amid persistent structural inequality. Rio de Janeiro represents the imperial legislative centre.

significance.zh: 它结束美洲最后一个国家的合法奴隶制度，却未消除种族不平等。
significance.en: It ended legal slavery in the last American country to retain it without eliminating racial inequality.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Abolition of slavery in Brazil

title.zh: 新西兰妇女获得议会选举权
title.en: Women gain the parliamentary vote in New Zealand

summary.zh: 新西兰选举法赋予成年女性议会投票权，长期组织请愿的凯特·谢泼德等活动者发挥重要作用。新西兰因此成为首个在全国议会选举中赋予女性投票权的自治国家。投票权不等于所有政治权利同时实现，女性取得参选资格和更平等社会地位仍需后续斗争。
summary.en: New Zealand’s electoral law extended the parliamentary vote to adult women after sustained petitioning and campaigning, prominently associated with Kate Sheppard. It became the first self-governing country to grant women the vote in national parliamentary elections. Voting rights did not mean that all political and social inequalities disappeared: eligibility to stand for Parliament and broader equality required further campaigns.

significance.zh: 妇女参政运动获得具有全球示范意义的制度突破。
significance.en: The women’s suffrage movement achieved a major institutional breakthrough with global influence.

sources.title: NZHistory — New Zealand women and the vote

summary.zh: 孟尼利克二世率领的埃塞俄比亚军队在阿杜瓦击败意大利入侵军，迫使意大利承认埃塞俄比亚独立。胜利依靠广泛动员、外交采购和军事组织，也涉及当地复杂政治关系。此战成为反殖民抵抗的重要象征，但不意味着埃塞俄比亚此后不再面临侵略。
summary.en: Ethiopian forces under Menelik II defeated an invading Italian army at Adwa, compelling Italy to recognize Ethiopian independence. Broad mobilization, diplomacy, weapons procurement and military organization contributed to victory amid complex local political relationships. The battle became a powerful symbol of resistance to colonialism, although it did not end future threats: Italy invaded Ethiopia again in the twentieth century.

significance.zh: 它在非洲殖民扩张高峰期保住了埃塞俄比亚的国家独立。
significance.en: It preserved Ethiopian state independence at the height of colonial expansion in Africa.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Battle of Adwa

summary.zh: 贝克勒尔发现铀盐能使感光材料留下影像，即使没有阳光照射也能发生；居里夫妇随后系统研究放射现象并发现新的放射性元素。研究改变了原子不可分的传统观念，但健康危害当时尚未充分认识。巴黎代表这些相互联系的实验工作中心。
summary.en: Henri Becquerel found that uranium salts could expose photographic material without prior sunlight, and Marie and Pierre Curie subsequently investigated radioactivity and identified new radioactive elements. Their work challenged assumptions about stable, indivisible atoms and opened new research fields. The health hazards of radiation were not yet adequately understood. Paris represents a centre of these interconnected experimental investigations.

significance.zh: 放射性研究开启了原子物理、核技术与相关医学的新领域。
significance.en: Radioactivity research opened new fields in atomic physics, nuclear technology and medicine.

sources.title: Nobel Prize — Physics 1903

summary.zh: 六个英国殖民地联合组成澳大利亚联邦，在帝国框架内建立共同议会和联邦政府，各州保留部分权力。联邦成立并不等于立即取得后来意义上的完整独立。早期联邦制度也包含白澳政策和对原住民的排斥，统一国家的形成与平等公民权并未同步。
summary.en: Six British colonies united as the Commonwealth of Australia, creating a federal parliament and government while retaining state powers. Federation occurred within the British Empire and did not immediately deliver every aspect of later independence. Early federal institutions also entrenched racial exclusion through the White Australia policy and restrictions affecting Indigenous peoples, so national unification and equal citizenship did not advance together.

significance.zh: 联邦制度重组了澳大利亚治理，也保留了需要后来改革的排斥结构。
significance.en: Federation reorganized Australian government while preserving exclusions challenged by later reform.

sources.title: National Museum of Australia — Federation

title.zh: 爱因斯坦的奇迹年论文

summary.zh: 爱因斯坦在伯尔尼工作期间发表关于光量子、布朗运动、狭义相对论及质能关系的重要论文。这些研究分别回应不同物理问题，并非同一理论的简单展开。它们挑战经典时空观，支持物质微观结构的研究，也推动量子理论和现代物理学的发展。
summary.en: While working in Bern, Einstein published influential papers on light quanta, Brownian motion, special relativity and the relation between mass and energy. These addressed distinct physical problems rather than simply extending one theory. Together they challenged classical assumptions about space and time, strengthened investigations of microscopic matter and helped establish research directions that became central to twentieth-century physics.

significance.zh: 现代物理的时空、物质与辐射观念由此发生重大转变。
significance.en: Modern conceptions of space-time, matter and radiation underwent major changes.

sources.title: Nobel Prize — Albert Einstein, biographical

summary.zh: 反对迪亚斯长期统治的运动发展为多方参与的革命和内战，农民土地诉求、劳工权利与政治民主相互交织。萨帕塔、比利亚及其他力量目标不同，一九一七年宪法规定重要社会权利。此处采用常见的革命主要阶段分期，后续制度化和冲突仍延续。
summary.en: Opposition to Porfirio Díaz’s long rule developed into revolution and civil war involving rival political and military movements. Peasant demands for land, labour rights and democratic government overlapped but did not form one unified programme. The 1917 constitution established important social provisions. This conventional date range covers the principal revolutionary phase; institutional consolidation and further conflicts continued afterward.

significance.zh: 土地改革和社会权利成为二十世纪墨西哥国家建设的重要议题。
significance.en: Land reform and social rights became central issues in twentieth-century Mexican state-building.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Mexican Revolution

title.en: Xinhai Revolution and the end of Qing rule

summary.zh: 武昌起义引发多省脱离清廷，革命者、地方精英与军政力量在谈判和冲突中推动共和政体建立。中华民国于一九一二年成立，清帝随后退位。帝制终结没有立即产生稳定民主，中央与地方权力关系、民族国家构建及社会改革仍面临长期争议。
summary.en: The Wuchang uprising encouraged provinces to break with the Qing, while revolutionaries, local elites and military leaders negotiated and fought over a new order. The Republic of China was established in 1912, followed by the emperor’s abdication. Ending monarchy did not immediately produce stable democracy: central authority, regional power, nation-building and social reform remained deeply contested.

significance.zh: 中国两千余年的帝制政治形式终结，共和国家建设进入复杂阶段。
significance.en: China’s imperial political order ended, opening a contested era of republican state-building.

sources.title: 故宫博物院 — 辛亥革命 / Palace Museum — Xinhai Revolution

summary.zh: 巴拿马运河开通，以船闸连接大西洋和太平洋，大幅缩短若干重要航线。工程经历法国项目失败、美国接手和巴拿马政治变化，劳工死亡与疾病防治是其历史的重要部分。美国长期控制运河区，运河主权后来经条约谈判逐步移交给巴拿马。
summary.en: The Panama Canal opened a lock-based passage between the Atlantic and Pacific, shortening important shipping routes. Construction followed a failed French effort, US intervention and political change in Panama. Worker deaths and disease-control measures formed central parts of its history. The United States retained control of the Canal Zone for decades before treaties enabled the eventual transfer of authority to Panama.

significance.zh: 它改变全球航运和美洲战略格局，并引发长期主权争议。
significance.en: It transformed global shipping and American strategic geography while generating a prolonged sovereignty dispute.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Opening of the Panama Canal

summary.zh: 萨拉热窝刺杀事件触发外交危机，在联盟、帝国竞争和军事动员相互作用下演变为世界大战。欧洲是主要战场之一，殖民地士兵、劳工和资源也被广泛动员。工业化战争造成巨大伤亡，多个帝国崩溃，其结束后的边界、赔款与民族安排仍引发争议。
summary.en: The assassination at Sarajevo triggered a diplomatic crisis that escalated through alliances, imperial competition and military mobilization into world war. Europe was a principal theatre, but colonial soldiers, labourers and resources were drawn into a genuinely global conflict. Industrial warfare caused immense losses and several empires collapsed. Postwar borders, reparations and national settlements remained contested rather than delivering a stable peace.

significance.zh: 大战摧毁旧帝国格局，并重塑二十世纪国际政治。
significance.en: The war dismantled old imperial structures and reshaped twentieth-century international politics.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — First World War

summary.zh: 战争、粮食短缺与政治危机推动俄国沙皇退位，临时政府与苏维埃并存，随后布尔什维克夺取政权。二月和十月为当时俄国使用的旧历名称，对应公历三月和十一月。革命之后发生内战和广泛暴力，苏维埃国家的建立并非一九一七年即告完成。
summary.en: War, food shortages and political crisis led to the tsar’s abdication and competing authority between the Provisional Government and soviets. The Bolsheviks later seized power. “February” and “October” use Russia’s contemporary Julian calendar, corresponding to March and November in the Gregorian calendar. Civil war and extensive violence followed, so the formation of the Soviet state was not completed within 1917 alone.

significance.zh: 革命开启了苏维埃政权，并影响全球社会主义与反殖民运动。
significance.en: The revolutions established Soviet power and influenced socialist and anticolonial movements worldwide.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Russian revolutions of 1917

title.zh: 一九一八年流感大流行

summary.zh: 流感在战争末期迅速跨洲传播，引发严重死亡与公共卫生危机，年轻成年人也受到异常沉重的打击。所谓“西班牙流感”反映新闻报道与战时审查差异，不能证明疫情起源于西班牙。马德里仅为历史命名的代表点，本事件并不确定最早暴发地点。
summary.en: Influenza spread rapidly across continents near the end of the First World War, causing extraordinary mortality and public-health disruption, including severe effects among young adults. The label “Spanish flu” reflected patterns of reporting and wartime censorship, not proof of a Spanish origin. Madrid is used only as a representative point for that historical label; the earliest outbreak location is not established here.

significance.zh: 大流行显示了战争、全球交通与公共卫生能力之间的紧密联系。
significance.en: The pandemic revealed the connections among war, global transport and public-health capacity.

sources.title: CDC archive — 1918 Pandemic (H1N1 virus)

summary.zh: 朝鲜独立人士发表独立宣言，群众示威随后遍及日本殖民统治下的半岛，学生、宗教人士和普通居民广泛参与。日本当局以暴力镇压，运动却扩大了独立诉求的社会基础，并推动海外临时政府与国际宣传活动。首尔代表最初的重要示威地点。
summary.en: Korean independence activists issued a declaration and mass demonstrations spread across the peninsula under Japanese colonial rule. Students, religious groups and ordinary residents participated, meeting violent repression. Although immediate independence was not achieved, the movement widened the social foundations of resistance and encouraged overseas provisional-government activity and international advocacy. Seoul represents an important initial protest location within a nationwide movement.

significance.zh: 非暴力群众动员成为朝鲜反殖民独立运动的重要转折。
significance.en: Mass civilian mobilization became a major turning point in Korea’s anticolonial independence movement.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Korean March First Movement

summary.zh: 北京学生抗议巴黎和会有关山东权益的处置，示威迅速与罢工、抵制日货和知识界讨论相联系。事件同此前新文化运动交织，推动白话、科学、民主以及多种政治思想的传播。不同参与者对国家出路意见并不一致，北京代表运动起点而非全部影响范围。
summary.en: Students in Beijing protested the Paris Peace Conference’s handling of rights in Shandong, and demonstrations connected with strikes, boycotts and intellectual debate. The protests interacted with the earlier New Culture Movement, encouraging vernacular writing and discussion of science, democracy and competing political ideologies. Participants disagreed about China’s future. Beijing marks the initial demonstration rather than the full geographical reach of the movement.

significance.zh: 青年与公众动员把文化变革和国家政治更紧密地联系起来。
significance.en: Youth and public mobilization connected cultural transformation more closely with national politics.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — May Fourth Movement

summary.zh: 协约国与德国签署条约，规定领土调整、军事限制、赔偿责任及国际联盟安排。德国未以平等身份参与主要谈判，殖民地人民的自决诉求也受到限制。条约是战后多份和约之一，其后果与经济危机、政治选择等因素交织，不能单独解释第二次世界大战。
summary.en: The Allied powers and Germany signed a treaty imposing territorial changes, military restrictions and reparations obligations while incorporating arrangements for the League of Nations. Germany did not participate equally in the central negotiations, and colonial self-determination remained restricted. Versailles was one of several postwar settlements; its consequences interacted with economic crises and political choices and cannot alone explain the Second World War.

significance.zh: 战后和平安排同时孕育了新的国际制度与严重的不满。
significance.en: The peace settlement created new international institutions while generating deep grievances.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Treaty of Versailles

title.en: Establishment of the League of Nations

summary.zh: 第一次世界大战后，国际联盟正式成立，试图通过集体安全、外交协商和国际合作预防战争。它在公共卫生、难民和劳工相关事务上开展工作，但主要强国参与不全、决策机制和执行能力有限。日内瓦代表其总部，后来危机暴露了这一制度的严重弱点。
summary.en: The League of Nations began operating after the First World War, seeking to prevent conflict through collective security, diplomacy and international cooperation. It developed work on public health, refugees and related international problems, but incomplete great-power participation and limited enforcement undermined its security role. Geneva represents the headquarters. Subsequent crises exposed weaknesses without erasing the importance of its institutional experiments.

significance.zh: 它是常设全球国际组织的重要尝试，并为联合国提供经验。
significance.en: It was a major experiment in permanent global organization and informed the later United Nations.

sources.title: UN Geneva — League of Nations overview

title.zh: 图坦卡蒙墓的现代考古发现
title.en: Modern archaeological discovery of Tutankhamun’s tomb

summary.zh: 霍华德·卡特团队在帝王谷找到图坦卡蒙墓入口，墓内保存的大量物品使古埃及王室生活受到全球关注。发掘依赖埃及工人和专业人员的劳动，也发生在埃及争取更大主权的时代。此事件指现代考古发现，墓葬本身及相关文化远早于这一日期。
summary.en: Howard Carter’s team located the entrance to Tutankhamun’s tomb in the Valley of the Kings, where surviving objects attracted worldwide attention to ancient Egyptian royal life. Egyptian workers and specialists were essential to the excavation, which took place amid struggles over national sovereignty and control of antiquities. The date refers to modern archaeological discovery, not the tomb’s ancient construction.

significance.zh: 发现促进了埃及学与公众考古兴趣，也凸显文物归属和研究权问题。
significance.en: The discovery expanded Egyptology and public interest while highlighting questions of ownership and research authority.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Modern archaeological discovery of Tutankhamun’s tomb

title.en: Proclamation of the Republic of Turkey

summary.zh: 奥斯曼帝国战败及土耳其独立战争后，共和国在安卡拉宣告成立，穆斯塔法·凯末尔成为总统。国家随后推行法律、教育和宗教管理改革，但伴随威权政治与民族同质化压力。洛桑体系和人口交换重塑地区社会，国家建立不能与这些复杂后果分离。
summary.en: Following Ottoman defeat and the Turkish War of Independence, a republic was proclaimed in Ankara with Mustafa Kemal as president. Reforms in law, education and religious administration followed, alongside authoritarian politics and pressures toward national homogenization. The Lausanne settlement and population exchange reshaped regional communities. The republic’s foundation must therefore be understood together with both institutional transformation and the human costs of nation-building.

significance.zh: 后奥斯曼政治秩序中形成了新的共和国与国家认同工程。
significance.en: A new republic and programme of national identity emerged within the post-Ottoman order.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Proclamation of the Republic of Turkey

title.zh: 青霉素的发现与临床发展
title.en: Discovery and clinical development of penicillin

summary.zh: 弗莱明观察到霉菌抑制细菌生长，后来弗洛里、钱恩及其他研究者解决提纯、临床试验和生产问题。青霉素并非发现当年就成为普遍可用药物，其广泛应用依赖第二次世界大战时期的工业协作。伦敦代表最初发现地点，研发和生产横跨多个机构与国家。
summary.en: Fleming observed that a mould inhibited bacterial growth, while later researchers, including Florey and Chain, developed purification, clinical testing and production methods. Penicillin did not become a widely available medicine immediately in 1928. Its large-scale use depended on extensive research and wartime industrial collaboration. London marks the initial observation, while development and manufacturing involved multiple institutions and countries.

significance.zh: 抗生素的有效应用改变了细菌感染治疗与现代医学实践。
significance.en: Effective antibiotic treatment transformed responses to bacterial infection and modern medical practice.

sources.title: Nobel Prize — Physiology or Medicine 1945

summary.zh: 金融崩溃、银行危机、需求下降与国际经济政策失误相互作用，造成大规模失业和贸易萎缩。纽约股灾是重要节点，却不是全部原因或所有地区危机的同一起点。不同国家采取新政、紧缩、保护主义等回应，复苏时间也不一致，改变了国家与市场关系。
summary.en: Financial collapse, banking crises, falling demand and policy failures interacted to produce mass unemployment and contracting international trade. The New York stock-market crash was a major turning point, not the sole cause or a common starting date for every region. Governments responded with varying combinations of intervention, austerity and protectionism, and recovery occurred unevenly, transforming debates about relations between states and markets.

significance.zh: 大萧条促使经济治理与社会保障制度发生重大调整。
significance.en: The Depression prompted major changes in economic governance and social protection.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Great Depression

summary.zh: 甘地率领追随者从萨巴尔马蒂步行至丹迪海岸，公开违反英国殖民政府的盐法，随后引发广泛的非暴力不合作行动。食盐税影响日常生活，使反殖民诉求具有鲜明的群众基础。运动遭到逮捕与镇压，却推动印度独立问题进入国际舆论中心。
summary.en: Gandhi and followers walked from Sabarmati to the coast at Dandi and publicly defied the colonial salt law, encouraging wider civil disobedience. Because salt taxation touched everyday life, the campaign connected anti-imperial politics with an accessible material grievance. Arrests and repression followed, but the movement expanded participation and brought international attention to the struggle for Indian independence.

significance.zh: 非暴力抗争把普通生活议题转化为大规模政治动员。
significance.en: Nonviolent resistance transformed an everyday issue into mass political mobilization.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Salt March

summary.zh: 日本关东军以九一八事变为借口扩大军事行动，占领中国东北主要地区，并扶植“满洲国”。国际联盟调查和外交谴责未能有效制止侵略，日本随后退出国联。沈阳代表军事行动起点，这一事件是东亚战争升级的重要阶段，中国社会也展开持续抵抗。
summary.en: Japan’s Kwantung Army used the Mukden Incident as a pretext to expand military operations, occupying major parts of Manchuria and establishing the puppet state of Manchukuo. League of Nations investigation and diplomatic condemnation failed to reverse the aggression, and Japan later withdrew from the League. Shenyang marks the initial incident within a wider process of occupation and sustained Chinese resistance.

significance.zh: 它暴露集体安全的弱点，并推动东亚冲突走向全面战争。
significance.en: It exposed weaknesses in collective security and advanced East Asia’s escalation toward full-scale war.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Japanese occupation of Manchuria

title.zh: 纳粹在德国建立独裁统治
title.en: Establishment of Nazi dictatorship in Germany

summary.zh: 希特勒被任命为总理后，纳粹利用紧急法令、政治暴力及授权法摧毁民主制度，镇压反对派并排斥犹太人等群体。独裁的建立经过一系列政治决定与制度变化，并非民主选举自动授权其全部政策。此后种族迫害进一步升级，最终发展为战争与种族灭绝。
summary.en: After Hitler’s appointment as chancellor, the Nazis used emergency decrees, political violence and enabling legislation to dismantle democracy, suppress opponents and exclude Jews and other targeted groups. Dictatorship emerged through specific political decisions and institutional changes; an election did not automatically authorize all subsequent policies. Racial persecution intensified afterward, ultimately developing into aggressive war and genocide.

significance.zh: 民主制度的瓦解为国家组织的大规模迫害和侵略创造条件。
significance.en: The destruction of democracy enabled state-organized persecution and aggression on a vast scale.

sources.title: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum — Nazi rise to power

title.zh: 中国全面抗日战争爆发

summary.zh: 卢沟桥事变后，日本侵华行动扩大为全面战争，中国国民政府、共产党军队及广大民众展开不同形式的抵抗。战争造成大规模平民伤亡、迁徙与城市破坏，并与一九四一年后的太平洋战争相连。卢沟桥代表全面战争升级节点，抗日抵抗此前已存在。
summary.en: After the Marco Polo Bridge Incident, Japanese aggression expanded into full-scale war in China. Nationalist forces, Communist armies and civilian communities pursued varied forms of resistance. Fighting, atrocities and occupation caused immense civilian losses, displacement and urban destruction, while the conflict later intersected with the Pacific War. The bridge marks escalation in 1937, not the beginning of every form of Chinese resistance.

significance.zh: 中国战场成为第二次世界大战的重要组成部分并深刻改变国内政治。
significance.en: The China theatre became a major part of the Second World War and transformed domestic politics.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Outbreak of full-scale Sino-Japanese War

summary.zh: 德国入侵波兰引发欧洲全面战争，轴心国与同盟国冲突最终遍及多个大洲和海洋。东亚战争已有更早起点，因此一九三九年是常用的欧洲中心分期。战争包含大屠杀、殖民动员和大规模轰炸，结束后催生联合国与新的国际权力格局。
summary.en: Germany’s invasion of Poland triggered full-scale European war, and conflict between Axis and Allied powers ultimately extended across continents and oceans. Warfare in East Asia had earlier beginnings, so 1939 is a conventional European-centred starting date. Genocide, colonial mobilization and massive bombing formed central parts of the conflict. Its conclusion produced the United Nations and a transformed international distribution of power.

significance.zh: 战争造成空前破坏，并推动全球秩序与殖民体系重组。
significance.en: The war caused unprecedented destruction and accelerated the reorganization of world order and colonial systems.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Second World War

title.zh: 广岛与长崎原子弹轰炸
title.en: Atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki

summary.zh: 美国分别在八月六日和九日向广岛、长崎投下原子弹，造成巨大即时伤亡及长期辐射伤害。轰炸与苏联对日参战等因素共同处于日本投降的历史背景中，其相对作用仍有学术争论。广岛是两个城市的代表点，事件开启核武器实际用于战争的时代。
summary.en: The United States dropped atomic bombs on Hiroshima and Nagasaki on 6 and 9 August, causing massive immediate casualties and long-term radiation injuries. The bombings occurred alongside Soviet entry into the war against Japan and other pressures surrounding Japan’s surrender; historians debate their relative roles. Hiroshima represents the two affected cities and the first wartime use of nuclear weapons.

significance.zh: 核战争的破坏能力改变了安全观念与全球裁军议程。
significance.en: The destructive power of nuclear warfare transformed security thinking and the global disarmament agenda.

sources.title: United Nations — History of nuclear testing and the beginning of the nuclear era

summary.zh: 苏联军队于一月抵达奥斯维辛，解放仍留在营中的幸存者，此前纳粹已强迫大量囚犯参加死亡行军。奥斯维辛是纳粹屠杀犹太人及迫害其他群体的核心场所之一。解放并未消除幸存者长期创伤，这一地点后来成为大屠杀记忆与教育的重要中心。
summary.en: Soviet troops reached Auschwitz in January and liberated prisoners remaining in the camp after the Nazis had forced many others onto death marches. Auschwitz was a central site in the genocide of European Jews and the persecution of other groups. Liberation did not remove survivors’ lasting trauma. The site subsequently became a major centre for Holocaust remembrance, research and education.

significance.zh: 营地解放使纳粹大屠杀的罪行留下不可回避的物证与见证。
significance.en: Liberation preserved essential evidence and testimony of Nazi genocide.

sources.title: United States Holocaust Memorial Museum — Auschwitz

summary.zh: 五十个国家的代表在旧金山会议起草并签署《联合国宪章》，宪章于十月生效，联合国正式成立。组织以维护和平、国际合作及人权为宗旨，也将战胜国特权写入安理会制度。旧金山表示创始会议地点，不是后来位于纽约的主要总部。
