summary.en: Representatives of fifty countries drafted and signed the United Nations Charter at San Francisco, and the organization formally began when the Charter entered into force in October. Its purposes included peace, cooperation and human rights, while Security Council arrangements also institutionalized privileges of the victorious great powers. San Francisco marks the founding conference, not the later principal headquarters in New York.

significance.zh: 联合国成为战后国际合作与外交协商的核心制度之一。
significance.en: The United Nations became a central institution of postwar cooperation and diplomacy.

sources.title: United Nations — History of the UN

summary.zh: 英国结束对印度的殖民统治，印度与巴基斯坦成为独立国家，宗教人口分布被用于划分部分边界。分治伴随大规模迁徙、屠杀和家庭离散，难民的经历并非单一叙事。新德里只是代表地点，旁遮普、孟加拉等地区受到特别深刻的冲击，边界争端随后持续。
summary.en: British colonial rule ended as India and Pakistan became independent states, with religious demography influencing parts of the new boundary. Partition involved enormous population movements, massacres and family separation, experienced differently across communities. New Delhi is only a representative point; Punjab and Bengal were especially affected. Disputes over territory and belonging continued long after the formal transfer of power.

significance.zh: 去殖民化实现国家独立，同时留下深刻的人道与边界问题。
significance.en: Decolonization achieved independence while leaving profound humanitarian and territorial problems.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Indian independence and Partition

title.zh: 以色列建国、战争与巴勒斯坦人大流离
title.en: Israel’s foundation, war and the Palestinian Nakba

summary.zh: 英国委任统治结束前后，以色列宣布成立，已在进行的犹太人与阿拉伯人冲突扩展为邻国参与的战争。大量巴勒斯坦人被驱逐或逃离家园，巴勒斯坦人称此为“灾难”。停战线形成后，难民、领土和国家地位问题仍未解决，特拉维夫为建国宣告的代表地点。
summary.en: As British mandatory rule ended, Israel declared independence and the ongoing conflict expanded into war involving neighbouring Arab states. Large numbers of Palestinians were expelled or fled their homes, a catastrophe remembered as the Nakba. Armistice lines emerged, but refugee, territorial and national questions remained unresolved. Tel Aviv represents the declaration of statehood, not the full geography of warfare and displacement.

significance.zh: 新国家的成立与巴勒斯坦难民危机共同塑造了此后地区政治。
significance.en: The creation of a new state and the Palestinian refugee crisis jointly shaped subsequent regional politics.

sources.title: United Nations — History of the Question of Palestine

title.en: Adoption of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights

summary.zh: 联合国大会在巴黎通过《世界人权宣言》，提出应普遍保护的公民、政治、经济、社会与文化权利。文本由来自多种法律文化背景的代表参与起草，既回应战争暴行，也反映国际政治协商。宣言本身不是条约，却成为后来人权公约与社会运动的重要依据。
summary.en: The United Nations General Assembly adopted the Universal Declaration of Human Rights in Paris, articulating civil, political, economic, social and cultural rights for universal protection. Representatives from different legal and cultural traditions contributed to its drafting, responding to wartime atrocities through international negotiation. The declaration was not itself a treaty, but it became a foundation for later conventions and rights movements.

significance.zh: 普遍人权成为战后国际秩序中明确表达的共同规范。
significance.en: Universal human rights became an explicitly articulated norm of the postwar international order.

sources.title: United Nations — Universal Declaration of Human Rights

title.en: Foundation of the People’s Republic of China

summary.zh: 中国共产党在内战中取得决定性优势后，毛泽东在北京宣布中华人民共和国成立。国民政府随后迁往台湾，海峡两岸形成持续分治。新政府推动土地、国家机构和经济制度重组；这一事件标志政权转换，但并不意味着所有军事冲突或国家建构问题在当年结束。
summary.en: After the Chinese Communist Party gained decisive advantages in the civil war, Mao Zedong proclaimed the People’s Republic of China in Beijing. The Nationalist government subsequently relocated to Taiwan, producing a continuing division across the strait. The new government reorganized landholding, state institutions and the economy. The proclamation marked a transfer of power, not the immediate conclusion of every conflict or state-building issue.

significance.zh: 中国的政治制度和国际关系进入新的阶段。
significance.en: China’s political institutions and international relations entered a new phase.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Foundation of the People’s Republic of China

summary.zh: 朝鲜军队越过三八线后爆发战争，韩国与美国主导的联合国军、中国人民志愿军等先后参战。战争反复越过半岛多地，造成巨大平民伤亡和破坏。一九五三年签订停战协定，但并未签署结束战争状态的全面和平条约，板门店代表停战谈判地点。
summary.en: War began when North Korean forces crossed the thirty-eighth parallel, followed by intervention from a US-led United Nations command and Chinese forces, among others. Front lines shifted across the peninsula, causing enormous civilian suffering and destruction. The 1953 armistice halted major fighting but was not a comprehensive peace treaty. Panmunjom represents the negotiations rather than the war’s full geographical extent.

significance.zh: 战争巩固了半岛分裂，并使冷战军事对抗长期化。
significance.en: The war entrenched the peninsula’s division and prolonged Cold War military confrontation.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Korean War

summary.zh: 沃森和克里克提出DNA双螺旋结构模型，研究依赖富兰克林、威尔金斯等人的X射线衍射成果及既有化学知识。碱基配对为理解遗传信息复制提供了结构线索，但遗传密码和分子调控仍需后续研究。剑桥代表模型构建地，而非全部实验贡献的地点。
summary.en: Watson and Crick proposed a double-helix model of DNA, drawing on X-ray diffraction work by Rosalind Franklin, Maurice Wilkins and others, together with existing chemical knowledge. Base pairing suggested a mechanism for copying genetic information, although the genetic code and molecular regulation required further research. Cambridge represents the modelling work rather than every location contributing essential experimental evidence.

significance.zh: 结构发现为分子遗传学提供了关键机制与研究框架。
significance.en: The structural model supplied a crucial mechanism and framework for molecular genetics.

sources.title: Nobel Prize — Physiology or Medicine 1962

summary.zh: 阿尔及利亚民族解放阵线发动武装斗争，法国军队与殖民统治体系进行镇压，战争伴随酷刑、恐怖袭击和人口流离。埃维昂协议及公投之后，阿尔及利亚于一九六二年独立。独立伴随欧洲移民大规模离去和内部权力斗争，并非无冲突的终点。
summary.en: The National Liberation Front’s armed struggle met French military repression in a war involving torture, attacks on civilians and displacement. The Évian agreements and referendums preceded Algerian independence in 1962. Independence brought mass departure of European settlers and internal struggles over power rather than a conflict-free conclusion. Algiers represents a national struggle extending across the country and into metropolitan France.

significance.zh: 阿尔及利亚战争成为战后去殖民化及殖民暴力讨论的重要案例。
significance.en: The Algerian war became a defining case in postwar decolonization and debates over colonial violence.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Algerian independence

summary.zh: 来自亚洲和非洲的二十九个国家或地区代表在万隆举行会议，讨论反殖民主义、和平共处和经济文化合作。与会者在制度和冷战立场上并不一致，却共同争取在国际事务中的发言权。会议影响了后来的不结盟运动，但不等于该组织当年已经成立。
summary.en: Representatives of twenty-nine Asian and African countries or territories met at Bandung to discuss anticolonialism, peaceful coexistence and economic and cultural cooperation. Participants differed in political systems and Cold War alignment but sought greater influence in international affairs. The conference influenced the later Non-Aligned Movement, although that organization was not founded at Bandung itself. The meeting helped articulate shared postcolonial aspirations.

significance.zh: 亚非国家以集体方式提出独立于大国对抗的国际议程。
significance.en: Asian and African states collectively advanced an international agenda beyond great-power rivalry.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Bandung Conference

summary.zh: 英属黄金海岸与英属多哥兰合并组成独立的加纳，夸梅·恩克鲁玛及群众政治组织推动了这一转变。独立受到泛非主义者广泛关注，并鼓舞其他非洲殖民地的运动。新国家仍面临发展、政治多元和国际依赖问题，阿克拉代表独立庆典和中央政府。
summary.en: The Gold Coast and British Togoland became independent Ghana after mobilization associated with Kwame Nkrumah and a wider mass political movement. Independence attracted attention across Pan-African networks and encouraged other anticolonial struggles. The new state still faced questions of development, political pluralism and external dependence. Accra represents the independence celebrations and central government rather than the whole territory’s diverse experiences.

significance.zh: 加纳成为撒哈拉以南非洲去殖民化浪潮的重要先驱。
significance.en: Ghana became a leading landmark in the decolonization of sub-Saharan Africa.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Independence of Ghana

summary.zh: 苏联从拜科努尔发射斯普特尼克一号，使第一颗人造地球卫星进入轨道。无线电信号可被地面接收，展示了火箭与轨道工程能力。事件激化美苏科技和军事竞争，也推动科学教育、卫星通信及航天机构建设；地点表示发射场，并非卫星在轨位置。
summary.en: The Soviet Union launched Sputnik 1 from Baikonur, placing the first artificial Earth satellite in orbit. Its radio signals could be received on the ground and demonstrated rocket and orbital engineering capability. The event intensified US–Soviet scientific and military competition and encouraged investment in education, space institutions and satellite technology. The coordinate marks the launch site, not the satellite’s position in orbit.

significance.zh: 人类活动首次进入持续环绕地球的人工卫星时代。
significance.en: Human activity entered the era of artificial satellites orbiting Earth.

sources.title: NASA — Dawn of the Space Age

title.en: Expansion of the Green Revolution in Asia

summary.zh: 高产品种、灌溉、化肥、农药和农业推广共同推动亚洲部分地区粮食增产，印度的小麦与菲律宾等地的水稻研究尤其重要。收益受到水源、土地与资本分布影响，环境和社会代价也逐渐显现。范围表示扩展阶段，菲律宾水稻研究机构所在地为代表点。
summary.en: High-yielding varieties combined with irrigation, fertilizer, pesticides and agricultural extension increased grain production in parts of Asia. Wheat research in India and rice research associated with the Philippines were particularly influential. Benefits depended on access to water, land and capital, while environmental and social costs also emerged. The range represents a broad expansion phase, with a Philippine rice-research location as the representative point.

significance.zh: 农业技术显著提高产量，同时使资源分配与生态影响更受关注。
significance.en: Agricultural technology raised yields while intensifying questions about resource distribution and ecological costs.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Expansion of the Green Revolution in Asia

title.zh: “非洲年”与联合国非殖民化宣言
title.en: Year of Africa and the UN decolonization declaration

summary.zh: 一九六〇年，十七个非洲国家获得独立，因此常被称为“非洲年”；联合国大会同年通过给予殖民地国家和人民独立的宣言。各地独立道路不同，有的经协商，有的伴随危机与暴力。利伯维尔作为当年独立国家之一的代表点，并非整个去殖民化进程中心。
summary.en: Seventeen African countries gained independence in 1960, widely remembered as the Year of Africa, while the UN General Assembly adopted its declaration on colonial independence. Routes to statehood differed, including negotiation, crisis and violence, and formal independence did not eliminate inherited economic or political problems. Libreville represents one of the newly independent states rather than a single centre of continental decolonization.

significance.zh: 非洲国家大规模进入国际体系，反殖民自决获得更明确规范支持。
significance.en: African states entered the international system in large numbers as anticolonial self-determination gained stronger normative support.

sources.title: United Nations — Decolonization

title.zh: 加加林首次载人轨道飞行

summary.zh: 尤里·加加林乘坐东方一号从拜科努尔升空，完成人类首次进入太空并绕地球飞行的任务。飞行由复杂地面控制、火箭和生命保障系统共同支撑，并置于冷战竞争背景下。地图点为发射场，任务的实际航迹环绕地球，返回方式也不同于后来的载人飞船。
summary.en: Yuri Gagarin launched aboard Vostok 1 from Baikonur and became the first human to travel into space and orbit Earth. The mission depended on extensive ground control, rocket engineering and life-support systems within the context of Cold War competition. The map marks the launch site; the actual flight circled the planet, and its landing arrangements differed from those of later crewed spacecraft.

significance.zh: 载人航天证明人类能够短期在轨道环境中生存和工作。
significance.en: Human spaceflight demonstrated that people could survive and operate briefly in an orbital environment.

sources.title: European Space Agency — 12 April 1961

summary.zh: 美国发现苏联在古巴部署核导弹后实施海上封锁式隔离，美苏在高度紧张中进行公开与秘密谈判。苏联撤走导弹，美国承诺不入侵古巴，并秘密同意移除在土耳其的导弹。哈瓦那为代表点，危机涉及多个决策中心，也凸显核误判风险。
summary.en: After detecting Soviet nuclear missiles in Cuba, the United States imposed a naval quarantine and confronted the Soviet Union through public and secret negotiations. Soviet missiles were removed, the United States pledged not to invade Cuba, and a secret understanding addressed US missiles in Turkey. Havana is a representative point in a crisis involving several decision-making centres and acute risks of nuclear miscalculation.

significance.zh: 核危机推动危机沟通和军备控制成为国际安全的重要议题。
significance.en: The crisis strengthened the importance of communication and arms control in international security.

sources.title: US Office of the Historian — Cuban Missile Crisis

title.zh: 第二次梵蒂冈大公会议

summary.zh: 天主教主教在梵蒂冈举行大公会议，讨论教会与现代世界、其他基督宗派及非基督宗教的关系。会议推动礼仪更新、平信徒参与和宗教自由的重新表述，各地执行方式和接受程度不一。它没有取消教会传统，而是在延续与改革之间引发持续讨论。
summary.en: Catholic bishops gathered at the Vatican to reconsider the Church’s relationships with the modern world, other Christian communities and non-Christian religions. The council encouraged liturgical renewal, lay participation and a renewed articulation of religious freedom. Implementation varied across regions and provoked continuing debate. It did not simply abolish tradition but generated new interpretations of continuity and reform within Catholic life.

significance.zh: 会议深刻影响当代天主教礼仪、社会参与和宗教间对话。
significance.en: The council profoundly influenced contemporary Catholic worship, social engagement and interreligious dialogue.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Second Vatican Council

title.en: Foundation of the Organization of African Unity

summary.zh: 三十二个独立非洲国家在亚的斯亚贝巴签署宪章，成立非洲统一组织，推动反殖民斗争、国家合作及大陆团结。成员同时重视主权和不干涉原则，这既有助于维护独立，也限制组织处理内部冲突的能力。它后来由非洲联盟继承并发展。
summary.en: Thirty-two independent African states signed a charter at Addis Ababa to establish the Organization of African Unity, supporting anticolonial struggles, cooperation and continental solidarity. Members also emphasized sovereignty and non-interference, principles that protected independence but constrained responses to internal conflicts. The organization later became the institutional predecessor of the African Union, rather than remaining unchanged across subsequent decades.

significance.zh: 泛非主义获得大陆级常设组织的制度表达。
significance.en: Pan-African cooperation acquired a permanent continental institutional expression.

sources.title: African Union — Overview and history

summary.zh: 在黑人社区长期组织、诉讼、抗议与全国政治动员后，美国通过《民权法案》，禁止公共设施和就业等领域的若干歧视形式。立法并未自动结束种族主义，投票权还需次年的专门法律及后续执行。华盛顿表示立法地点，运动基础则遍及全国。
summary.en: After sustained Black community organizing, litigation, protest and national political mobilization, the United States adopted the Civil Rights Act. It prohibited specified forms of discrimination in public accommodations, employment and other areas. Legislation did not automatically end racism, and voting rights required additional measures and enforcement. Washington marks the legislative decision, while the movement’s foundations extended throughout the country.

significance.zh: 社会运动推动反歧视原则获得更强的联邦法律保障。
significance.en: Social mobilization secured stronger federal legal protections against discrimination.

sources.title: US National Archives — Civil Rights Act

summary.zh: 新加坡在加入马来西亚后不到两年即与联邦分离，成为独立共和国。独立发生在族群紧张、政党竞争和经济分歧的背景下，最初面临就业、防务与资源限制。此后国家推进出口工业化、住房和教育政策，其经济成就与政治制度问题仍需分别评估。
summary.en: Singapore separated from Malaysia less than two years after joining the federation and became an independent republic. Ethnic tensions, party competition and economic disputes formed the background, while the new state faced employment, defence and resource constraints. Subsequent policies emphasized export industry, housing and education. Economic achievements and questions about political institutions require separate assessment rather than an inevitable success narrative.

significance.zh: 一个资源有限的港口城市转向独立国家建设和全球贸易枢纽发展。
significance.en: A resource-constrained port city began independent state-building and development as a global trading hub.

sources.title: National Archives of Singapore — Proclamation of Singapore, 1965

summary.zh: 印度尼西亚、马来西亚、菲律宾、新加坡和泰国在曼谷签署宣言，建立东南亚国家联盟。组织提出经济、社会与文化合作目标，成立时也处于冷战和地区冲突背景。成员后来逐步扩大，因此不能把今日东盟的全部成员与机制都投射回一九六七年。
summary.en: Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore and Thailand signed the Bangkok Declaration establishing ASEAN. The organization promoted economic, social and cultural cooperation while emerging amid Cold War tensions and regional conflicts. Membership and institutions expanded later, so present-day arrangements should not be projected backward onto the founding moment. Bangkok marks the signing of the declaration rather than the organization’s later headquarters.

significance.zh: 东南亚国家建立了持续发展的区域合作框架。
significance.en: Southeast Asian states established a lasting framework for regional cooperation.

sources.title: ASEAN — The founding of ASEAN

title.zh: 阿波罗十一号载人登月

summary.zh: 阿波罗十一号从肯尼迪航天中心发射，阿姆斯特朗和奥尔德林在月面行走，柯林斯留在月球轨道飞船中。任务依赖庞大的工程、制造与计算团队，处于美苏航天竞争背景。地球地图上的点仅表示发射场，实际登月地点不在地球上。
summary.en: Apollo 11 launched from Kennedy Space Center, and Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walked on the Moon while Michael Collins remained in lunar orbit. The mission depended on extensive engineering, manufacturing and computing teams within the US–Soviet space competition. The terrestrial map point represents the launch site only; the actual landing occurred on the Moon, beyond this map’s geography.

significance.zh: 人类首次登上另一颗天体，展示大型科技协作的能力。
significance.en: Humans reached another celestial body for the first time, demonstrating the capacity of large-scale technological collaboration.

sources.title: NASA — Apollo 11

summary.zh: 东巴基斯坦选举结果引发的权力危机与长期语言、经济和政治矛盾升级，巴基斯坦军队镇压后爆发独立战争。大量平民死亡并逃往印度，孟加拉抵抗力量与印度军队最终击败巴军。达卡代表战争结束和新国家建立的主要地点，伤亡总数仍存在估计差异。
summary.en: A crisis over electoral power intensified longstanding linguistic, economic and political tensions in East Pakistan. Military repression was followed by a liberation war, mass civilian deaths and refugee movements into India. Bengali resistance forces and the Indian military ultimately defeated Pakistani forces. Dhaka represents the decisive surrender and state formation; casualty estimates differ and are not reduced here to a single disputed figure.

significance.zh: 南亚地图出现新的主权国家，分治遗留矛盾再次被深刻改写。
significance.en: A new sovereign state emerged in South Asia, reshaping unresolved legacies of Partition.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Bangladesh Liberation War

title.en: Adoption of the World Heritage Convention

summary.zh: 联合国教科文组织大会通过《保护世界文化和自然遗产公约》，将文化遗产与自然遗产纳入共同保护框架。缔约国承担识别和保护责任，国际合作提供支持。列入名录并非证明某种文化高于其他文化，也不意味着当地社区利益自动得到充分保障。
summary.en: UNESCO’s General Conference adopted the World Heritage Convention, bringing cultural and natural heritage into a shared framework of protection. States accepted responsibilities for identifying and safeguarding sites, supported by international cooperation. Inscription on a list does not demonstrate cultural superiority, nor does it automatically guarantee local communities’ interests. The convention established institutions through which conservation priorities could be negotiated across borders.

significance.zh: 遗产保护获得全球性的法律与合作框架。
significance.en: Heritage conservation gained a global legal and cooperative framework.

sources.title: UNESCO — World Heritage Convention

title.en: UN Conference on the Human Environment

summary.zh: 各国在斯德哥尔摩举行联合国首次以人类环境为核心的全球会议，讨论污染、资源及经济发展之间的关系。会议形成宣言和行动计划，并推动联合国环境规划署建立。发达国家与发展中国家的优先事项存在差异，环境治理从此更明确地成为国际政治议题。
summary.en: Governments met in Stockholm for the first major UN conference focused on the human environment, debating pollution, resources and economic development. The meeting produced a declaration and action plan and encouraged the creation of the UN Environment Programme. Industrialized and developing countries brought different priorities, making environmental governance an increasingly explicit matter of international negotiation rather than a purely domestic technical concern.

significance.zh: 全球环境保护进入常设国际合作与发展政策议程。
significance.en: Environmental protection entered permanent international cooperation and development-policy agendas.

sources.title: United Nations — Stockholm 1972

summary.zh: 巴布亚新几内亚结束澳大利亚行政管理，成为独立国家，由迈克尔·索马雷领导首届政府。新国家拥有极其多样的语言和社区，必须在殖民边界内建立共同政治制度。莫尔兹比港代表独立典礼和政府所在地，其后资源分配、地方自治与发展问题持续受到关注。
summary.en: Papua New Guinea became independent after Australian administration, with Michael Somare leading its first government. The new state brought exceptionally diverse linguistic and local communities into a shared political system within inherited colonial boundaries. Port Moresby represents the independence ceremony and national government. Questions of resource distribution, local autonomy and development continued, showing that formal sovereignty was the beginning of further state-building challenges.

significance.zh: 大洋洲去殖民化产生了新的国家与治理任务。
significance.en: Decolonization in Oceania produced a new state and continuing challenges of governance.

sources.title: National Museum of Australia — Papua New Guinea

summary.zh: 北越军队进入西贡，南越政府投降，长期战争的主要战事结束，越南次年正式统一。冲突涉及越南内部政治、法国殖民遗产和美国等国干预，也波及老挝、柬埔寨。战争结束之后仍有难民外逃、战后改造与地区冲突，不能等同于立即实现和平繁荣。
summary.en: North Vietnamese forces entered Saigon and the South Vietnamese government surrendered, ending the principal fighting of a prolonged war; formal reunification followed the next year. The conflict combined Vietnamese political struggles, French colonial legacies and foreign intervention and affected Laos and Cambodia as well. Refugee movements, postwar reconstruction and further regional conflict continued after the military victory.

significance.zh: 越南实现统一的道路进入新阶段，冷战干预的代价长期延续。
significance.en: Vietnam entered a new phase of reunification while the consequences of Cold War intervention endured.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — End of the Vietnam War

title.en: Beginning of China’s reform and opening

summary.zh: 中共十一届三中全会后，政策重心逐步转向经济建设，农村改革、对外开放和市场机制试验相继展开。改革并非一次完成或全国同步，家庭联产承包、经济特区和企业改革有各自进程。北京代表中央政策转向，长期影响包含增长、迁移及分配结构变化。
summary.en: After the Third Plenum of the Eleventh Central Committee, policy emphasis shifted toward economic development, with rural reform, external opening and experiments in market mechanisms unfolding over time. Household farming arrangements, special economic zones and enterprise reforms followed different schedules. Beijing represents the central policy shift rather than every local initiative. Long-term consequences included growth, migration and changes in income distribution.

significance.zh: 中国经济和社会逐步更深地融入全球生产与贸易网络。
significance.en: China’s economy and society became increasingly integrated into global production and trade networks.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Beginning of China’s reform and opening

summary.zh: 广泛反对巴列维王朝的抗议和罢工促使沙阿离国，霍梅尼返回伊朗，随后建立伊斯兰共和国。革命联盟包含宗教人士、自由派、左翼和其他群体，但新政权形成过程中权力逐渐集中，许多原先的参与者被排斥或镇压，地区关系亦发生剧变。
summary.en: Mass protests and strikes against the Pahlavi monarchy led to the shah’s departure, Khomeini’s return and the creation of an Islamic republic. The revolutionary coalition included religious activists, liberals, leftists and other groups, but power became increasingly concentrated as the new order developed. Many former participants were excluded or repressed, while Iran’s relationships with regional and international powers changed dramatically.

significance.zh: 革命重塑伊朗政治制度，并深刻影响中东和国际关系。
significance.en: The revolution remade Iran’s political system and profoundly affected Middle Eastern and international relations.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Iranian Revolution

summary.zh: 世界卫生大会确认全球消灭天花，这是长期疫苗接种、病例监测和发现后围堵传播的结果。各国卫生工作者与社区合作至关重要，最后一例自然感染病例出现在此前的索马里。日内瓦代表国际认证地点，不是疾病消失的唯一地点，也不意味着所有痘病毒消失。
summary.en: The World Health Assembly endorsed the global eradication of smallpox after sustained vaccination, surveillance and containment of outbreaks. Health workers and communities across many countries were essential, and the last naturally occurring case had been recorded in Somalia. Geneva represents international certification, not a single location where the disease disappeared, and eradication of smallpox did not mean the disappearance of all poxviruses.

significance.zh: 天花成为人类首次在全球消灭的传染病。
significance.en: Smallpox became the first human infectious disease eradicated worldwide.

sources.title: World Health Organization — Smallpox

summary.zh: 切尔诺贝利核电站四号反应堆在测试期间发生爆炸和火灾，设计缺陷、操作及安全管理问题共同导致灾难。放射性物质跨境扩散，附近居民被疏散并遭受长期社会影响。不同健康后果与死亡估计的证据强度不同，因此此处不采用单一总伤亡数字。
summary.en: Reactor four at Chernobyl exploded and burned during a test, with design flaws, operational decisions and safety-management failures contributing to the disaster. Radioactive material spread across borders, and nearby communities were evacuated and experienced lasting social disruption. Evidence for different health outcomes and mortality estimates varies, so the event is not summarized here with a single supposedly definitive death toll.

significance.zh: 事故推动核安全、信息公开和跨境灾害应对制度调整。
significance.en: The disaster prompted changes in nuclear safety, transparency and responses to cross-border emergencies.

sources.title: International Atomic Energy Agency — Chornobyl

summary.zh: 各国在蒙特利尔通过限制破坏臭氧层物质的议定书，将科学发现转化为分阶段削减生产和消费的国际规则。议定书后来多次修订，并以资金和技术合作支持履约。它与气候治理存在联系，但最初主要目标是保护臭氧层，不能与温室气体协定混同。
summary.en: Governments adopted the Montreal Protocol to control substances that damage the ozone layer, translating scientific findings into phased limits on production and consumption. Later amendments strengthened obligations, and financial and technical cooperation supported implementation. The agreement has connections with climate protection, but its original primary purpose was ozone-layer protection and should not be confused with a general treaty on greenhouse-gas emissions.

significance.zh: 它成为科学证据支持下跨国环境合作的重要案例。
significance.en: It became an important example of international environmental cooperation informed by scientific evidence.

sources.title: UNEP Ozone Secretariat — Montreal Protocol

summary.zh: 东德持续抗议、民众外流和政策危机促成边境管制松动，一次新闻发布会上的混乱宣布引发群众前往关卡，柏林墙于十一月九日晚开放。开放不是德国立即统一，后续谈判和政治程序持续至一九九〇年。事件成为东欧共产党政权转型的象征。
summary.en: Persistent protests, emigration and political crisis in East Germany weakened border restrictions. A confused press-conference announcement drew crowds to checkpoints, which opened on the evening of 9 November. Opening the wall did not immediately reunify Germany; negotiations and political processes continued into 1990. The event became a powerful symbol of the transformations affecting communist governments across Eastern Europe.

significance.zh: 冷战欧洲分裂的核心象征被突破，德国统一进程随后加速。
significance.en: A central symbol of Europe’s Cold War division was breached, accelerating German reunification.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Opening of the Berlin Wall

title.en: Invention and open release of the World Wide Web

summary.zh: 蒂姆·伯纳斯-李在欧洲核子研究中心提出超文本信息系统，随后发展网页、浏览器与服务器，使网络上的文档能够互相链接。一九九三年，CERN开放相关软件，促进广泛采用。万维网建立在既有互联网之上，二者不能视为同一发明或同一起点。
summary.en: Tim Berners-Lee proposed a hypertext information system at CERN and developed pages, a browser and a server that linked documents over computer networks. CERN’s release of the software in 1993 helped encourage widespread adoption. The World Wide Web was built on the already existing Internet; the two should not be treated as the same invention or assigned a single common starting date.

significance.zh: 开放标准和超链接改变了知识传播、商业与公共交流。
significance.en: Open standards and hyperlinks transformed knowledge circulation, commerce and public communication.

sources.title: CERN — The birth of the Web

summary.zh: 多国科研机构合作绘制和测定人类基因组，推动测序技术、数据共享与生物信息学发展。二〇〇三年公布完成主要目标，并不意味着每一段人类DNA都已无缺口测定；后续技术继续补全复杂区域。贝塞斯达代表合作机构之一，项目不是单一国家或实验室的成果。
summary.en: Research institutions in several countries collaborated to map and sequence the human genome, advancing sequencing technology, data sharing and bioinformatics. Completion of the project’s main goals in 2003 did not mean every stretch of human DNA had been resolved without gaps; later techniques addressed difficult regions. Bethesda represents one participating institution, not ownership of a collective international achievement.

significance.zh: 大规模开放生物数据为生命科学与医学研究建立新基础。
significance.en: Large-scale shared biological data established a new foundation for research in life science and medicine.

sources.title: National Human Genome Research Institute — Human Genome Project

summary.zh: 经济和政治危机、戈尔巴乔夫改革、各共和国主权运动及八月政变失败共同推动苏联瓦解。年底苏联中央国家机构终止存在，多个独立国家继承其领土与部分制度。莫斯科只是中央层面的代表点，转型在各地速度不同，并伴随经济震荡和新的冲突。
summary.en: Economic and political crisis, Gorbachev’s reforms, republican sovereignty movements and the failed August coup contributed to the Soviet Union’s dissolution. By year’s end, central Soviet institutions ceased to exist and multiple independent states inherited its territories and parts of its institutional legacy. Moscow represents the central political dimension; transitions differed regionally and involved economic disruption and new conflicts.

significance.zh: 冷战两极结构终结，欧亚地区出现新的国家与安全问题。
significance.en: The Cold War’s bipolar structure ended as new states and security problems emerged across Eurasia.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Dissolution of the Soviet Union

title.zh: 卢旺达反图西族种族灭绝
title.en: Genocide against the Tutsi in Rwanda

summary.zh: 卢旺达极端势力组织并实施针对图西族人的种族灭绝，反对杀戮的胡图族人也遭到杀害。宣传、国家机构和民兵网络参与暴力，国际社会未能有效阻止灾难。基加利为代表点，杀戮遍及多地，其后司法追责、难民问题与地区战争持续影响社会。
summary.en: Extremist forces in Rwanda organized and carried out genocide against the Tutsi, while Hutu opponents of the killings were also murdered. Propaganda, state institutions and militia networks enabled the violence, and the international response failed to stop it effectively. Kigali is a representative point for killings across the country. Accountability, refugee movements and regional warfare continued to shape its aftermath.

significance.zh: 灾难促使国际社会重新审视种族灭绝预防与保护平民的责任。
significance.en: The catastrophe forced renewed scrutiny of genocide prevention and responsibilities toward civilians.

sources.title: United Nations — Rwanda historical background

title.zh: 南非首次普遍选举与种族隔离终结
title.en: South Africa’s first universal national election

summary.zh: 南非举行首次不以种族限制投票资格的全国民主选举，非洲人国民大会获胜，曼德拉成为总统。结果来自长期反种族隔离斗争、社会动员和复杂谈判。政治制度转型并未消除土地、财富和机会的不平等，比勒陀利亚代表新总统就职的政府中心。
summary.en: South Africa held its first democratic national election without racial restrictions on the franchise, and the African National Congress won, with Nelson Mandela becoming president. The transition followed sustained anti-apartheid struggle, social mobilization and complex negotiations. Political transformation did not remove inequalities in land, wealth and opportunity. Pretoria represents the government centre and presidential inauguration rather than the nationwide voting process.

significance.zh: 种族隔离的法律政治体制被普遍公民权和民主选举取代。
significance.en: Apartheid’s legal and political order gave way to universal citizenship and democratic national elections.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — South Africa’s first universal national election

title.en: Establishment of the World Trade Organization

summary.zh: 乌拉圭回合谈判后，世界贸易组织开始运作，在关税与贸易总协定基础上建立更广泛的贸易规则和争端处理机制。规则覆盖货物、服务及知识产权等领域，成员之间仍存在发展程度和谈判能力差异。日内瓦代表总部，组织的政策影响遍及全球。
summary.en: Following the Uruguay Round negotiations, the World Trade Organization began operating with a broader set of trade rules and dispute procedures built on the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade. Its agreements covered goods, services and intellectual property, while members retained unequal development levels and negotiating capacities. Geneva represents the headquarters; the organization’s policies affected economic relationships around the world.

significance.zh: 全球贸易获得更统一的多边制度，也引发发展与公平争论。
significance.en: Global trade acquired a more unified multilateral framework alongside debates over development and fairness.

sources.title: World Trade Organization — What is the WTO?

title.en: Transfer of sovereignty over Hong Kong

summary.zh: 英国结束在香港的殖民管治，中国恢复对香港行使主权，香港特别行政区依基本法成立。“一国两制”安排保留不同于中国内地的经济和法律制度。此次移交有明确条约和宪制背景，其后自治、民主与身份问题的变化不能被简单提前写入当年的事件。
summary.en: British colonial administration ended and China resumed the exercise of sovereignty over Hong Kong, establishing a Special Administrative Region under the Basic Law. The “one country, two systems” framework retained economic and legal arrangements distinct from mainland China. The transfer rested on treaty and constitutional instruments; subsequent developments concerning autonomy, democracy and identity should be treated as later events rather than predetermined features of 1997.

significance.zh: 殖民管治结束，香港进入特别行政区的制度阶段。
significance.en: Colonial administration ended and Hong Kong entered the institutional framework of a Special Administrative Region.

sources.title: Hong Kong Basic Law — Official text

title.zh: 北爱尔兰《贝尔法斯特协议》

summary.zh: 英国、爱尔兰与北爱尔兰主要政治力量达成协议，设计权力分享、南北合作和英爱关系的新安排，并以同意原则处理宪制地位。公众公投支持协议，但和平进程仍涉及解除武装、警务改革及受害者诉求。贝尔法斯特代表谈判中心，协议并未立即消除所有暴力。
summary.en: The British and Irish governments and major Northern Irish political parties agreed on power-sharing, cross-border cooperation and new British–Irish arrangements, with constitutional status governed by consent. Referendums endorsed the agreement, but implementation involved disarmament, policing reform and victims’ concerns. Belfast represents the negotiating centre. The settlement did not instantly eliminate all violence or resolve every disagreement about identity and sovereignty.

significance.zh: 制度化协商为长期冲突提供了可持续的政治解决框架。
significance.en: Institutionalized negotiation supplied a durable political framework for addressing a prolonged conflict.

sources.title: UK Government — The Belfast Agreement

summary.zh: 基地组织劫持四架民航飞机袭击美国，世界贸易中心和五角大楼遭撞击，另一架飞机在宾夕法尼亚州坠毁。袭击造成大量平民死亡，纽约是多个袭击地点的代表点。事件后美国发动阿富汗战争并扩大反恐政策，全球安全、监控和公民自由争论随之改变。
summary.en: Al-Qaeda hijackers seized four civilian aircraft, attacking the World Trade Center and the Pentagon; another plane crashed in Pennsylvania. The attacks killed large numbers of civilians, with New York serving here as a representative point for several locations. The United States subsequently began war in Afghanistan and expanded counterterrorism policies, reshaping international security, surveillance and debates over civil liberties.

significance.zh: 恐怖袭击及其政策回应重塑了二十一世纪初的国际安全议程。
significance.en: The attacks and policy responses reshaped the early twenty-first-century international security agenda.

sources.title: National September 11 Memorial & Museum — 9/11 primer

summary.zh: 苏门答腊外海发生巨型海底地震，引发跨越印度洋的海啸，印度尼西亚、斯里兰卡、印度、泰国及更远海岸遭受灾难。大量居民和游客丧生，沿海生计与基础设施受到重创。地图点为震中附近，灾区横跨多个国家，灾后推动区域预警与救援合作。
summary.en: A powerful undersea earthquake off Sumatra generated a tsunami that crossed the Indian Ocean, devastating Indonesia, Sri Lanka, India, Thailand and more distant coasts. Residents and visitors died in large numbers, while coastal livelihoods and infrastructure suffered severe damage. The map marks the epicentral area, not the whole disaster zone. Recovery encouraged regional warning systems and international humanitarian cooperation.

significance.zh: 灾难显示跨海域预警与地方防灾能力的重要性。
significance.en: The disaster demonstrated the importance of ocean-wide warning systems and local preparedness.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami

summary.zh: 美国住房信贷风险通过证券化、金融杠杆和跨国机构联系扩散，银行与市场危机演变为全球衰退。二〇〇八年雷曼兄弟破产是关键节点，但危机此前已开始。各国救助、财政和货币政策减缓崩溃，也引发关于债务、监管、失业及不平等的长期争论。
summary.en: Risks in US housing credit spread through securitization, leverage and internationally connected financial institutions, producing banking and market crises and a global recession. Lehman Brothers’ failure in 2008 was a major turning point, not the initial cause or beginning of the crisis. Government rescues and fiscal and monetary responses limited collapse while generating lasting disputes over debt, regulation, unemployment and inequality.

significance.zh: 危机暴露金融全球化中的系统性风险并推动监管改革。
significance.en: The crisis exposed systemic risks in financial globalization and prompted regulatory reform.

sources.title: Federal Reserve History — Great Recession

title.zh: 《联合国土著人民权利宣言》通过
title.en: UN Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples

summary.zh: 联合国大会经过多年谈判通过宣言，确认土著人民在文化、土地、自决和参与决策等方面的权利。文本是国际宣言而非直接适用的全球条约，实施仍取决于具体法律和政治实践。纽约表示表决地点，相关运动与利益主体遍布大洋洲、美洲、亚洲及非洲。
summary.en: After years of negotiation, the UN General Assembly adopted a declaration recognizing Indigenous peoples’ rights concerning culture, land, self-determination and participation in decisions. The text is an international declaration rather than a universally self-executing treaty, and implementation depends on legal and political practice. New York marks the vote, while the relevant movements and communities extend across Oceania, the Americas, Asia and Africa.

significance.zh: 原住民长期诉求获得更明确的国际规范承认。
significance.en: Longstanding Indigenous demands received more explicit recognition in international norms.

sources.title: United Nations — Declaration on Indigenous Peoples’ Rights

summary.zh: 突尼斯抗议扩展为多个阿拉伯国家的群众运动，参与者要求尊严、就业、政治参与并反对腐败和威权统治。各地结果差异巨大，包括政权更替、改革、镇压和战争。西迪布济德为起点代表，日期只概括早期浪潮，不把后续长期冲突判定为已经结束。
summary.en: Protests in Tunisia helped inspire mass movements across several Arab countries, with demands for dignity, employment, political participation and an end to corruption and authoritarian rule. Outcomes diverged sharply, including government changes, reforms, repression and war. Sidi Bouzid represents an initial flashpoint. This date range describes the early wave and does not imply that subsequent conflicts or struggles were concluded.

significance.zh: 跨国抗议挑战了地区政治秩序，却没有产生单一转型道路。
significance.en: Cross-border protest challenged the regional political order without producing a single path of transition.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Arab uprisings

summary.zh: 联合国气候大会通过《巴黎协定》，确立控制全球升温的共同目标，并以各国自主贡献及定期更新机制推动行动。通过协定不等于已实现减排目标，其效果取决于政策、资金和落实程度。巴黎北郊会场代表谈判地点，气候风险与责任在各地区并不均等。
summary.en: The UN climate conference adopted the Paris Agreement, establishing shared temperature goals and a system of nationally determined contributions with periodic updating. Adoption did not mean that emissions targets had already been achieved; outcomes depend on policies, finance and implementation. The conference site near Paris represents the negotiations, while climate risks, historical responsibilities and capacities to respond differ substantially across regions.

significance.zh: 全球气候治理形成覆盖广泛国家的共同目标与承诺框架。
significance.en: Global climate governance gained a widely shared framework of goals and national commitments.

sources.title: UNFCCC — The Paris Agreement

title.zh: 联合国可持续发展目标

summary.zh: 联合国成员国通过二〇三〇年可持续发展议程，提出十七项目标，将贫困、教育、健康、性别平等、环境与制度治理等议题相联系。目标面向所有国家，但不意味着各国起点和能力相同。纽约表示通过地点，目标达成情况需依据指标与实际数据另行评估。
summary.en: UN member states adopted the 2030 Agenda with seventeen Sustainable Development Goals, linking poverty, education, health, gender equality, environmental protection and governance. The goals apply to all countries without implying equal starting conditions or capacities. New York marks their adoption. Progress must be assessed through indicators and actual evidence rather than assuming that the announcement itself delivered the intended outcomes.

significance.zh: 发展从单一经济增长指标转向更综合的社会与环境议程。
significance.en: Development was framed through a broader social and environmental agenda beyond economic growth alone.

sources.title: United Nations — Transforming our world: the 2030 Agenda

title.zh: 新冠疫情被评估为全球大流行

summary.zh: 世界卫生组织于三月十一日将新冠疫情评估为全球大流行，反映疾病已广泛跨国传播。其后各地采取公共卫生措施并研发疫苗，疫情造成严重死亡、经济和教育中断。日内瓦代表声明地点，此条仅标记正式评估节点，不把疫情起源定位于此，也不设定其终止年份。
summary.en: On 11 March, the World Health Organization characterized COVID-19 as a pandemic, reflecting widespread international transmission. Public-health measures and vaccine development followed alongside severe mortality, economic disruption and interrupted education. Geneva represents the announcement, not the disease’s origin. This entry records the formal assessment milestone only and does not assign an ending year to the pandemic or its continuing consequences.

significance.zh: 疫情凸显全球卫生联系、疫苗合作及资源分配不平等。
significance.en: The pandemic exposed global health interdependence, vaccine cooperation and unequal access to resources.

sources.title: World Health Organization — 11 March 2020 briefing

title.zh: 俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰

summary.zh: 俄罗斯于二月二十四日发动对乌克兰的全面入侵，使二〇一四年以来的冲突急剧扩大。联合国大会谴责侵略并要求撤军，战争造成广泛平民伤亡、流离失所及基础设施破坏。基辅为代表地点，此条只记录入侵开始，不用任意结束年份暗示战争已经终结。
summary.en: Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine on 24 February, dramatically escalating a conflict that had begun in 2014. The UN General Assembly condemned the aggression and demanded withdrawal. Warfare caused extensive civilian suffering, displacement and infrastructure damage. Kyiv serves as a representative location. This entry records the invasion’s start and does not invent an end date or imply that the war subsequently concluded.

significance.zh: 战争重塑欧洲安全与全球能源粮食关系。
significance.en: The war transformed European security and global energy and food relationships.

sources.title: United Nations — General Assembly demands an end to the invasion and withdrawal

title.zh: 印度月船三号成功软着陆
title.en: Chandrayaan-3 successfully lands on the Moon

summary.zh: 印度月船三号着陆器于八月二十三日在月球南部高纬度地区成功软着陆，并部署月球车开展探测。地点接近南极区域但并非月球南极点，任务继此前失败后完成关键工程目标。班加罗尔代表地面任务控制中心，实际科学探测地点位于月面。
summary.en: India’s Chandrayaan-3 lander touched down successfully at a high southern lunar latitude on 23 August and deployed a rover for investigation. The site was in the southern polar region, not at the Moon’s geographic south pole. The mission achieved key engineering goals after an earlier failed landing attempt. Bengaluru represents ground mission control; the actual exploration occurred on the lunar surface.

significance.zh: 印度成为实现月球软着陆的国家之一，扩大了深空探索参与。
significance.en: India joined the countries achieving lunar soft landings, broadening participation in deep-space exploration.

sources.title: European Space Agency — Chandrayaan-3 landing

title.zh: 喀麦隆启动常规疟疾疫苗接种

summary.zh: 喀麦隆于一月二十二日把RTS,S疟疾疫苗纳入常规儿童免疫服务，成为先前试点项目之外首个这样做的国家。疫苗用于降低疾病负担，需要多剂接种并与蚊帐、诊断和治疗配合，不能等同于已经消灭疟疾。雅温得代表全国项目启动与卫生管理中心。
summary.en: Cameroon introduced the RTS,S malaria vaccine into routine childhood immunization on 22 January, becoming the first country outside the earlier pilot programme to do so. Vaccination aims to reduce disease burden and requires multiple doses alongside measures such as bed nets, diagnosis and treatment; it does not mean malaria has been eradicated. Yaoundé represents the national launch and health-administration centre.

significance.zh: 长期疫苗研发进入更广泛公共卫生实施阶段。
significance.en: Longstanding vaccine development entered a wider phase of public-health implementation.

sources.title: WHO Regional Office for Africa — Cameroon malaria vaccine rollout
